6. What might be the effect on a community if the citizens did not participate in recreation activities?

7. What are some of the problems in communities where people do not follow rules?

title: Why Do We Need Rules?
text:
Over time people have formed communities for many reasons. Living in a group helps people feel safe. But to really feel safe, people who live in communities must have rules, or laws. Rules keep everything in order. Sometimes people do not agree with one another. Rules are needed to help find solutions to disagreements. Rules help keep people within a community safe and healthy. Without rules and order there could be chaos. This means there might be a great deal of confusion.

There are rules to follow in many places. We have rules to follow at home. Perhaps you have certain chores you must do before you play outside. Maybe you must always ask permission to do research on the internet. These rules help your parents keep order. Think about rules you follow at your house. Why are these rules important to your family?

People have rules to follow at work. Most people must report to work at a certain time. Some work places require employees to wear a uniform. Companies believe their businesses run better when everyone follows rules.

Of course there are rules at school. Rules here help you behave in the class and hallways. They also help you play fairly at recess. Rules are necessary so everyone in the school is safe. Rules at school also help make it a better place for you to learn.

There are also rules in our communities. Can you imagine what your community would be like if no one ever stopped at red lights? What if everyone threw their garbage into the streets? The community wouldn’t be a safe place to live, would it? Rules keep citizens happy and healthy.

Who makes the rules we all follow? Most of them are put into place by leaders. At home, the leaders are your parents. At school, your principal and teachers make the rules. In a community, government leaders such as the mayor and city council make rules for everyone to follow.

In this issue you will learn more about rules in communities. You will study different groups that help keep citizens of a community safe. You will also learn about your responsibility to follow rules. Most of all, you will be able to understand why rules and laws give us a better place to live.

title: K-9 Cops Protect Communities
text:
Being a police officer is a very tough job. It can be very demanding. Sometimes the job can be deadly. At the end of a long and stressful day of protecting citizens, some police officers relax with a good belly rub and ear scratching. Oh... and did we mention a bowl of kibble and bits?

That's right! Some of America's best police officers are the furry, four-legged kind. They are police dogs. This special group of crime fighters is also known as the K-9 unit of a police force. Just like human police officers, these dogs are specially trained to protect the safety and well being of citizens.

Police dogs spend many long hours in obedience and protection classes. After graduation they work with human police officers to help protect citizens. They are trained to track scents. Many K-9 officers work to sniff out bombs and drugs.

Police dogs often look friendly. They are trained to be patient and controlled. But don’t make the mistake of thinking these dogs are pets. They work long, hard hours in very tough situations. Their job is to protect citizens at all costs, even if it means their own life.

title: Keeping Communities Safe
text:
Communities provide many services for citizens. Some of the most important services are those that keep people safe. Many people choose to live in certain communities because they feel safe and protected there. As you know, people who live in communities must pay taxes. This tax money is used to fund, or pay for, all the services the people of a community receive. Below, you will learn about some of the services tax dollars pay for. These services help keep order in the community.

Police Departments

When you think about safety where you live, do you think about the police department? Police officers are very important members of the community. They help people in many ways. Of course they are available to help people who are in danger or trouble. They respond to accidents and disasters. They are trained to protect people and their property. You have probably seen a police officer controlling traffic or responding to an emergency. They drive vehicles that can be seen easily. If a police officer’s car lights are flashing and the siren is sounding, they are probably on their way to help someone.

Police officers also work to find and catch citizens who do not follow laws. Sometimes people break rules. The police department sees that these people do not harm others in the community or their property. Sometimes they must stop lawbreakers by arresting them. Even though it is not a fun part of their jobs, it must be done.

Police officers also spend time working with young people. They help children understand the importance of following rules. They encourage students not to try drugs or become involved with gangs. Many police officers have lots of stories to tell about people who made bad choices. You can count on a police officer if you are ever in trouble or scared. They will do everything necessary to protect your safety.

Fire Departments

Another important part of a community is the fire department. Firefighters must be very responsible. They are important because they help protect people and property in a community. Their most important job is to protect communities from fire. They put out fires and rescue people who are in danger of being burned or hurt by the fire. But that isn't the only thing firefighters do to help a community.

Firefighters are also trained to respond to many types of emergencies. They are able to help victims of disasters, automobile accidents and other emergencies. They clean up accident and disaster sites. Finally, they work to teach people in the community how to keep away from the danger of fire. Perhaps you have had the chance to visit with firefighters at your school. They usually spend time in schools making sure children know what to do in case of emergencies.

Like police officers, firefighters can be trusted to help you if you are ever in need. It is their job in the community.

Paramedics

In emergencies, people's lives often depend on quick thinking and immediate care. This job often falls to a paramedic. Paramedics are highly trained medical specialists. Their job is to respond to emergencies where people are injured or sick. They are trained to give treatment to people until they can be taken to a hospital or doctor.

Most communities have special teams of paramedics. Many of them work with firefighting and police teams to respond to disasters, accidents and emergencies. These healthcare professionals take the lead and give the first treatment to victims. Sometimes this happens in an ambulance.

Paramedics use their skills to save many lives each day. In a community emergency, you can bet a paramedic will be there quickly to help.

School Crossing Guards

The safety of children is very important in all communities. Children should be safe everywhere they go. That is why schools often have crossing guards. These responsible citizens must understand traffic laws. They must know how to signal cars to stop and go safely in traffic.

A crossing guard helps children walk to school safely. They stop traffic so students may cross the street without feeling afraid. Usually a crossing guard carries a flag or stop sign to warn drivers that children are near. Some crossing guards walk with the children back and forth across busy intersections.

Because crossing guards are there to protect the children, parents can be sure their child is getting to and from school safely.

title: The Four Chaplains
text:
On February 3, 1943, during World War II, a ship named the Dorchester was making its way across the North Atlantic. Over 900 soldiers were on the ship, going to an American military base in Greenland. During their journey, the ship was hit by a torpedo fired from a German submarine below them. The torpedo destroyed the ship's electrical system, which caused the ship to lose lights and power. There was no way to radio for help. Many soldiers were killed or wounded, and the ship began to sink.

On board the ship was a group of four chaplains (military pastors, rabbis and priests). Father John Washington (Catholic), Reverend Clark Poling (Dutch Reformed), Rabbi Alexander Goode (Jewish) and Rev. George Fox (Methodist) were some of the first on deck. The chaplains tried to calm the soldiers and helped take care of the injured men. They also started handing out life jackets and helping soldiers into lifeboats. When the life jackets ran out, the chaplains quickly gave theirs away. As the ship sank, some survivors say they remember seeing the chaplains standing on the ship linked arm-in-arm and praying as the ship sank. All four chaplains died.

Congress awarded the four chaplains the Purple Heart and the Distinguished Service Cross. February 3 was declared as "Four Chaplains Day" and the four men were honored with a postage stamp. The four chaplains will always be remembered for their bravery and willingness to put others before themselves.

title: What is a jury?
text: All American citizens have rights. They also have responsibilities. Serving on a jury is a very big responsibility. When someone is accused of a crime, they have the right to a trial with a jury. The U.S. Constitution guarantees that right. In many trials, a jury is the group of people who decide if a person is guilty of the crime. They have to listen carefully to all of the evidence and talk about whether there is proof that they are guilty. A jury may also help decide on the punishment given to those who are found guilty of breaking a law. A person who serves on a jury is called a juror.

title: Todd Beamer
text:
Todd Beamer, a 32-year-old husband and father, left his home in New Jersey at 8 a.m. on Tuesday, Sept. 11, 2001, for a business trip to San Francisco. Beamer never made it to California because his plane was hijacked by terrorists. (Hijacking an airplane means taking control of it illegally.)

Beamer called an operator on the in-flight telephone after the plane was hijacked, and she told him of the attacks on the World Trade Center. Beamer decided that he and others with him would not allow their plane to attack another American landmark. They would stop the hijackers, preventing a more serious tragedy, if they could.

The last words the operator heard Beamer say were "Are you guys ready? Let's roll." Later, the plane went down, crashing into a field in Somerset County, Pennsylvania, well away from its possible targets of the U.S. Capitol or the White House. Because of their patriotism and willingness to put their own lives on the line to protect others on the ground, Todd Beamer and those who helped him became true American heroes.

title: Rules
text: In this issue you learned rules are important to communities. You also learned there are school, home and community rules. Look closely at the rules below. Decide if it would be a rule to follow at home, school or in the community. Sort the rules and draw a line to the correct category it belongs in. Add two more rules of your own and draw lines to the correct category in which they belong.

title: Communities Need Play Time Too!
text:
What is the best part of your day? Is it work time? Maybe it's bedtime. More than likely the most exciting and fun part of your day is recess. Recess is a time when you get to stop everything else you are doing and take a break. You can run, play games or just sit and relax and visit with friends. Recess is a time when you can exercise and enjoy nature. After recess you probably feel less stressed and full of energy. Recess is something to look forward to every day. It is a fun type of recreation.

Recreation is any activity that people choose to do for enjoyment. Usually it is done in their free time. There are many different forms of recreation. Some people enjoy reading or watching television. Other people like more active forms of recreation, such as jogging or bike riding. Humans need recreational activities. They make people happy. But they can also be an important part of keeping people healthy. Recreational activities help people, so communities try to provide opportunities for citizens to enjoy them.

Community governments use tax money to pay for recreation. People who live in the community can enjoy all the recreational activities there. Most local governments have a special group to make decisions about the community's recreation. It is called the recreation and parks department. People who work there take care of the community's parks, swimming pools and recreation buildings like gyms. Many times this department also provides programs for people to learn more about different types of recreation.

Every state has a recreation department, too. State park services operate parks for people to enjoy. The United States has also made opportunities for its citizens to enjoy recreation. Certain areas of national land can only be used for recreation such as hiking, camping, fishing and hunting. This recreational land cannot be used for homes or businesses.

In this issue you are going to learn more about the ways communities met people's needs for recreation in the past. You are going to learn about opportunities for recreation now and in the possible future. Who knows, someday we may all be way too busy to use television as recreation!

title: Lack of Recreation is a "Weighty" Issue
text:
Recreational activities are enjoyable. But did you know they also protect your health? It's true. Recreation gives people a chance to exercise their bodies. Daily exercise helps people control their weight. Many children in America are not choosing recreational activities that provide exercise. That is leading to a very heavy problem.

In America today, millions of children over the age of six are considered obese. This means they are very overweight. The number of obese children who are 6-11 years old nearly tripled between 1980 and 2010. Unfortunately, this number is rising. Children who are overweight can get sick. They may become unhealthy adults, too. There are several reasons for this trend.

More and more kids today are choosing recreational activities that don't involve aerobic activity. This means they are choosing to spend their free time watching television, playing video games and playing on the computer. They are not getting enough exercise, so body weight becomes a problem.

Many communities are trying to find ways to help their children lose weight and get healthy. Community programs are encouraging kids to eat better. Schools are serving healthier lunches. More parks, playgrounds and swimming pools are being built. They want children to enjoy exercise. Some communities are even offering classes to help teach children and their parents how to live a healthier life. Working together, they are making a difference.

title: People in Communities Want to Have Fun!
text:
People need recreation time. It is a way to relax and spend time with family members and friends. Today, communities try to provide many opportunities for their citizens to enjoy free time. Here are a few examples of different types of recreational activities that can be found in communities across America.

Community Parks

As communities were settled in America over the last two centuries, leaders quickly realized there needed to be places for citizens to rest and relax. The park was born. Early parks were places where families could walk and take carriage rides. They were places where people could see the beauty of nature.

The open land of the park was often in the center of the community. This way everyone could reach it easily. As people enjoyed the parks, the parks grew. Today, almost every community has a park. Many communities have several parks. Citizens can enjoy the space every day.

Many parks have water features, such as ponds or fountains. Parks for young children often are filled with playground equipment. Walking and jogging paths provide places for exercise. Many parks even have equipment and activities for disabled people to enjoy. These parks are becoming more and more common in communities.

Aquatic Centers

People enjoy relaxing by a pool on a hot day. Many people enjoy getting their day's exercise by swimming laps. For these reasons many communities now operate aquatic centers for their citizens.

These centers often include indoor and outdoor swimming pools. Wading pools and water playgrounds are also found in many centers. Here, the people of the community can swim and enjoy a day of fun together. Of course, swimming pools provide relief from heat on a hot summer day, too.

Workers make sure the swimming centers are clean and safe. That way citizens won't get ill from swimming in water that is dirty or untreated. Communities must also provide trained people to work at the centers. All pools are protected by lifeguards who can handle emergencies. Many of these lifeguards also teach swimming and water exercise classes to citizens.

Golf and Tennis

Communities try very hard to provide recreation for citizens of all ages. Some sports can be played and enjoyed by everyone. Golf courses and tennis courts are very popular in communities. Everyone from kids to senior citizens can play golf and tennis. Many communities even have professional players who give lessons.

In many communities golf and tennis tournaments are very popular. In these events many people play against one another. Sometimes they play for prizes. Other times people just play for the right to say they won. Many community organizations raise money by charging admission to the competitions.

Recreation Centers

Communities want to have many different activities for people to enjoy. Recreation centers are operated by community employees. Many of these centers offer classes in martial arts, dance, boxing and gymnastics. People might even enjoy playing card and board games.

Many of these centers offer daycare for children so that parents have a safe place to take their kids while they exercise and have fun. This often includes after-school care for older kids. In the summer, many centers offer day camps for children where kids can enjoy classes and special field trips.

Many communities offer special recreation centers for senior citizens. While most of the people who spend time at the center might be grandparents, they still stay active. They enjoy the same types of activities as the younger citizens do - just at their own speed.

Youth Sports Programs

Communities want to help keep kids fit. This is why youth sports organizations are so popular. Kids can choose to learn and play many sports. Today soccer, baseball, softball, basketball and flag football are just some of the choices.

Volunteers work with children to teach them the basics of the game. In addition, kids learn what it’s like to play on a team. They must play by the rules and be good sports. It is a great opportunity for children of a community to get exercise and spend time with friends.

Arts and Museums

Not every recreational activity must be exercise. Most people need to enjoy their free time in other ways, too. This is why many communities support museums and other centers for the arts.

Art museums are very popular in many communities. Here citizens may enjoy works that have been created by artists. Many museums even offer classes for people to learn how to create art of their own.

Music and drama are also part of the arts programs in communities. School and professional groups often present orchestra and band concerts. Plays and musical dramas in communities often star local townspeople.

title: Juliette Gordon Low
text:
Have you ever heard of Juliette Gordon Low? She was from Savannah, Georgia, and she founded the Girl Scouts of America in 1912. She wanted to teach young women to be responsible and to be strong leaders. She believed that girls should be active citizens in their communities. The first Girl Scout troop was a group of 18 girls from Savannah.

Juliette Gordon Low died in 1927 at her home in Savannah and was buried in her Girl Scout uniform. In her pocket was a telegram that read, "You are not only the first Girl Scout, you are the best Girl Scout of them all!" All the Girl Scouts in Savannah lined the streets to say good-bye to this great woman who inspired each of them to be great women, too.

title: Friendliness
text:
You know, just being friendly can make the difference between a bad day and a good day. The United States is home to some of the friendliest people around. Maybe that's why America has so many good days.

Friendliness can turn driving in a car, riding on a bus or taking a walk in your neighborhood into a pleasant memory all its own. Friendliness can make someone glad you were the one who answered the phone.

Of course, some people choose to be unfriendly most of the time, but why would you want to do that? After all, you hardly ever hear anyone say, "I just love coming over for a visit. You're all so nice and grumpy!"

Make friendliness one of your character traits, and anyone who ever visits you will go away feeling warm.

title: What is the difference between a lake and a reservoir?
text:
Lakes and reservoirs are both bodies of water. People use both of them for recreation. Many people enjoy boating, skiing, swimming and fishing in lakes and reservoirs. Both can also supply drinking water to communities.

The big difference in the two is how they are made. Natural lakes are formed by volcano eruptions, glaciers and movement of the Earth's crust. Reservoirs are formed by people. They are built when people build dams to hold back and store water along a river. Water in the reservoirs can also be used to help create electrical power.

title: The Nation's First Park
text:
For many people, visiting a park is the perfect recreation. People like to picnic, hike, explore and enjoy nature. At Yellowstone National Park, the first national park in the United States, everyone can do these things and much more. The park was created in 1872. It covers land in Idaho, Wyoming and Montana. The U.S. Congress set aside Yellowstone as a national park. President Grant signed the law. The land will forever be protected.

People can enjoy seeing many types of animals at Yellowstone National Park. Grizzly bears, wolves, bison and elk roam freely. For many people, the highlight of a trip to the park is Old Faithful. This is a natural underground geyser, which sprays fountains of boiling hot water high into the air right on cue, about every 90 minutes. Visitors can also enjoy seeing nature at its finest. Hot springs, thick green trees and plenty of wildflowers are everywhere.

With all this beauty, it's no wonder thousands of people from all over the world travel to Yellowstone National Park each year to marvel in its wonder. Now that's recreation!

title: Bar Graphs
text:
You have read about many types of recreational activities that are available for citizens. You learned national parks provide recreation outdoors. Did you know there are other national sites for people to enjoy? The government protects these sites. Homes and businesses cannot be built on the land. The area will be available for people to enjoy for many years to come.

Below is a bar graph showing information about different types of national sites. This graph is a special type of illustration. It will help you understand information, or data, easily.

title: What Makes a Community?
text:
Think about the things you and your family do each day. You begin your day at home. You go to school. Your parents go to work. Your family might go shopping for groceries. Perhaps you belong to a sports team or club. You probably practice or attend meetings from time to time. You might get the chance to play in the park once in a while. You always end up back home each evening.

Kinds of Communities

You and your family do all these things within your community. A community is a place where people live, work and play together. There are many different types of communities of many different sizes in Texas. The way people live usually depends on the type of community in which they choose to live.

Do you live in a community where there are lots of businesses in tall buildings and many workers hurrying around? If so, you probably live in an urban community. These communities are usually large cities with many people living in them.

If you live near, but not in, a large city, you might live in a suburb. A suburb is a community that is smaller than a city. Many people today live in suburbs and commute, or travel, to their jobs in the nearby city.

Maybe your community is very small. Perhaps many of the people in your area live on farms that are spread across open land. If so, you live in a rural community. Rural communities usually have fewer people living in them than in other communities.

Why People Live in Communities

Suppose you had to choose a new community in which to live. How would you make your choice? People want to feel safe in the place where they live. They want to feel safe when they go to work and school each day. Knowing the community's police and fire departments will be there to help them in an emergency helps them feel safe.

People also choose where they live because they have a job in the community. People must work to make money to take care of their families, so having a job in the community is important.

No matter what type of community you live in, there are neighbors. All people in communities have to work to get along with the other people in the community. People in communities must be respectful of their neighbors and their neighbors' cultures in order for the community to continue to be safe and peaceful. And a peaceful community is certainly a happy one!

title: Technology Communities of the 21st Century
text:
Is it possible to belong to several communities? It is if you’re talking about the new communities of the 21st century. Computers and other technology have changed the way people think about the word community. Today, people can be members of many different internet communities at the same time.

The internet is the network of computers that are linked worldwide. People can use the internet from almost anywhere in the world. They can communicate with anyone else on the planet who has a computer that is also connected to the World Wide Web, another name for the internet.

Just like in real communities, people who share common interests can get together in internet communities. These communities are called virtual communities. Many people in virtual communities email each other or have video chats. Some write blogs, or online journals, about certain topics. Some people play online games with people all over the world. Many people belong to several virtual communities because they have many different interests or hobbies.

There can be some problems with internet communities. Online activities might keep people from interacting, or working with, people in their real communities. People must also be sure they never give out personal information like their full names and addresses in online communities. This helps keep everyone safe.

How will communication methods change as the century continues? It will be exciting to see!

title: Communities Adapt to Climates
text:
Climate vs. Weather

In Texas there is a saying everyone knows. "If you don't like the weather outside, just wait a minute!" The weather in our state can change very quickly.

Texas is known for its unpredictable weather. One minute it can be hot and dry. The next minute it can be pouring down a cold rain. Texas is a very large state. There may be several types of weather happening at the same time in different parts of the state.

Weather is the daily outdoor conditions of a community. Meteorologists are scientists who study weather patterns and make predictions about daily weather. They tell people about the temperature, rainfall and wind conditions they will probably see each day.

Meteorologists also help communities understand their climates. Climate is different from daily weather. Climate is the type of weather a place usually has over a long period of time. Climate describes how warm, cold, dry, wet, windy or calm an area is most of the time. Parts of Texas, especially in the west, receive very little rain during the year. These areas have a dry climate. Other parts of the state receive a great deal of rainfall. These areas, mostly in the eastern part of the state, have a wet climate.

People must adapt to the climate. They must change the ways they live, dress and make their living in the community based on the climate there. For example, people who live in the north must dress much warmer in winter than people who live in southern communities. That's because the climate in the north is usually cooler. People who live in the southern parts of Texas can make a living growing citrus fruits. The warmer climate in their communities makes this possible. Many areas of Texas have a warm, dry climate year round. People from all over the world enjoy visiting and taking vacations in these communities.

Weather Warnings

Even though there are many different climate regions in Texas, all people must know about some types of weather that can be dangerous.

Tornadoes

Tornadoes are strong storms. They are spinning winds shaped like a cone. These storms happen during thunderstorms. Cool air sinks to the ground and collides with warm air moving upwards. The air begins spinning faster and faster. Some tornado winds can move up to 300 miles per hour! Tornadoes can occur in any part of the state. They can happen at any time of the year. Many communities have sirens to warn citizens of a tornado.

Hurricanes

Strong storms can also form over the ocean. These storms can cause heavy rain and high winds. This type of storm is a hurricane. Communities near an ocean are the ones most often hit by a hurricane. Rain from the storm may cause flooding. Communities near oceans have plans that citizens must follow to remain safe if a hurricane is near.

Floods

Thunderstorms can cause a lot of rain. If too much rain falls in a short period of time, flooding can occur. Floods are caused when water covers land that is usually dry. Sometimes storms produce so much rain that water covers cars and homes. Communities where floods often happen have systems in place to protect people and homes as much as possible.

Blizzards

During cold winter months, severe storms can produce snow. When a heavy snow is blown by high winds, it is called a blizzard. Most blizzards happen in northern communities, especially the ones near mountains. Driving a car in a blizzard is very dangerous, so it’s best to stay home. Communities must be prepared to make sure the roads are safe for emergency vehicles like fire trucks and police cars if this kind of storm happens.

title: Hurricane Helpers
text:
Aug. 28, 2005, is a day the people of New Orleans, Louisiana, will never forget. It was the day Hurricane Katrina struck their city. The storm changed their lives. It brought high winds and heavy rain. The people knew the storm was coming. Many people left the city to go to safer places. Some people stayed home. They hoped the storm was not going to be as bad as everyone thought. It was a terrible storm. Many people were killed by floods after the heavy rain. Homes and businesses in the community were destroyed or damaged badly.

After the storm, the citizens of New Orleans had a big decision to make. Should the city be rebuilt? Should the people move to new places that would be safer from hurricanes? Most citizens decided to stay and rebuild their lives.

Many people came together to help the community. First, the city had to be cleaned. It was a lot of hard work. People worked together to get safe drinking water back into homes. Temporary homes were brought to the city for the people to live in until their homes were rebuilt.

Even though everyone worked hard to make the city clean and safe again, some people were upset. They felt some of the city's problems could have been avoided. Dams that were supposed to protect the city from floodwater had not worked properly during the storm. The citizens decided to study the dams and rebuild them properly. This way the city will be better protected from another storm.

title: Natural Disasters: Volcanoes, Hurricanes and Earthquakes
text:
You've probably heard the term "natural disaster," but what does it mean? A natural disaster is something terrible that happens because of an event in nature. Natural disasters almost always affect the people who live through them and sometimes even change the shape of the land.

Both Hawaii and Alaska have active volcanoes. You might think of a volcano as a mountain with a hole on the top. In the hole, there is a pool of melted rock called magma. When the pressure of the magma gets too high, it erupts. Lava gasses and liquid rock shoot into the air. After the lava falls to the ground, it cools and hardens to create new landforms.

You've probably heard of or even been in a hurricane. Hurricanes are tropical storms that rotate in a counterclockwise direction. They can form in the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean Sea, Atlantic Ocean or Pacific Ocean. These storms produce heavy rain, strong winds and large waves when they come on shore. Hurricanes can cause flooding and wind damage to the coast and nearby areas.

An earthquake is a powerful natural disaster that causes the Earth to shake. This happens when two pieces of the Earth shift underground. Sometimes an earthquake causes a tsunami (large ocean wave caused by a shift in the ocean floor). Tsunamis can cause much damage and have sometimes killed hundreds or thousands of people. Most tsunamis happen in the area of the Pacific Ocean known as the "Ring of Fire."

title: Wacky Weather
text:
No matter how hard meteorologists try, they just can’t predict every weather event. Some pretty wacky weather happens on our planet, even here in Texas!

A sun dog is a bright spot or spots that appear in the sky near the sun. Sun dogs look like large, shiny stars. There may also be a small patch of rainbow nearby. You’ll see sun dogs only when light from the sun hits ice crystals in certain types of clouds.

Since you live in Texas, you’ve probably been in a loud thunderstorm. But a thundersnow storm doesn’t come along very often. In a regular thunderstorm, warm air rises and bumps into colder air. This unstable air and moisture mix to create a thunderstorm. A thunderstorm has high clouds, rain, lightning, thunder and strong winds. The lightning and thunder happen when electrical charges build up from ice particles bumping into each other. In snowstorms, the clouds are usually lower. Even so, the electrical charge can build up in the clouds and cause lightning and thunder as it snows. It’s just not very common!

A waterspout is like a tornado over water. You can see the funnel shape as it moves across a lake or ocean. Sometimes the waterspouts are simply tornadoes that form on the water. The funnel drops down from storm clouds. Other times, the weather is very calm, and the funnel will start at the surface of the water. It “grows” up in the air. These types of waterspouts usually don’t last long on land. Have you heard someone say that it was “raining cats and dogs”? Well, stories have been told about it raining fish and frogs. These poor creatures may have been picked up by a waterspout! Be on the lookout for these and other wacky weather events.

title: The Nature of Natural Resources
text:
Look around your classroom. What things do you use each day that came from nature? Your books are made of paper. Paper comes from trees. Pencils come from trees, too. Some of the clothes you are wearing started out as plants like cotton. Even the wooden desks and tables came from nature. Nature also gives us the air and water we need to keep us alive. There are many things in nature that are helpful to people.

Natural resources are things from nature people need and use. People in all communities depend on natural resources. These resources can give us materials or energy. Plants give us materials that can be used for food, clothing, shelter and medicine. We use wood to build houses, and we grow fruits and vegetables to eat. Nature also gives us many types of energy - sunlight, wind, water and fuels taken from the Earth like oil and natural gas. Minerals are natural resources, too. Minerals come from the Earth, but they are not plants or animals. People use minerals like salt, iron, coal and aluminum every day.

Communities need natural resources to survive. Each community has its own natural resources. People in the communities must use their resources wisely. Sometimes people must change the way they live because of the resources they have or need. When they do that, we say they are adapting to their environment. Recycling is an example of how people have changed the way they live. It saves resources like trees and metals, and it keeps some trash out of landfills.

Earth's resources help us in many ways. Without them, life would be very difficult or even impossible. This week you will learn about the kinds of resources we find in nature. You will learn how people use and take care of these resources in their communities. And you will find out why it's important for people to use these natural resources wisely - our lives depend on them!

title: Texans Step Back in Time to Save Natural Resources
text:
Did you know that Texans throw away enough trash to fill the Houston Astrodome in just 10 days? Most of the trash we throw away is paper, plastic and metals. The bad news is throwing away this much trash is harmful to Earth, and it wastes natural resources. The good news is some of this trash can be recycled and used again. People in Odessa, Texas, are making some good news in their community.

The Odessa Time Machine Recycling Center is open all year. It's called the Time Machine because the people of Odessa are hoping that recycling can help make the Earth as healthy as it was long ago. It helps people in the community find ways to use and save their natural resources. People can bring paper, plastic and metals to the center. The materials are recycled, and they can be used to make other things people need. Recycling saves water, trees and electricity.

The Time Machine also helps people find places to dispose of (get rid of) things like motor oil, paint and dangerous chemicals. Keeping these items out of landfills protects the Earth and the water we drink.

The recycling center plans special events for the people in the community. They teach the people about taking care of Earth's natural resources. They offer exciting contests and fun classes for the citizens.

Does your community have a recycling center like the Time Machine? If everyone recycles, we can help take care of Earth's natural resources and keep our planet healthy. That's just what the people of Odessa are doing!

title: Resources: Renewable and Nonrenewable
text:
Natural resources come from nature. They are things we need and use that come from the Earth. There are two kinds of natural resources - renewable and nonrenewable resources. People in communities use both.

Renewable Resources

Some natural resources can be replaced after they are used. These renewable resources include water, wind, sunlight and trees. Sometimes these things are replaced by nature. Sometimes people in communities must plan ways to help replace these resources.

Trees are a renewable resource. Communities cut down trees to use for wood. The wood is used to build homes and businesses. It is also used for many other items such as paper. When a tree is cut down, it is gone forever. But when a new tree is planted in its place, there will be wood again one day. In this way the community helps protect the resources.

People in communities need energy. Some energy sources are renewable. These are good for a community because they can be replaced easily. Communities are always looking for ways to use sunlight, wind and water to produce the energy they need. There are good things and bad things about using each of these types of energy.

Energy from Sunlight

Solar panels capture energy from sunlight. The energy from the sun gets changed into other types of energy. This energy can be used to power homes, businesses and even some cars. Solar energy can be difficult to use, because the sun doesn't shine every day. On cloudy or rainy days, it's hard to replace solar energy.

Energy from Wind

Wind is moving air. Because the wind blows every day, wind is a renewable resource. Wind can be used to move machines called turbines, which make electricity. These machines do not pollute the air. Some people don't like the way the machines make their communities look.

Energy from Water

Water is often used to make energy. Today communities build dams so they can use water power to help make electricity. This type of energy is very clean. It does not pollute the environment. It is also very cheap for communities. However, building a dam can destroy animal habitats and can sometimes make flooding worse.

Nonrenewable Resources

Resources that can't be replaced are called nonrenewable resources. When these resources are gone, they might as well be gone forever. It would take millions of years for the Earth to make them again.

Fuels like natural gas, coal and oil are nonrenewable. These resources formed in the Earth over millions of years. They cannot be replaced because it takes too long for them to form. Communities must use these resources carefully and not waste them. Minerals in the Earth such as copper, iron and gold cannot be replaced either. People must be careful about how they use them, so they last as long as possible.

Some nonrenewable resources are not destroyed when they are used. People can find ways to reuse or recycle them. Aluminum is a good example. Recycling one aluminum soda can saves enough energy to operate your television set for three hours!

title: Trees - America's Great Renewable Natural Resource
text:
Can you think of all the things that come from trees? You probably thought of wood for homes and buildings. Maybe you thought about paper and pencils. You might have even thought about fruits like apples and cherries. But did you think of medicine, baby food, toothpaste and football helmets? Probably not, but all of these items are made from trees!

Trees are important to communities. They provide shade, beauty and a home for many animals. Trees give us food like fruit and nuts. Many tree products are used to make things people use every day. The list of these items is almost endless. The best thing about trees is they are a renewable resource. This means they can be replaced.

Cutting down trees without planting enough new ones causes problems. This could cause a scarcity of tree products. Scarcity means that there is not enough of something. Not planting enough new trees could mean there will not be enough wood, paper and fruit for people to use. When that happens, prices go up.

Communities work to protect trees. Many groups organize tree-planting days. The trees they plant help the community in many ways. Some communities hold classes to teach everyone how to take care of the trees that are already in the community. Tree experts go to schools to teach children how to protect trees. There are even laws in some cities to protect trees from being cut down.

If people work together to take care of trees, there will be plenty of this natural resource for years to come.

title: Milton Hershey
text:
Did you know that when you eat a Hershey’s Kiss® it’s like eating a piece of history? It all started with a man named Milton Hershey. Milton was born on September 13, 1857, in Pennsylvania. When Milton was 15, he worked at a candy shop. He tried and tried to master the art of candy making and finally figured it out. After many tries, Milton started his own candy business, called the Lancaster Carmel Company. It wasn’t until after he attended the World’s Columbian Exposition in Chicago in 1893 that he became interested in chocolate. The Hershey’s chocolate recipe starts with an important natural resource found in Brazil and Indonesia called the cocoa bean. Milton made batch after batch of chocolate until he finally mastered his recipe. In 1900, America enjoyed the first Hershey’s Milk Chocolate® bar. Seven years later, the first Hershey’s Kiss® was made.

Milton Hershey did much more than just own a chocolate factory. He created a whole town around it. The town, named Hershey, is located in Pennsylvania. It included churches, parks, an amusement park and even its own trolley system. It also had many schools. Education was very important to Milton because he didn't have much education. He wanted to share his success and help kids learn. Milton Hershey died in 1945, but we still remember him. Hershey, Pennsylvania, is still a popular place to live. Because of Milton's kindness, the town was able to build a world-class hospital in 1967. Hershey's Chocolate World® is a favorite place for families to visit. There you can learn more about the Hershey Company or even create your own candy bar! So, when you take the next bite of Hershey's chocolate, remember Milton Hershey and all he has done for the "World of Chocolate."

title: What is a fossil fuel?
text: A fossil fuel is a nonrenewable energy source buried inside the Earth. Fossils are the remains of plants and animals that died long ago. Fossil fuels are made when the remains of these dead plants and animals build up over time underground. Heat and pressure cause the plant and animal materials to change. It takes millions of years for this to happen. Fossil fuels can be solid (coal), liquid (oil) or gas (natural gas). We use them to heat our homes and to make gasoline for our cars. When fossil fuels are burned, they give off gases that can pollute the environment.

title: Respect
text:
Have you ever heard your parents or teachers talk about respect? What does it mean? When you respect someone, you treat that person with kindness and you show that you care about the person's feelings. Respect is an important quality to have and practice everyday.

American families come from many different places and have different beliefs and traditions. It is important to respect the beliefs and traditions of others, even if they are not the same as yours.

You should also respect yourself. Having self-respect helps you see the good things about yourself. When you respect yourself, it is easier for you to show respect to others. For example, when you feel good about yourself, you are happy and treat others kindly. Respecting yourself also means admitting when you do something wrong and learning from your mistakes.

Respect also means honoring and appreciating another person for who they are. If you are working at a homeless shelter, you show respect for the people who are in that situation by treating them kindly.

There are many places to show respect. Home and school are just two. Can you think of other places where it's important to show respect? Can you think of other people you should respect besides your friends, family and teachers?

title: A Busy Day on the Farm
text:
The sun was warm on Mason's back. He'd been in the fields for hours now, helping his dad prepare for planting. There was a lot of work to be done. It was Mason's job to help his dad make sure there were no rocks or weeds in the fields. His dad was letting him help fertilize and plant the corn this year, too.

Once the corn came up, there would be even more hard work for him to do. The weeds had to be kept out of the fields, and the corn had to be watered so it would stay healthy. Mason hoped the weather would be good so the crop would be good.

They didn't always grow corn. Sometimes they grew soybeans or other crops. Dad said rotating, or switching, the crops helped the soil stay healthy.

Mason grinned as he looked at his hard work. It had taken a long time, but the fields were ready for the corn now. His dad put his hand on Mason's shoulder and smiled.

"Good work, Mason," he said.

Mason knew the farm would be his one day. It had belonged to his great-grandfather, then his grandfather, and now it was his dad's. Mason wanted to learn all he could about the farm. Mason was proud his family grew things other people needed.

The money from the crop paid the bills and helped with everything the family needed. It seemed like Mason and his sister always needed new clothes or things for school. And the family had to buy the food they couldn't grow on the farm. It also took money to keep the farm running. A good harvest would give them the money they needed for everything.

His parents were hoping to make enough money to buy a new combine harvesting machine. It would make the job of harvesting, or gathering, the crops much easier. Mason knew he had a lot to learn about the farm. There were new machines to study. There were special methods of planting he still had to learn. Most of all, Mason knew he had to learn how to run the farm as a business. He wanted to be sure he learned everything about how to sell the crops. Then, one day, he could pass the farm on to his son.

title: What a Piggy Bank!
text:
Do you have a piggy bank at home? How much money do you think is in someone's piggy bank? If you think a few dollars worth of coins might be hiding inside one of these, then hold onto your hats.

A type of Viking piggy bank called a bucket has been found on the Swedish Island of Gotland in the Baltic Sea. An archaeologist found it using a metal detector. Other treasures from Viking times had been found on the island, including a treasure of almost 6,000 coins discovered during the 1880s. Well, when people know treasure could be buried somewhere, then they hunt for themselves! The Gotland county administrative board decided that they had better find whatever Viking treasure might still be on the island before treasure hunters looted any more of it. What they found has been described as "fantastic" by Swedish archaeologists.

Buried about 12 inches under the ground, they found a bronze bucket from the Viking era filled to the brim with silver coins. The bucket is about nine inches wide by seven inches deep, and archaeologists think it contains thousands of coins. They think the coins were probably minted in Germany between 1000 and 1040 C.E. The archaeologists estimate that just one of the coins could be worth hundreds of U.S. dollars. The scientists plan to study the treasure even more to unravel more secrets from the past!

title: Living in a Free Market Economy
text:
A Free Market Economy

In the last week, what things did you and your family buy? Groceries? A new pair of shoes? Movie tickets? Maybe you stopped for ice cream on the way home from school one day or ate dinner in a restaurant.

Have you had a haircut recently? Maybe you’ve been to the doctor or dentist. Perhaps your parents have had the car washed or the lawn mowed.

If you have bought or sold any good or service, you are part of our country’s economy. The economy is the way a country makes and uses money, goods, services and natural resources. In the United States, people have the right to choose what products and services they will buy or sell. We live in a free market economy.

In a free market economy, people can choose to run any type of business they wish. Business owners have the right to decide how they want to sell their products and how much money they want to charge for their goods or services. Businesses can advertise to attract consumers. Then these buyers and sellers can agree on a price that will be paid for the good or service.

In our country’s free market economy, the government does not get too involved in the buying and selling process. The government does, however, set a tax to be paid for most goods and services that are sold. Government leaders also work to make sure companies are run fairly.

Supply and Demand

The most important thing about a free market is that the government does not set prices for goods and services. The buyer and seller agree on a price. However, many things can affect that agreement.

The supply of a good or service is the total amount that is available for purchase. Many things can change the supply. One thing that may change supply is the demand for the good or service. Demand is how many people want the good or service that is available.

Many goods and services are always in demand. Food products, such as fruits and vegetables, are needed at all times. The demand for these products does not change often. There are generally plenty of these items for sale. This means that the prices for the products often are stable, which means they don't change much.

Supply and demand can bring about changes in prices. For example, if bad weather destroyed the orange crop in Florida, there would be a scarcity, or shortage, of oranges at the grocery store. People would still want to buy oranges, but there would be fewer oranges for sale. There would not be enough supply to meet the demand. The price of oranges would increase.

Supply and demand can also cause prices to decrease. Study this example. One sneaker company produced many pairs of sneakers with a movie logo design on them. But the movie wasn't very good, and kids didn't want to wear the shoes. The company had a large supply of the shoes, but the public was not demanding to buy them. The company had to lower the price of the shoes in order to sell them all. Understanding the free market system of our economy is important. You will be better able to make decisions about the goods and services you buy and sell. You will be able to make good choices for your family and be a better citizen.

title: Technology and the Free Market
text:
For thousands and thousands of years, people have bought and sold goods and services. The ways in which these goods and services are exchanged has not stayed the same. Today technology is changing the way people exchange goods and services. Much of the free market economy in the United States is now based on the internet. In ancient times, people who needed goods or services worked with other people who wanted to supply the goods or services. Together they agreed upon a price. Sometimes money was exchanged. Other times goods and services were traded for other goods and services. This bartering system still exists today.

Exchanging goods and services soon grew to include markets. In these early markets, people who wanted to sell goods or provide services set up shop in a common area. People from surrounding areas came to do business.

In America, many people think of large shopping malls when they consider free trade. In these large shopping areas, people can buy and sell all types of things. At the Mall of America in Bloomington, Minnesota, shoppers can purchase clothes, shoes, books, electronics, furniture and sports equipment. Consumers can also buy food or get a haircut. They can even go to the eye doctor or ride on a roller coaster.

In the last 20 years, technology has changed greatly. Most homes in America now have a computer with internet access. People who have a good or service to offer can set up a “store” online. Millions of people shop in the online stores each day. Websites such as eBay offer a place where people can easily look for goods and services. Almost any good or service imaginable can be found on the internet. You can find airline tickets, clothing, medical advice and even groceries online.

Online education is becoming more and more popular. Some students in our country attend online schools from home. Some of those students might be learning about our free market economy right now!

title: Government Rules Affect What We Pay
text:
There are many laws and rules in our country, our state and our cities. Many laws help keep us safe. Many laws help keep order in our communities. But did you know that some laws affect how much we pay for the things we buy? It's true!

Have you noticed that when you go to the grocery store there are two sections of produce: organic and non-organic? Organic fruits and vegetables usually cost more than non-organic produce. Why do you think this is true? The government has set up regulations (rules) farmers must follow to label their food organic. Farmers can't use pesticides (chemicals used to kill bugs), herbicides (chemicals used to kill weeds) or add anything to the food to change its color or flavor. Farmers have to work extra hard to keep insects and weeds out of their farms. They may even have to hire people to help them. Organic farmers usually aren't able to farm as much land as other farmers do. Instead of using chemical fertilizers (things that help plants grow faster), they use natural fertilizers. All of these rules make the cost of organic fruits and vegetables go up.

Another government rule is that we must pay a tax on items that we buy. When you buy a toy for $5, the store will also charge a sales tax. The toy will cost you a little bit more because of this tax. The tax money you pay helps your community and our great state of Texas.

title: How do consumers make good decisions?
text:
Each day people must make decisions about what goods or services they will buy. Most people want to spend their money wisely. They want to feel good about the things they buy. Sometimes the decision is easy. Other times the choice is a bit more difficult. Consumers, or people who use goods and services, must think carefully before spending money. Thinking about each choice carefully can help you make the right decision about a good or service.

Before spending money on a good or service ask yourself the following questions:

Why do I need this?

If you can't answer this question, it is probably something you want rather than need. Think carefully about whether you really should spend your money.

What do I know about the product or service?

If you don’t know a lot about it, you might want to gather more information before making a final purchase. Will the good or service really be what you need? Should you do more research?

What other choices do I have?

If there are other choices, you should see what they are. There might be a better product or price out there.

What will happen if I don't buy this? What will happen if I do buy this and it isn't what I expected?

Taking the time to ask these two questions will help you be confident of your decision. Sometimes it helps to talk these questions over with a grown-up. Good consumers usually ask their family and friends about products or services they have used. They might be able to tell you about their experiences. Then you will be able to begin making your choice. Once you have thought your decision through, you will be ready to make your purchase.

title: Sequential Information
text:
Read the story about a shopping trip Chris and Kasey take with their mother. Complete the graphic organizer showing the order of the story’s main events. Read the story again. Circle all of the items from the story that would be considered “goods.” Underline each “service” mentioned in the story. Use information from the story to fill in the empty boxes. Be sure to write a complete sentence in each box.

Shopping for Sara

Chris and Kasey woke up early Saturday. They were very excited. Today was the day their mother was going to take them on a special shopping trip. They were going to go buy a new pet.

At the pet shop, the sisters looked at puppies. They finally decided on a small white terrier. They both decided to name the puppy Sara. Now they had to get a few things Sara would need in her new home.

The girls put a soft puppy bed in the basket. They put food and water bowls in too. Finally, they decided on a pink collar for Sara’s neck. They hurriedly checked out at the cash register. As they walked out of the store, Chris saw an advertisement on the wall. It was for a dog washing company. It wouldn’t be long before Sara would need a bath.

On the way home, they stopped at the veterinarian’s office. Dr. Tyler examined Sara and said she was one healthy dog. The girls knew that by the way Sara was wagging her tail!

title: Mr. La's Big Dream
text:
Hung La hurried to the glass door and turned the sign over. Now the word "OPEN" was facing the street for everyone to see. Mr. La reached up and adjusted the wire-rimmed glasses sitting on his nose. A big smile spread across his face. Today the restaurant was open at last. His big dream, or "giấc mơ lớn" as his mother used to say, was coming true.

Taking a deep breath, Mr. La moved back towards the counter where he and his wife would be taking orders from customers. The smell of vegetables cooking in tasty sauces filled the air. It would not be long before customers sat in the chairs inside Mr. La's restaurant. He couldn't wait to see people enjoying the delicious foods of his homeland. Everyone should like the sticky rice and sweet and sour noodles. All of their friends said Mrs. La's recipes were the best.

Mr. La sat quietly and thought back to all the years he had worked to own his own restaurant. He had been only nine years old when he arrived in America from Vietnam with his family. His mother and father wanted to have a better life in a free country. Now Mr. La was opening his own business. This was exactly the kind of opportunity his parents wanted him to have.

Starting his own business had not been easy for Mr. La. He wanted to know how to run his business the right way. He had worked many long hours, done research and read lots of books. There was plenty of math, too. Mr. La had to make sure he had enough money to start his restaurant. He also had to calculate the supplies he would need each day. He was glad he had studied so hard in school. Mr. La felt prepared for the challenge.

Now there was nothing to do but wait for the first customer of the day. Today, Mr. La's big dream was going to come true at last.

title: Saving Pompeii
text:
In 79 C.E., a volcano in Italy called Mt. Vesuvius violently erupted. It sent poisonous gas and ash into the nearby town of Pompeii, and its extreme heat killed the people right away. After tons of ash and pumice (lightweight, gray stone) stopped falling on the town, it rained. Some think this mixture caused casts to form around the dead, and it preserved them for over 1,700 years. The town was buried under many feet of ash and pumice, and people forgot all about Pompeii until 1748, when archaeologists uncovered the site.

Since finding the site, archaeologists have dug through the ash and stone and studied the city. The ash preserved the city so well that it gives us a picture of what life was like in this Roman city at the time the volcano erupted.

Some people are upset that the site is not still being preserved. Some buildings have collapsed, such as the "House of Gladiators" that fell in 2010. Many people think the area is one of the world's greatest archaeological treasures. About 2.5 million people visit Pompeii each year, and Italy has given €105 million (or almost $140 million) to help restore and protect Pompeii. This is even when European countries are in debt, or owe money to other groups. Many countries, like Italy, are trying to pay off their debts, so it's hard to give money to these types of archaeology projects. However, many Italians feel that Pompeii is worth the cost.

title: Owning a Business Can Be a Rewarding Job
text:
People must work to make money. Money is used to pay for the things people need, such as homes, clothes and transportation. Some people choose to make money by owning and running their own business.

What is a Business?

A business is any activity that provides goods or services. There are many types of businesses. They all have some things in common, but they have differences too.

Some businesses are run completely by the owner without help from anyone else. These small businesses might even be in the owner’s home. Some businesses might run completely on the internet.

Some small businesses are run by the owner and just a few other people. According to the United States Small Business Administration, 99 out of 100 businesses in America are considered small businesses.

Other businesses have many people who help the owner every day. These businesses might have several places or buildings where people work running the company. Some businesses even have offices all over the world. These businesses are often called corporations. Most corporations are very large businesses with many people working there.

Employer or Employee?

People who get paid to help the business owner are called employees. An employee is paid with a salary. This money can be used by the employee to buy the goods and services they need. The salary is paid by the employer. Some business employers also provide their employees with benefits such as vacation days and health insurance.

Expenses and Profits

Businesses are designed to make money. It is important to know that not all of the money taken in by a business goes directly to the owner. There are expenses that must be paid first. Expenses are the costs of all the things a business needs to stay open. Salaries paid to employees are considered expenses. Electricity, rent and supplies are also examples of expenses. Most businesses need supplies to operate. These items are purchased, or bought, from a producer. A producer is any person, company or group that makes or creates something someone else needs. Items purchased from a producer are considered a business expense.

The amount of money left over after a business pays all of the expenses is called the profit. A simple math problem (shown at bottom left) can help you remember what expenses and profits are.

Businesses need profits. The profits allow the owner to improve or expand the business. Profits allow the business owners to buy other goods and services from producers. This is good for the economy.

All businesses are important to the economy of our nation for many reasons. Large and small businesses provide people with goods and services they want and need. These businesses also give people job opportunities.

Business owners work hard to make a profit. They try to make sure the consumers, people who buy the goods or services, are happy with their purchases. In our country, people have the freedom to choose what they would like to buy or sell. It is an important right that we have.

title: Teenagers in the Work Force
text:
Tens of millions of people in the United States work in many different types of jobs. All workers are important to our economy. Some of the most important employees are teenagers.

American teenagers work more during the summer than during the school year. They often work in stores and restaurants. The number of teenagers who work goes up and down with the economy. When unemployment is high, some adults take jobs that had often been filled by teenagers. That makes it harder for teens to get jobs. Working is a good experience for teenagers. Working lets teens earn spending money. It also gives them work experience and a chance to learn new skills. Teenagers can explore careers before deciding what they would like to do as an adult. Working also helps teenagers feel more confident and responsible.

Teen workers are critical, or very valuable, to the economy in the United States. Teenagers are often employed at jobs with lower pay. Many adults with families do not want to work at these jobs. They want to work at places where they can earn, or make, more money. Teens also work at jobs where there are many openings during the summer months.

Each state has laws about how old someone must be to work in different types of businesses. There are also laws about how many hours and times of the day teenagers can work. These laws are meant to protect teenagers and keep them safe on the job. Even if you still have a few years before you can get a job, it's always fun to start thinking about where you can work when you are a teenager.

title: Ray Kroc: The Man Who Turned Milk Shakes into Millions
text:
What restaurant do you think people all over the world recognize most often? If you thought about the bright golden arches of McDonald’s, you are right. But did you know that it all started with one man and a milkshake machine?

Ray Kroc sold milkshake makers. In fact, he had used his whole life’s savings to buy these machines. One day he visited a restaurant that used his machines. He thought the restaurant was doing a good job serving customers. Mr. Kroc talked to the owners, the McDonald brothers, about opening more restaurants like the one they already had. The McDonald’s we know and love today was born!

Kroc opened his first McDonald's restaurant in Des Plaines, Illinois, in 1955. Mr. Kroc worked hard to make his restaurant a success. He wanted all of his employees to be hard workers too. One of his favorite sayings was, "If you've got time to lean, you've got time to clean." The harder he worked, the larger the restaurant chain grew.

Over the next 50 years, McDonald's restaurants continued to grow. New food ideas were added to the menu. You've probably heard of the Happy Meal, right? Kroc and his employees always worked on having good service too.

Today the McDonald's Corporation has grown larger than Ray Kroc ever thought possible. There are more than 34,000 McDonald's restaurants around the world. You can eat a McDonald's meal in more than 100 countries. As a matter of fact, about 70 million people eat at a McDonald's restaurant somewhere in the world every day!

Ray Kroc's story is a good example of how it is possible to start small and make it big in American business.

title: What is a Free Enterprise system?
text: A Free Enterprise system is a type of economy. Because the United States has a Free Enterprise system, Americans have many freedoms. The government doesn’t tell citizens what color shirt or what kind of car to buy. We make those choices for ourselves. We do not need the government’s permission to work in a certain job. We have the freedom to open a business and decide how to run it. Imagine you run a pizza place in your town. One day, someone else opens a new pizza place. You may not be happy about that, but that person has the same freedom to open a business that you have. Having two pizza places in town creates competition. Both businesses will have to work hard to get customers. Many other countries in the world have a Free Enterprise system, but others have systems that do not give their citizens as much freedom.

title: See it, Want it and Buy it?
text:
Have you ever been excited about buying a new toy or video game? Lots of kids can't wait for new products to be sold in stores. When everyone wants a new toy, the demand is high. What happens to the price of the toy? It never goes on sale, does it? The stores keep charging full price because there are plenty of kids who are willing to buy it. But after a while, newer and better products are for sale. People stop buying the first toy. The product stays on the store shelf. The supply has increased. What happens to the price of the toy now that the demand is not as great? The toy goes on sale! The store wants to move the product off the shelves.

So the next time there's a new toy you want to own...wait a while. You might be glad you did!

title: Haym Salomon, Financial Hero
text:
In 1975, the U.S. Postal Service issued a stamp [right] honoring Haym Salomon as a "Financial Hero of the American Revolution," yet many Americans have never heard of him. Who was Haym Salomon?

Haym Salomon was a Jewish immigrant from Poland who came to New York City in 1772. He became a successful financial broker (someone who arranges business transactions). Salomon sided with the patriots and joined the Sons of Liberty. The British arrested him as a spy. In jail, he became an interpreter for German soldiers but secretly encouraged many to desert (leave the army). He was supposed to be executed, but he escaped. He set up a new business in Philadelphia.

Salomon could see that the Continental Congress was struggling to get money to support the war. American soldiers did not have enough pay, food or supplies. Salomon began raising money. He helped Robert Morris, the Superintendent of Finance, get loans from France and other countries. He often made personal loans to the government and to American leaders like James Madison, Thomas Jefferson and James Monroe. When George Washington needed money for the Battle of Yorktown, he said, "Send for Haym Salomon." Salomon's clear thinking, generosity and dedication helped our country win its independence.

The Treaty of Paris in 1783 ended the war, but the new country still had money problems. Salomon continued to help America raise money. He was also a strong leader in Philadelphia's Congregation Mikveh Israel. He worked to overturn a law that kept non-Christians from holding office.

Now that you have learned Haym Salomon's story, why do you think history has often overlooked him?

title: Minimum Wage
text:
Employees are paid a salary by their employers for the jobs they do. Many employees get paid for each hour of the day that is worked. Many states have laws that require employers to pay a minimum wage. This minimum wage is the smallest amount that can be paid by law for each hour an employee works.

The table below gives information about the minimum wage in several states in 2008. Answer the questions that follow on a separate sheet of paper. (You may need to do some extra research for the last two.) Then look up the minimum wage in those states today and create a new table. Write at least three questions about the table, and trade questions with a friend.

1. Which state required employees to receive the most per hour?

2. Which of these states had the lowest minimum wage?

3. What was the minimum wage in California?

4. How much greater was the minimum wage in Texas than in Wyoming?

5. Why do you think Washington had a higher minimum wage than other states on the list?

6. Why do you think Wyoming had a lower minimum wage than other states on the list?

title: Looking Back: Environment and Economy
text:
Climate and Communities

Texas weather can be very difficult to predict. Weather conditions can change quickly. Texas is also a very large state. There can be many weather patterns happening at one time in different areas. People in west Texas might be able to swim outside while people in east Texas need to wear coats and gloves. Scientists called meteorologists help people understand the weather each day. Meteorologists also help people understand the climate in their communities. Climate is the weather a place usually has over a long period of time.

Some parts of Texas have a dry climate. Other areas are said to have a wet climate. People must adapt to the climate. They must change the ways they live, dress and make their living. For example, people in the north part of Texas usually have to dress warmly in the winter. Large snowstorms, called blizzards, and low temperatures are likely. In the southern part of the state, farmers can grow citrus fruits. The climate is warm and wet in this area. Other parts of the state are drier or colder. Farmers must find ways to adapt to the climate if they want to be successful.

There are natural weather hazards in all areas of Texas. Strong windstorms called tornadoes can happen throughout the state. Hurricanes are strong storms that form over an ocean. High winds and flooding are often part of these storms. Communities must prepare for these natural emergencies.

Necessary Natural Resources

People in communities depend on natural resources. These are things from nature that people want or need. Natural resources give us materials or energy. These resources include materials that can be used for food, clothing, shelter, fuel and medicine. Without natural resources, life would be difficult. Sometimes people must change the ways they live in order to protect their resources. Recycling is a good example of this.

There are two kinds of natural resources. Communities depend on both kinds. Fossil fuels are nonrenewable resources. These fuels are energy sources buried deep inside the Earth. Heat and pressure created these resources over millions of years. Coal, oil and natural gas are used to heat homes and make gasoline for cars. Unfortunately, they can also create pollution. People must use these resources carefully. They must last as long as possible because they cannot be easily replaced. Some nonrenewable resources are not destroyed when they are used. Aluminum is a good example. It can be recycled and used again.

Renewable resources can be replaced after they are used. Water, wind, sunlight and trees are all renewable resources. It is good for a community to use these resources. They provide energy that people need without causing harm to the environment. Energy produced from sunlight, wind and water does not cause pollution.

Making Good Decisions

How many decisions will you make today? You had to decide what to wear to school. You chose what to eat for lunch. You might even decide if you should spend your allowance on a new toy. Tonight you will have to decide to either complete your homework or play video games. Life is full of decisions. Think carefully about the decisions, or choices, you make. One way to do this is to use a decision-making process.

First, you must think very carefully. Do you understand what your choices are?

Second, learn everything you can about your choices. Ask questions or do research.

Next, review all the possible decisions you could make. Sometimes it helps to make a list.

Then, think about what will happen to you and others if you make that decision. Some people think it helps to make a list of good and bad things that might happen for each choice.

Finally, make your decision and take action.

Think about this decision-making process the next time you face a difficult choice. It just might make things a bit easier.

title: Money Makes the World Go Around
text:
A Free Market Economy

Buying and selling goods and services are part of our country's economy. The economy is the way a country makes and uses goods, services, money and natural resources. People in the U.S. have the right to choose what products and services they will buy and sell. We live in a free market economy. People can operate almost any kind of business they like. It is important for people to understand the free market system. That way, people can make decisions about the goods and services they buy and sell. Families can make better choices about how to spend their money.

In a free market economy, business owners make decisions about the products they provide. Owners decide and advertise how much they want to charge consumers for goods and services. In a free market economy, the government does not get too involved in the buying and selling process. The government taxes most goods and services, though. Government leaders also make sure companies operate fairly.

Supply and Demand
