The government does not set prices for goods and services in a free market economy. The buyer and seller can decide on the price that will be paid. The price of almost all goods and services is based on supply and demand. Supply is the total amount of a good or service that is available for purchase. Demand is the total amount of a good or service that people want to buy.

Many goods and services are always in high demand. Food products are needed at all times. The demand is high and stays high. There is usually plenty of food for sale in grocery stores. This means the prices on most food items are stable. They don't change very much.

Supply and demand causes changes in prices, though. For example, let's think about cattle in Texas. If all the cattle get sick and many die, there would be a shortage of beef at the grocery store. This is called scarcity. People would still want to buy beef, but there would not be enough for their demand. The price of beef would increase at the market. What would happen to the price of a product if the demand was less than the supply? Of course, the price would drop, or decrease.

Be Your Own Boss

People work to make money. People must pay for the things they need. Homes, clothes, food and transportation cost money. Some people make their money by owning and operating a business. A business is any activity that provides goods or services. People who work for a business are known as employees. The owner is the employer.

There are different types of businesses. Today, people run many of these businesses completely online. An owner alone may run some companies. There are also businesses that the owner and just a few other people operate. These are known as small businesses. Most businesses in America fit into this category. Finally, there are businesses where many people help the owner. These businesses are large and often have many different offices. These large businesses are corporations.

Even though there are many different types of businesses, they all have one thing in common. They are designed to make money. Not all of the money goes directly to the owner, though. First, expenses must be paid. These are the costs of all the things a business needs to stay open. The amount of money that is used to produce and sell a product or service is an expense. Salaries that employees earn are expenses. Electricity, rent and supplies are also expenses. The money left over after all the expenses are paid is called the profit. The profit allows the owner to improve or expand the business. Profits are used to buy other goods and services from producers. If a business does not make a profit, it will not be successful.

Government Rules for Businesses

Communities need laws to keep order and safety. The government has laws that affect how much we pay for the goods and services that businesses produce. Some of these laws are to help the consumer. They protect people from unsafe goods. The government also has rules about the taxes we must pay for things we buy. The tax money pays for the services our local, state and national governments provide for citizens. However, if taxes rise, then so will the price of the goods and services.

title: Natural Disasters Shape the Landscape
text:
Natural disasters are terrible events that happen in nature. Volcanoes, hurricanes and earthquakes are all examples of natural disasters. These events affect people. People can be injured or killed. Natural disasters can also change the shape of the land.

When volcanoes erupt, liquid rock shoots into the air. New land is created when this lava cools and hardens. Hurricanes are tropical storms that form over oceans. Land can be worn and carried away by the flooding and high winds of these storms. Earthquakes can also change the land. The shifting earth might create mountains or valleys. Earthquakes can also cause tsunamis. These are large waves that cause flooding and damage to land and communities.

title: Selling for Success
text:
Have you made any trips to the candy store in the past year? Maybe you have enjoyed a creamy, chocolaty candy bar produced by the Hershey Chocolate Company. If so, then you are enjoying the success of entrepreneur Milton Hershey.

Mr. Hershey was born in Pennsylvania in the late 19th century. His mother taught him to work hard. He tried and failed many times to start a candy store. He never gave up, though. Finally, his Hershey chocolates, caramels and other candies became favorites. Mr. Hershey used his profits to help develop his home city, Hersey, PA. He gave a lot of money away to help other people. People all over the world still enjoy Hershey products. That is a SWEET success story!

title: Mind Your Money
text: You can make many choices about how to spend and save money. But first things first! Where can you get money? Most people work at jobs to earn money. After you have money, you can decide what to do with it. You will spend some money, of course. People usually pay for rent, food, transportation and clothing. Most people save part of their paychecks. Some people keep the money in a safe place at home. Other people put their money in a bank or similar corporation. It is also good to donate, or give money to, groups or people who might need help. Many people put aside a certain amount of their earnings each month for donations.

title: Banking on a Budget
text: It is good to have a plan to help make the right choices about spending, saving and donating money. A plan for using money is called a budget. Making a written plan for your money means you are more likely to make wise decisions. Budgets usually have a balance between income and expenses. Some people find it helpful to prepare a weekly budget. Other families plan their budget by the month or year. Budgets include a list of all the money that will be made and all the money that will be paid out. Schools, businesses and even the government must plan how to use their money with a budget.

title: Money From Four Points of View
text: Use information from this week’s magazine to examine the topics of money, budgets and economy from the viewpoints of four people. Complete the activities in the spaces provided. You may use another sheet of paper if you need extra space.

title: Think and Review Questions
text:
1. Why is it important for communities to prepare for natural disasters?

2. Why do you think it’s important for communities to develop different energy sources using the sun, wind and water?

3. Why is it important to have a plan to help make difficult decisions?

4. How do you think the free market economy in the United States is different from economies in other countries?

5. How is scarcity related to supply and demand?

6. What will happen if families spend more than they earn?

title: Let's Write
text: Think about a time you really wanted to buy something special. Maybe it was a candy bar, a new video game or a book. How did you convince your parents to let you spend money on the item? Tell what you wanted to buy and why it was important to you. Explain what steps you took to talk your parents into buying it. Be sure to write in complete sentences. Check your writing for correct spelling and punctuation.

title: Save a Dollar or Spend a Dollar
text:
Dorian shoved his hand down deep in his front pocket again just to be sure it was all still there. Sure enough, the wad of crumpled dollar bills was right where he had put it only minutes earlier. Dorian couldn't help being excited. Ninja Space Warriors went on sale today! It was the newest video game. Dorian had been waiting for months to have the chance to play. As a matter of fact, Dorian had been saving money for three months so he could be the first kid on his street to have the game.

Dorian remembered the day he first heard about the game. He had been watching television when a commercial came on. He was soon convinced he just had to have Ninja Space Warriors. Mom and Dad both suggested that Dorian should make a plan to earn (make) money to buy the game himself.

Dad sat down with Dorian, and they talked about saving for the game. Dorian knew he would have to work to make money. Dad suggested a dog washing service. Mom said she would pay Dorian to pull weeds from her garden. Dorian took his parents' advice and wrote down his plan for making and spending his money. Mom and Dad both thought the budget was a good idea. All summer long, Dorian worked hard to earn money. He washed at least two dogs each week. He pulled so many weeds from his mother's garden that she said it was the best her yard had ever looked.

Each time he completed a job, Dorian put the money he earned, or his income, into his piggy bank. The bank became heavier and heavier. Dorian also kept a written journal of the money he made. It made him feel proud to see how much money he was earning. He just knew the video game would be worth all the hard work.

Now the big day had finally arrived. Dorian looked at the video game again. He carefully counted all the money he had earned over the whole summer. Suddenly, he thought about how he was going to feel with an empty piggy bank. Dorian put the money back into his pocket.

"Hey Mom," he called, "do you think maybe I could just rent the game at the video store first to see if I really like it?" Mom smiled and nodded her head. Dorian left the store empty-handed but very happy.

title: Sacrifices of the Founders
text:
Many of the Founders made sacrifices for the Revolution. The people who helped found our country pledged their lives, their fortunes, and their sacred honor for the foundation of a new nation.

In letters to family and friends, Washington said he did not want to be president, but he was concerned that he didn’t have enough money to live out his retirement. In other words, he needed the job! Like other Founding Fathers after the war, he had land but no cash.

Washington owned a lot of land, but no one wanted to buy any of it. People who rented parts of his land didn’t have money to pay him. During the Revolution, he refused to accept pay for being the commander of the Army. He fed his staff and paid spies with his own money. After the war, the government paid him back in Continental dollars, which were worthless. Washington even had to borrow money to get to the Constitutional Convention in 1787.

Esther Reed lived in Philadelphia. She and her husband, Joseph Reed, supported the Revolutionary cause. Joseph was elected to the First Continental Congress and became a part of Washington’s army staff. Because of her husband's position, Esther had to leave Philadelphia. She spent much of the war evading British troops with her children. By 1780, Esther had moved back to Philadelphia and started the Ladies Association of Philadelphia. The Association raised about $7,500 for the Continental Army. Unfortunately, Esther got sick and died before she could see the money given to the Continental Army. Many Founders sacrificed their fortunes and lives for the cause of freedom.

title: Mind Your Money
text:
You can earn money to buy goods and services you need and want. There are many choices to make about how to save and spend this income. It is good to have a plan to help make these choices. A plan for using money is called a budget.

You can write down your budget. When you write down your plans for your money, you are more likely to make wise decisions. A budget can help you keep track of the amount of money you spend on expenses. It can help you see what types of things you are spending your income on. Seeing a budget written on paper can actually help keep you from spending too much money on goods and services that you don't really need. A budget can also help you plan for saving some of your money.

Balancing Income and Expenses

When you plan a budget, you should try to have a balance between money you earn (income) and money you spend (expenses). You can make a budget for each week, month or even year. To make a budget, think about how much money you will make for the time period of the budget. Then think about things you will need to spend money on. Most people must include money they will spend on housing, clothing, food and transportation. Of course, you will also want to think about money to spend on things you want. Wanted items are different from needed items because you don't have to have them to survive. Wanted items include things like movie tickets, video games and fast food. A good budget will also note the amount of money you will save. Saving money is important. People need to be prepared to pay for things they might need in the future. Many people save for college or retirement.

Madison's Budget

Madison is 16 years old and just got her first job. She works part time at an ice cream shop in her town. The work is fun, and Madison meets lots of people at her job. The best part for Madison is that she makes $125 each week. This is her income.

Madison wanted to work to earn money for herself. She is saving money to buy herself a car. Madison also likes to have money to go to the mall or the movies with friends. Madison is planning to go to college soon. She wants to save money for that as well.

Madison has to pay her brother for taking her to work each day. She also has to buy lunch. These are expenses.

Madison made a written plan for her money. Study her budget.

Madison's plan seems good, doesn't it? She will make more income than she has to spend for expenses for the month. This means she can save the amount left over. If Madison keeps this up, she'll be driving that new car in no time at all!

title: Who's Budgeting?
text:
Budgeting helps people make good choices about money. Families make budgets. This helps them set and meet goals for themselves. Families can make sure they are using their money wisely. They can see places where they might be spending too much or too little. But who else writes and uses a budget?

The president of the United States has to write a budget for our nation. He works with government leaders to decide what our country needs to spend its money on. In the same way, each state government has a budget. In Texas, the governor and other state leaders plan how to use money to best help the citizens of our state. They make sure that there is money to pay for all the services we need.

Your school has a budget too. Each year, leaders from your school and other schools in our state write out a plan for the things they need and want for each student. Then they compare those things to the money that is available to pay for them. Your principal and teacher want to make sure you have everything you need to do well in school.

Even businesses write budgets each year. Businesses have to plan how they will pay for their expenses. They have to think about changes that might need to be made to the budget if the income they make decreases or increases.

Knowing about budgets can help you become a better money manager.

title: Budgeting for College
text:
Many families stick to budgets for one important reason. They want to make sure there is plenty of money to send their children to college. Parents know that a college education is important today. People with a college degree will earn about $1 million more than someone without a degree during their life. That's a big chunk of money! But getting a college education is not cheap.

Experts on the economy say the cost of going to college is rising. Each year the cost increases. By the time you are ready for college it may take more than $30,000 each year. That could be bad news if families are not prepared.

Experts say the key to finding an answer for this problem is simple. Start saving money now. Set aside money to use only for college. Families should plan their budgets carefully. They should make good choices about their income and expenses. It's a good idea to put your savings into a college fund.

There is one other important thing that you can do now. Those same experts say kids should be encouraged to do well in school. If you study hard and get good grades, you will have a better chance of getting a scholarship. That means you might be able to go to college for a lot less money or maybe even for free. Now that is one smart idea!

title: What is a donation?
text: Another word for a donation is a gift. People usually make a donation to a charity group who will use the gift to help other people. Groups like the American Red Cross and the Salvation Army depend on donations to be able to offer help to people in times of need. You have probably seen these groups collecting donations outside of public buildings. You may have even donated to them yourself. Donations can be in many forms. Sometimes people give money as a donation. Other times the donation can be clothes, food or services. When planning a budget, donations received are considered income. If you are giving donations, it is an expense.

title: Going Bananas Over Food Prices
text:
One major expense families have in their budget is the cost of groceries. Families are spending more and more money each month for food. Why does the cost keep going up?

There are actually many reasons the cost of food is increasing. The high cost of energy is one reason. But one of the most important reasons food may cost more is scarcity of products. Scarcity is not having enough of something people need or want. When food products are in short supply, there is a greater demand for the product. When the supply is small, the price increases.

This has been seen in the cost of fish. Unfortunately, many lakes and rivers have become polluted. This means the fish from those areas are unsafe to eat. The supply of fish has decreased, but the demand for fish has stayed the same. This scarcity has caused the cost of some fish at the grocery store to rise.

Families will have to continue to budget food costs carefully.

title: Making a Budget
text:
Directions

For this activity, read the article called “Mind Your Money.” Think about a budget. In each circle connected to the word “Budget,” write an idea that would support the following main idea: “Budgets help people plan to use their money wisely.”

After you have completed the organizer, write two sentences about why budgets are important for families, schools or businesses. Use a separate sheet of paper if you need more space.

title: A Tale of Two Cousins
text:
Mara and Michael are cousins. Mara lives with her family on a vegetable farm in the Texas Panhandle. Michael and his family live near Houston, Texas. Michael's father works for a computer hardware manufacturing company. A manufacturing company uses machines to produce goods.

Read the letters below that the two cousins wrote one another. What can you learn about their families' ways of life from their letters?

Dear Michael,

I sure wish you were back visiting again. I had so much fun this summer while you were here. Daddy and Mama are much too busy out in the fields lately. They have a lot of work to do to get the crops ready. Daddy is a little worried about having a good harvest this year. If the crops don’t do as well this year, we won’t have as many vegetables to ship and sell to the stores. Of course, that means our family won’t have as much of an income. Mama says then we will have to change our family’s budget. The last time that happened, I couldn’t go to the movies for nearly a year!

Daddy was out in the fields today checking some new equipment he got. Can you believe a computer runs one of the new fertilizer machines? He was showing it off to other farmers from Iowa who came to visit him. They want to buy some of our corn to feed the cows they raise. Mama got their e-mail addresses so she can send them information on the internet when the crops are ready. I’ll bet a hundred years ago our great-grandfather didn’t need a computer to run this farm.

See you soon,

Mara

Dear Mara,

I liked reading your letter. I miss you too. I know what you mean about parents being busy. Dad has been working lots of hours at the factory. His company is working on manufacturing a new computer hard drive for farm machinery. Hey, maybe your dad's new fertilizer machine is one of my dad's products! You know what's cool about it? The factory is run almost completely by robots!

Mom's job at the shipping company is busy too. It was really funny yesterday because Mom had to pick up shipments to send out from Dad's plant. She told us she saw shipments to Japan, England and even Madagascar! At the dinner table Mom asked Dad if he was sure he put all the right addresses on the boxes! Dad laughed and told her not to worry because a computer does it all anyway.

Hope to see you soon,

Michael

title: High Gas Prices Could Tank Small Businesses
text:
There are many types of small businesses in the United States. Some are agricultural businesses. That means they are based on plants and animals. Some businesses manufacture goods in factories. Both types of businesses use transportation to ship goods from place to place. Whether goods are shipped by truck, train, ship or airplane, it takes fuel to get those goods where they need to go. When fuel prices go up, companies' transportation costs go up.

Gasoline is a good example of how fuel costs affect businesses. The cost of gasoline goes up and down, but over time the price has mostly gone up. In March 1999, a gallon of gas cost only $1.05. How much is a gallon of gasoline where you live today? High gas prices are hard on everyone, especially some businesses.

Small businesses usually don't make a lot of profit. When gasoline costs go up, some business owners are faced with difficult choices. They may have to close their businesses down. Or they may have to raise prices to make up for the cost of fuel. Then consumers may have to pay more for the goods they buy at the stores.

There are other ways for businesses to save money on transportation, too. Some pizza stores use bicycles instead of cars to deliver their pies. Other companies are using only small cars and trucks that don't use as much gas.

No one knows what the price of gasoline will be in ten years or even next year. What does your family do when the price of gas goes up? What do you do when it goes down?

title: Trade: Linking American Business to the World
text:
Moving Goods Around the World

Bananas don't grow very well in the United States. The climate just isn't quite right. But look around the grocery store. There is always a good supply of fresh yellow bananas. How can that be? Those bananas are shipped across the ocean to the United States from countries in Central or South America. As a matter of fact, there are many goods in the grocery store that were grown or manufactured in a far away place.

These goods make it to the United States because we choose to trade with other countries. This means we buy and sell goods and services to people in other countries. The reason people trade is very simple. Someone else has something we want. Or we have something someone else wants.

International Trade

Trade that takes place between two different countries is known as international trade. No country can produce every type of product. That's why countries choose to work with one another. Countries can choose to import and export goods. Importing is buying goods made in another country. Exporting is selling goods to other countries. The United States buys and sells goods with many other countries.

Our country trades many goods with our closest neighbors - Canada and Mexico. In fact, the governments of these three countries have signed an agreement with one another. The agreement makes it easier for businesses to import and export goods. The agreement helps people make money and get goods they want or need.

Domestic Trade

Not all trade in the United States takes place with other countries. Some trade is between states of our own country. This type of trade is known as domestic trade. Many states grow or manufacture goods that are not available in other places. These goods are shipped out daily in trucks, on railroads, in planes or on ships. For example, pineapples grown in Hawaii are shipped to all of the other states. Potatoes grown in Idaho are found in grocery stores in every other state. People in Hawaii and Idaho probably purchase automobiles manufactured in Michigan.

A Global Economy

Today the world is more connected than ever. We are all linked by trade as well as technology. People are able to come together to get the goods and services they need.

The economies of most of the world's countries are linked as well. They depend on each other. For example, the United States buys many computers and computer equipment from Japan. What if a Japanese computer factory burned down? There could be a shortage of computers in America. The cost of computers would increase because of the scarcity, or shortage. Some American companies might have to cut the number of people who work for them because they are spending more money on computers and can't afford salaries.

The people who lost jobs would not have as much money to purchase items at the store. They might not have enough money to buy clothes manufactured in Mexico. The businesses in Mexico would not make money because their products were not being sold.

So a fire in Japan could have an effect on people in Japan, America and Mexico.

The next time you go to the grocery store, take a look at the bananas. As a matter of fact, take a look at the labels and stickers on many products. You’ll probably be amazed at how many different countries have set up shop in your neighborhood grocery store.

title: Entrepreneurs
text:
Many Americans dream of owning their own business. People who start their own businesses are called entrepreneurs. Three famous entrepreneurs are Mary Kay Ash, Wallace Amos and Sam Walton. All three began with a small idea that grew into a successful business. Read on to learn more.

Mary Kay Ash

After a long career of working in sales, Mary Kay Ash started a business to help women. With the help of her son, Richard, she started a skin care and makeup business. Mary started by opening a small store in Dallas, Texas. As the company grew, employees sold items at in-home parties. In fact, Mary Kay parties are still popular in the homes of many women today. Most people remember Mary Kay Ash for the kindness she showed her employees. She rewarded employees with excellent sales by giving them a pink Cadillac to drive. Many people are still driving one today. Keep your eyes out for a light pink Cadillac. It just might be one of Mary Kay Ash's hard workers!

Wallace Amos

Wallace Amos enjoyed baking chocolate chip cookies as a child. He loved working with food so much that he attended a high school that focused on cooking. After returning from service in the U.S. Air Force, Wallace worked as a talent agent. Things didn’t work out well in that business, so he started baking cookies again. Soon he opened a cookie store named Famous Amos. Years later, Wallace sold his cookie business to a larger company called Keebler. Famous Amos® cookies are still a popular dessert today. Have you ever tried one? Yum!

Sam Walton

Sam Walton became interested in sales when he was young. After serving in the U.S. Army, he worked for J.C. Penney and eventually opened his own retail store named Walton's Five and Dime. A few years later, Sam was ready to open a larger store to sell more items. He opened the first Walmart on July 2, 1962. Today, Walmart is the largest retail company in the world.

title: World Currency for a World Economy
text:
It would get really confusing if there were lots of different money systems in the same country. Can you imagine what would happen if the United States had dollars, pesos (Mexican money) and yen (Japanese money) all mixed up together?

Each country needs a special type of currency (official money) for its citizens to use. Countries have to decide what their currency will look like and where it will be made. These bills and coins are called legal tender. Legal tender is money that can be used for all debts, charges, taxes and dues. For a long time, every country had its own money, and most of them still do. But in 1999, several European countries agreed to use a common currency called the euro. The countries thought a common currency would allow goods to move more freely between European countries. That would help everyone's economy.

By 2002, the first actual euro bills and coins were being made and used in 12 countries. In 2014, the euro was the official currency in 17 countries. These countries are called the Eurozone, and more countries are joining it each year. The introduction of the euro is the largest monetary (having to do with money) changeover the world has ever seen. Pretty cool!

title: Reading a Flow Chart
text:
Many goods must be manufactured in a certain process. Most processes involve several steps. You know good readers think about steps in the order that they happen. A flow chart can help you better understand the order of the steps in a process.

• Always read the title of the flow chart. This will help you understand the main idea of the process being shown.
• Be sure to read all the labels and study the pictures on the flow chart.
• Look at the arrows on the flow chart. These tell you which steps occurred in what order.

Now you try. Think of a simple product that is familiar to you. Create a flow chart below to show how the product is produced. You can add more boxes if you need to. Be sure to include a title, labels, pictures and arrows to show the order of the steps.

title: Let's Write
text: Pretend you are running for president of the United States. You have been asked to write a speech about the importance of trade between countries. Write the speech and present it to an audience of your classmates. Be sure to give details to support the ideas in your speech. Write in complete sentences. In your written work, try to use correct spelling, punctuation and capitalization.

title: A Fiesta of Cultures
text:
"Mami, hurry," Marisa called towards the kitchen. "We are going to miss the start of the parade!"

Marisa walked through the door and turned down the volume of the upbeat tejano music (dance music that mixes different styles) playing on the radio so her mother could hear her better. Marisa's mother was filling a thermos with horchata, a sweet Mexican rice drink.

"Mija, sweetie, we have plenty of time," she said. "I promise we won't miss a single float. Let me finish packing the snacks to take with us."

Mami placed the burritos she was holding in a picnic basket. Marisa's mouth watered as she thought about the bean and cheese snacks she could eat later that night while watching the colorful parade.

Marisa and her family are lucky to live in San Antonio. Each year they can attend many fun events at the Fiesta San Antonio. This fiesta is a 10-day celebration that takes place every April. Some of the events include parades, music concerts, good food, and even a carnival. During the fiesta, people celebrate the history of San Antonio. They also celebrate the many cultures that make their city special.

San Antonio, just like the rest of the United States, has many people from different cultures. These people and their families are from many different countries. Each of these groups has a culture. A culture means a way of life. Language, food, art, music, customs, and traditions are all part of a group's culture.

Americans respect the many cultures that make up our country. Many people share their culture with others. It is what makes our country special and different from other countries. You have probably had food or listened to music that was from a culture other than your own. It is exciting and fun to learn about other cultures and to share our own culture with other people.

This week you will learn about heroes that have shaped our cultures and communities.

title: Come Join the Party!
text:
Each June, San Antonio puts on the biggest cultural celebration in all of Texas. The Texas Folklife Festival has been around since 1972 and just keeps getting bigger and better.

The Texas Folklife Festival brings more than 40 different cultures from across the state together for three days of food, crafts, music and dancing. The money raised at the festival goes back to the different cultural groups who participate in the event. Some use the money for scholarships and others use it to teach their young people more about their native cultures.

At the festival, you can taste Polish pierogi (dumplings), Japanese yakitori (chicken kabobs), Lebanese kibbee (ground lamb or pork) burgers, Filipino pancit (stir fried noodles) or dozens of other traditional foods. You can even try your hand at making pickles, compete in a watermelon seed spitting, contest or learn to clog. You can also enjoy music and dances from all over the world and shop for crafts from many different countries and cultures.

The festival is held on the grounds of the Institute of Texan Cultures on the University of Texas at San Antonio (UTSA) HemisFair Park Campus in early June. The Texas Folklife Festival is one of the biggest and best parties in Texas!

title: Historical Community Heroes
text:
There are lots of heroes, or people we can look up to, in the world. Heroes are people who have done incredible things for others. You can probably think of a few heroes who are special to you.

Every community has heroes. Heroes can help shape the culture of a community. Heroes can help shape traditions of holidays and the arts. Many heroes help us understand why values like courage and freedom are important. Some heroes inspire others to try to make positive changes. Read these stories about two famous heroes.

David Crockett

"Be always sure you are right. Then go ahead."

David Crockett (often called Davy Crockett) is one American hero whose story is almost larger than life. Many people today know him as the King of the Wild Frontier. He was a leader, a hunter, a scout, a storyteller and a very brave man.

Crockett was born in Tennessee in 1786. As a young boy, he ran away from home so he didn't have to go to school. He went to school only 100 times in his whole life. Crockett wandered from town to town and through the wilderness for several years. He became a great hunter and stayed alive on the harsh land. When he was 16, he finally returned home to his family. They hardly recognized him, but they were glad he was home safe.

David Crockett later married and started his own family. He and his wife had two children. After his wife died, he married again and had three more children. Crockett had little money but always took care of his family.

Crockett served in the Tennessee militia during the War of 1812. Everyone really liked him. He was later elected to the state government in Tennessee. He was even elected to the U.S. Congress. Crockett was well respected as a government leader but was not elected for a second term in Congress. So he went to Texas and joined the Texans fighting for independence from Mexico. David Crockett died fighting at the Alamo in San Antonio.

Crockett did not become a legend until after he died. People told stories about his life and adventures. Sometimes they mixed in some make-believe parts with the true parts. People everywhere liked learning about David Crockett's adventures. They wrote many books, plays, television shows and even movies about his life.

Today David Crockett is remembered as a hero because of his courage and bravery. He fought for what he believed in, and his example still inspires other people to do the same.

Abraham Lincoln

There are few men who are respected as much as Abraham Lincoln, the 16th president of the United States.

Lincoln was born in Kentucky in 1809. His family struggled to survive on the very rough frontier. Lincoln had many chores to do. He often spent hours splitting log rails for fences or doing other odd jobs to help earn money for his family. Lincoln did not like the hard work, but he did it for his family.

He did like to learn, even though it was not easy for him. When he could take a break from work on the farm, he often walked to the closest schoolhouse. It was more than two miles away. At school Lincoln learned to read, write and solve math problems. He was slower than most children. But once he learned something, he never forgot it. Lincoln became an excellent reader. He loved to read more than anything else.

Lincoln studied hard and became a lawyer. He married a woman named Mary Todd. They had four sons. Only one of their sons lived to be an adult. Mrs. Lincoln was often in poor health.

Lincoln decided to run for the U.S. Senate in 1858. He did not win the election, but people did start talking about his good ideas. Then in 1860, Abraham Lincoln was elected the president of the United States.

Things were hard right from the beginning. The Civil War began just a few weeks after he became president. Lincoln worked hard to put an end to the war. He wanted people to get along. He wanted all people to have freedom. Most of all, Lincoln wanted the United States to be a strong country.

In 1863, President Abraham Lincoln signed the Emancipation Proclamation. This document gave freedom to enslaved people in the Confederate states. By April 1865, the war was over. Lincoln believed he had done his job as president of the United States.

Some people were angry with President Lincoln. They did not like the decisions he made during the Civil War. A few days after the war ended, an actor named John Wilkes Booth shot and killed President Lincoln. The people of the United States of America lost a true hero.

Today people remember Abraham Lincoln for his calm courage and love of freedom. He is also remembered for getting people to solve their differences by working together.

title: Phillis Wheatley
text:
At the age of about eight years old, Phillis Wheatley was kidnapped from West Africa. Slave traders brought her to Boston, Massachusetts, where she was enslaved and sold to John and Susanna Wheatley. Phillis was intended to work for Mrs. Wheatley personally, but the Wheatleys came to consider her a member of the family. As time went by, Mr. and Mrs. Wheatley treated Phillis like one of their own children. It didn’t take long for the Wheatleys to see that Phillis was very smart. She learned to read and write English very quickly. She then went on to learn Greek and Latin. She wrote her first poem at the age of 13. Many people were fascinated (highly interested) with Phillis and her poetry.

When Phillis was 20 years old, the Wheatleys sent her to England. There she published many poems, including a book of poems called “Poems on Various Subjects, Religious and Moral.” While Phillis was in England, Mrs. Wheatley became very ill. Phillis had grown very close to Mrs. Wheatley, so she came back to the U.S. to be with her before she died. Three months before Mrs. Wheatley’s death, Phillis was freed from slavery. After Phillis gained her freedom, she wrote and published an anti-slavery letter and a poem that honored George Washington.

A few years later, Phillis married a free African American man named John Peters. Together they had three children who all died at a young age. Even though she was a successful poet, Phillis and John were very poor. Phillis Wheatley died in 1784 but will be forever remembered as the first African American woman to publish a book.

title: Laura Ingalls Wilder
text:
Have you ever watched the television show "Little House on the Prairie?" If so, you may know more about Laura Ingalls Wilder than you think you do. Even though the show added some new characters and extra scenes, the stories were pretty close to what life was like for Laura.

Laura was born on February 7, 1867, in Pepin, Wisconsin. Her father, Charles, and her mother, Caroline, were determined people who wanted the best for their family. The Ingalls family moved often, traveling from place to place on the frontier. Laura became a teacher when she was 15 and married at the age of 18. She married Almanzo Wilder, and together they built their home on a farm in Mansfield, Missouri.

Years later, Laura began to write. She wrote for a few magazines and later became an editor of the "Missouri Ruralist." With help from her daughter, Rose, Laura started to write about her childhood. She retold many stories of when she was young and made them easy for children to read. In 1932, Laura Ingalls Wilder published the first book in her "Little House" series. Laura told about her family's life during the 1870s in a book called "Little House in the Big Woods." Laura went on to write more books for the "Little House" series to remember life on the prairie. Have you ever read any of her books?

To learn more about Laura Ingalls Wilder, you can visit her home on Rocky Ridge Farm. The farm is located near Springfield, Missouri, and is open to the public. While you are there, be sure to visit the museum and gift shop. For more information go to http://www.lauraingallswilderhome.com/.

title: Organizing Information
text:
Use the graphic organizer below to organize ideas about two different heroes, David Crockett and Abraham Lincoln. Think about the ways the two men were alike. Put your ideas in the correct areas of the diagram. Then think about the ways the two men were different. Put these ideas in the correct areas of the diagram.

Use the information from your organized diagram to write two paragraphs about the men. Be sure to support main ideas with details from your organizer. You may write on a separate sheet of paper if you need more room.

title: Alena Writes to Remember
text:
Alena pulled the journal out from under her bed. She smiled as she opened the worn brown leather book. Alena began writing down stories about all of the events from the day.

The most exciting part was picking up her grandparents from the airport. Yaya and Pappous were staying for a whole month. They lived in Greece most of the year, but each spring they came for a visit. Alena could hardly wait for all the fun the family would have.

Alena's grandparents always brought their Greek customs and traditions with them. Alena's mom said it was just like being back in Greece when Yaya made her famous baklava. Baklava is a sweet honey dessert and was the family's favorite treat.

Alena wrote about the Greek feast they had for dinner that evening. The lemon chicken was the best part. Since Pappous was the oldest person at the table, he was served first. This was the custom in Greece. Alena didn't mind - she liked seeing her grandfather smile. During dinner everyone talked, laughed and joked. Yaya told Alena that in Greece it is always considered polite to talk during a meal.

Alena decided to write down some of the stories her grandparents told during dinner that evening. There had been lots of stories about Greek gods and goddesses. Alena wrote about her favorite story. It was a Greek myth about the world's first woman. Alena tried to remember all the details about the story exactly as her grandmother told it. She wanted to be able to read the story to her best friend at school.

Pappous told a funny story about dancing at the Fish Festival last year. Alena was sure to write down exactly how her grandfather had described the dancing, singing and feasting on the beach. Alena wrote about how different Greek festivals are from festivals in Texas.

Alena was getting sleepy. She closed her journal and thought about everything that had happened. She knew tomorrow would also be exciting and she would soon have lots more to write about. Maybe Yaya or Pappous would have another story to tell about their lives and culture in Greece. Alena knew she would be sharing the stories with her own children one day. With a smile, she put her pen away. Yes, tomorrow would be another story to tell.

title: Make Time to Read!
text:
Do you spend some time each day reading for fun? If you do, then you are among the 54 percent of kids your age who read nearly every day, just because they enjoy it. Unfortunately, this number goes down as kids get older. Only about 30 percent of 13-year-olds and 22 percent of 17-year-olds read each day for fun.

Why do kids quit reading for fun as they get older? Some kids say it is because they have too much homework, they are too busy, they are too tired or they just can't find any books they like. Reading for fun is important because it opens up a whole new world of ideas. It also improves your vocabulary, or the number of words you know, and makes it easier for you to concentrate and learn. How do YOU find a good book to read? Many kids get ideas for good books from their friends. Parents, teachers and librarians also have good ideas. Ask them to tell you what books they liked as kids or to recommend books that other kids your age have enjoyed.

A few books that you might want to try are “Frindle” by Andrew Clements; “Dog Diaries: Secret Writings of the WOOF Society” by Betsy Byars, Betsy Duffey and Laurie Myers; “Homer Price” by Robert McCloskey; “Thunder Rose” by Jerdine Nolen; or “La Mariposa” by Francisco Jiménez.

To find more great books to read for fun, ask a parent or teacher to help you visit “Favorite Books for Third-Graders” at http://www.greatschools.net/cgi-bin/showarticle/625.

title: Sharing Culture Through Stories and Poems
text:
Have you ever sat around with your family telling stories? What are your favorite stories to tell or hear? Maybe there is a story about your family's history you think is funny. Maybe you find a story about your community fascinating.

Reading, telling and listening to stories are ways that people share their culture with one another. By sharing stories, people can learn more about the cultural heritage in their community. A community’s heritage is made up of history, traditions, beliefs and customs that are handed down from one generation to the next.

There are many ways writers can share their cultural heritage with people. Stories and poems can express the traditions shared by people. Writers use words to describe the world in special ways. Read on to find out about four writers who found special ways to use words.

Larry McMurtry

Larry McMurtry was born in 1936 in Wichita Falls, Texas, and grew up on a Texas ranch. As a boy, Larry loved to read. He studied hard in school and later became an English teacher.

As an adult, Larry still loved to read. Soon he began writing down stories of his own. The stories he wrote most often were all about the wild frontier of Texas. He told stories about cattle drives and Texas Rangers. He wrote about cowboys and life in small Texas towns. People who read his books learned about the culture of early Texas. They learned how people in Texas lived, worked and solved problems.

Many of his stories won awards. In 1986, his book “Lonesome Dove” won the highest award for a writer — the Pulitzer Prize. Many of his stories were also made into movies and television shows. “The Last Picture Show” is a movie based on a book Larry wrote. He helped write the script for the movie, which was filmed in Archer City, Texas. In 2007, the American Film Institute ranked the movie as one of the 100 greatest American films of all time.

Many readers also love his nonfiction books about the history of the western United States. Young writers study his work as an example of a great way to use words to share culture.

Maya Angelou

Maya Angelou was born Marguerite Johnson in 1928 in St. Louis, Missouri. As a young African American who faced a lot of discrimination, Maya had a very difficult childhood. There was violence and anger all around her. She had a hard time being happy.

At one point, Maya did not speak for nearly five years. But she realized she could use her words to change the way people saw and understood her. She wrote many stories and poems about the thoughts inside her heart.

Maya wrote many books about her own life and family. The stories helped people understand life in the African American communities of her world. She won many awards for her work.

In January 1993, Maya became only the second poet in history to have the honor of reading and writing a poem for the president of the United States. She read her poem "On the Pulse of Morning" for President Bill Clinton when he was sworn into office.

In 2011, President Barack Obama gave Maya the Presidential Medal of Freedom for her work as a poet, actress, dancer and teacher. Her words help the world understand her culture and heritage.

Tomie dePaola

Tomie dePaola was born in 1934 in Connecticut. He loved anything and everything that had to do with books. One of his favorite things to do was to illustrate stories his mother read to him. As he got older, he began to write his own books. He grew up to be a well-known author and illustrator of almost 250 children's books. You may have even read one yourself. Some of Tomie's books include "Adelita: A Mexican Cinderella Story," "Andy: That's My Name" and "Bill and Pete." Do any of those titles sound familiar?

Tomie's books and illustrations have won many awards. Some of his awards include the Caldecott Honor Award, a Newberry Award and the Laura Ingalls Wilder Award. His books have been read by millions of children around the world. To see an interview with Tomie dePaola, visit http://www.readingrockets.org/books/interviews/depaola.

Mark Twain

The citizens in Hannibal, Missouri, have a special celebration each year called the National Tom Sawyer Days. This festival honors the author of the book “The Adventures of Tom Sawyer.” The author, Mark Twain, was born near Hannibal in 1835.

Mark Twain wrote more than 30 books during his career. Some of these are America's most beloved stories.

Many of Twain's stories take place in Hannibal or on the nearby Mississippi River. Some of his stories are funny. Readers can learn a lot about life in America in the 1800s from Twain's stories. They can learn about the culture of communities on the Mississippi River.

title: Words that Shared a Dream
text:
Martin Luther King Jr. was an African American leader during the 1950s and 1960s. He believed all people in a community should be treated fairly. He especially wanted African Americans to be treated better. Many people agreed with King and came to listen to the speeches he wrote. King wanted his words to change people's minds about how they treat other people.

On Aug. 28, 1963, Martin Luther King Jr. gave a very famous speech in Washington, D.C. The title of the speech was "I Have a Dream." He spoke to many people about the way African Americans were being treated. People listened to his speech. Many of them became determined to make changes to America's communities. Because of Martin Luther King Jr.'s speech, America was changed.

From Martin Luther King Jr.'s speech, Aug. 28, 1963

I have a dream that one day this nation will rise up and live out the true meaning of its creed: "We hold these truths to be self-evident, that all men are created equal."

...And this will be the day...when all of God's children will be able to sing with new meaning:

My country 'tis of thee, sweet land of liberty, of thee I sing.

Land where my fathers died, land of the Pilgrim's pride,

From every mountainside, let freedom ring!

title: It's Your "Write" to Change the Community
text:
Good citizens care about their community. They want the community to be safe. They want the people to have good jobs and housing. Good citizens work to protect and share the cultural heritage of the community with everyone. Sometimes people have ideas that could make the community better.

There are many ways for citizens to share their ideas with other people. Sometimes they write letters that are printed in the community's newspaper. These are called letters to the editor.

Writing a letter to the editor is a good way for citizens to share their opinion with others. Sometimes a letter to the editor can give information about a concern to everyone else within the community. Some letters thank or praise someone for doing something good for the community. A good letter to the editor may help make changes in the community that will be best for everyone. Even young citizens like you can write a letter to the editor of your local newspaper. Here are a few tips for writing the best letter possible.

Read and understand the newspaper's rules for publishing letters to the editor. Discuss your writing plan with an adult to make sure you know exactly how to get your letter published.

Make your letter short and to the point. Keep your statements strong. Provide details to support your main ideas.

End your letter with the main point you want readers to remember.

Be sure to edit your work. You must use correct capitalization, punctuation marks and spelling.

Ask someone to review your letter. Ask them to make sure your ideas are clear.

Always include your name and your parents' names and phone number with your letter.

Check with your parents before sending in your letter to the editor.

Follow these guidelines, and you could write your way to a better community.

title: The Value of Debate and Dissent: W.E.B. Du Bois and Booker T. Washington.
text:
Disagreements can be unpleasant and cause hard feelings. So what can you do? Have a debate! A debate is a chance for you and your friend to explain your point of view. If you understand why your friend sees things differently, it’s easier to respect their point of view, even if you don’t agree with it.

Booker T. Washington and William Edward Burghardt (W.E.B.) Du Bois were two great American leaders. Both men were African Americans, but Washington was born enslaved in 1856 and Du Bois was born free in 1868. Each man spent his life working to improve the lives of African Americans, but they disagreed about the best way to do it.

U.S. laws between 1876 and 1965 said that African Americans and white people should be separate but equal. Washington believed that if African Americans worked hard, eventually they would no longer be separate. They would be accepted as citizens with the same rights white people had. Du Bois dissented, or disagreed. He wanted people to protest and fight for the laws to be changed. He worried that Washington’s advice would hold African Americans back instead of helping them. The debates and struggle for civil rights went on for years, but both men are remembered as great leaders.

Read the quotes below, and have a class discussion about what they mean.

"In all things that are purely social we can be as separate as the fingers, yet one as the hand in all things essential to mutual progress." -Booker T. Washington

"But we do not merely protest; we make renewed demand for freedom in that vast kingdom of the human spirit ..." -W.E.B. Du Bois

title: Cause and Effect
text:
Writers sometimes write to persuade. This means they want to convince others to see their point of view. In this type of writing, main ideas and details are often written as causes and effects.

A cause is the reason another thing happens. An effect is what happens as the result of something else. It is important to be able to recognize which ideas are causes and which are effects. This skill will help you better understand how ideas are related.

Here is a letter written by nine-year-old Tran to her local newspaper about a way she thinks the community could be better. Read Tran’s letter. Underline all of the ideas you believe are causes. Circle all of the ideas you think are effects.

Letters to the Editor

Dear Editor,

My family is from Vietnam. My parents wanted to have a better life, so they came to live in America. We are very happy here. There are many other Vietnamese families like mine living in our city. We get together often to share food and stories from our culture. Because we are proud of our heritage, we would like a chance to share it with the rest of our community.

Our city should host a Vietnam Culture Day. The first Saturday in June would be a good day for the celebration because children will be on vacation from school. Vietnamese families could set up booths in the park. There are many good Vietnamese foods, so some families could share their special recipes. Some families could share pictures and videos of the many interesting places, plants and animals in Vietnam. Then people in our community could learn what life was like for us in Vietnam before we moved to America.

There are also many people from other cultures living in our city. If these people see a successful Vietnam Culture Day, maybe they will share their culture with everyone too! Citizens who attend all types of culture days will understand people from other countries better. A Vietnam Culture Day will make our community a better place to live.

Sincerely, Nguyen Tran

title: A 21st Century Field Trip
text:
Dominic grabbed his backpack and threw it over his shoulder. He hurried down the steps two at a time. In the kitchen Mom was packing lunches. Dominic rushed over to the counter and grabbed a brown paper bag. He took a quick peek inside. It was the usual peanut butter sandwich. "Looks yummy, Mom. Thanks!" Before Dominic could hurry out the back door, his mom called out, "Hey, what's the rush?"

"Sorry, Mom. I don't want to be late. We're going on a field trip today." Dominic gave his mother a quick hug. "It's going to be so much fun. We're visiting three museums today. I think my teacher said they are in New York City and Washington, D.C."

Mom's mouth dropped open in surprise. "I don't remember signing any field trip form for an out-of-town trip! What's going on?"

"Oh, don't worry Mom. We aren't leaving the classroom!" Dominic grinned from ear to ear at the little joke he was playing on his mother. Then he raced down the street towards Blackstone Elementary School.

In his classroom, everyone was talking about the field trip. Dominic's friend Mariah said she couldn't wait to see the paintings. Jahim said he thought the sculptures would be the best part. Everyone was buzzing about all the things they would study and learn about today.

When their teacher, Mrs. Cleaver, told them about the virtual field trips they’d take to art museums, the third grade students could hardly wait. Mrs. Cleaver explained that they would use the internet to log into the web sites of museums around the country. The students would be able to see famous paintings, sculptures and exhibits — all from their classroom. They would learn more about communities and people from around the world. And then they would talk about how the artists’ work helped shape the cultural heritage of communities.

A very excited Dominic held his breath and waited for Mrs. Cleaver to log onto the internet. Today would be a day he’d never forget. He was certain of that.

title: New U.S. National Monuments
text:
Do you know how many national monuments there are in the United States? President Obama approved five new national monuments in March 2013. These and other U.S. monuments preserve national resources so that visitors can honor special people and events of the past.

One is the First State National Monument in Delaware. It is the state’s first national park site, and it tells about the early settlement of the Delaware colony and how Delaware was the first state to ratify, or approve, the U.S. Constitution. Another is the Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad National Monument in Maryland. It honors Ms. Tubman, who bravely helped enslaved people escape to freedom using the Underground Railroad. It is located on Maryland’s Eastern Shore. There is also the Rio Grande del Norte National Monument in New Mexico. It is an important habitat for many birds and wildlife, and it has a collection of petroglyphs (rock drawings or carvings) and other archaeological and cultural resources.

The Charles Young Buffalo Soldiers National Monument is in Wilberforce, Ohio. It preserves the home of Colonel Charles Young, who was an officer in the U.S. Army. He was the first African American to become a Colonel. And last, the San Juan Islands National Monument is in Washington State's Puget Sound. It is a chain of islands, an archipelago, and there are 450 total! People can visit historic lighthouses and view cultural resources and fossils dating back 12,000 years.

President Theodore Roosevelt signed the Antiquities Act into law in 1906. Since then, 16 presidents have used this Act to preserve our national resources. Research the Antiquities Act (http://www.nps.gov/archeology/sites/antiquities/), and find out how many national monuments there are in the United States. (Hint: There are over 100!) Which ones are most interesting to you? Have you ever visited any?

Visit www.studiesweekly.com/currentevents/ for more Connections and Current Events articles.

title: Art in Communities: Reflecting Culture
text:
History of Art

For as long as there have been humans there has also been art. Art helps us learn about how people of a community lived. In other words, art helps us understand culture.

Music, drawings, paintings, photographs and sculptures are some types of art. The earliest art was found in ancient times on cave walls and rocks. These ancient people did not have a written language. Instead, they used pictures to tell about their lives. The drawings and sculptures they left behind have helped us learn more about the ways they lived.

We can also use art to study the early civilizations of Greece, Rome, India, China and Egypt. By studying the art and even the buildings they left behind, we have learned how these people lived. We have learned how the communities were governed. Artists in all time periods left work behind that shows the cultural heritage of their people.

Today there are many people who create songs, stories, drawings and pictures. Our artists today are important for many reasons. Artists look for new ways to explain people and events. Artists challenge people to study themselves through art. Most importantly, artists' work continues to shape and change the cultural heritage of our communities. Perhaps one day our modern works of art will be studied for information about our communities and culture.

Painting

We have been painting since ancient times. People living in the Ice Age painted cave walls. These drawings often showed what was important in their culture: the animals they hunted. Over time, paintings have also been used for decoration or as a way to communicate. People of all cultures have painted scenes of their homes, land and daily life in their communities. Art became popular in most religions. Artists painted on buildings or on cloth such as silk. Soon they painted on a new Chinese invention - paper. Early artists were often hired by rich clients to paint portraits of their families. Painting was, and still is, a way to express the culture of the people.

Kadir Nelson

There have been thousands of excellent painters throughout history. Just like painters such as Pablo Picasso and Vincent Van Gogh who lived long ago, painters today are creating beautiful pieces of artwork. One such painter is Kadir Nelson. Kadir started drawing when he was three years old and painting when he was 10. After trying out several types of art media, he decided to use oil paint for his work. Kadir has created many amazing paintings. He also worked with DreamWorks Animation as the lead artist for the movie “Spirit: Stallion of the Cimarron.” His paintings have been used in a Coca-Cola® calendar and on the cover of the program for the All-Star Game in Major League Baseball. Throughout Kadir’s career, he has tried to paint with emotion and strength. His hope is that people see the strength of the human spirit in his art.

Carmen Lomas Garza

Carmen Lomas Garza decided she wanted to be an artist when she was only 13 years old. When she was a little girl, she was treated unfairly at school. She and her peers were punished for speaking Spanish in an American school. Carmen took her experiences as a child and used them to create beautiful pieces of art. She is known for creating art that honors her family and her Texas Latino community.

Sculpture

Like painting, sculpture is a record of human experiences. Sculpture is three-dimensional art. The earliest sculptures were carved from wood, rock or bone. Sculptures were found in emperor's palaces, religious temples and on battlefields. As people and the way they lived became more advanced, so did their art. Soon sculptures were being chipped from stone to become models of leaders, warriors and heroes of the time. The sculptures of a community showed what the people found to be important, or what they valued.

Photography

In the 1800s a new type of art form was developed. This art form was photography and could be used by nearly everyone. Photography made it easy for people to record images instantly. Around 1837, Louis Daguerre invented a new type of photograph. It was called a daguerreotype. These pictures were clearer and had more details than before. Photography has continued to change and improve. Today many people enjoy taking digital pictures with their cell phones.

Gordon Parks

In the 20th century, one man made a great effort to use photography to share his culture. This man was Gordon Parks. He was the first African American to be a photographer for Life magazine, a famous American magazine. His specialty was taking pictures that would help people understand the African American community.

title: New Deal Art
text:
During the Great Depression of the 1930s, many people found themselves out of jobs. President Franklin Roosevelt, along with Congress, wanted to set up a program that might help people out of their troubles. They set up the Works Progress Administration. It was also known as the WPA.

One of the WPA projects was known as the Federal Art Project. The leaders of the project wanted to create new jobs for artists. So they hired the artists to paint murals in public buildings. Murals are large pictures painted on walls or ceilings of buildings. The murals were supposed to show the values of the American people. The artists also created posters and paintings.

More than 5,000 people were given jobs to create this artwork in nearly every state. Though the artists were not paid much money for their work, they took pride in doing a good job. Over time, these artists painted 225,000 pieces of art for the American public to enjoy.

Only some of these murals and paintings are still around today. Some communities ran out of money to care for them. Some of the murals were lost when old buildings were torn down. But today people are working to raise money to redo and save the murals. These pieces of art are an important part of American history. They reflect America's past culture.

title: What is a museum?
text:
A museum is a building where works of art, history or science are placed for people to see and study. Museums try to collect lots of pieces to share with the community. Many museums are dedicated to studying the pieces. Special employees, known as curators, are the museum directors.

There are many museums in the United States. The Smithsonian Institution in Washington, D.C., has thousands of works of art, science and history. The first museum in Texas was started in 1892. Today it is called the Modern Art Museum of Fort Worth. Have you ever been there? This museum has lots of art from the time after World War II. See if you can find other interesting museums near you.

title: New Tools, New Art
text:
Some artists paint. Other artists create sculptures. Others use photography to share their work. Modern artists now have another method to use — the internet.

Internet art, which is sometimes called net art or digital art, uses a computer as the medium, or method for making art. Net artists create artwork by using technology. Creative Web sites, e-mail projects and online video or audio are all types of net art.

There are many programs for net artists to use for creating their work. Many programs allow the artist to paint, create 3-D graphics and add music and sound to their work. Many movies are made by using net art to supply computer graphics to movie scenes. Who knows, maybe all of our artwork in the future will be made using a computer or a tablet.

title: Organizing Ideas
text: Read the article titled “Art in Communities: Reflecting Culture.” Think about the main idea and details that support the main idea in the article. Using the graphic organizer below, write a statement in the middle rectangle that gives the main idea about art and culture. Look for facts that support the main idea and write them in the circles. Be sure to write in complete sentences. Edit your work.

title: Let's Write
text: Look around your classroom. What are three things that could be placed in a museum for people in the future to study? Write about those three items. Explain why people in the future might be interested in the object. What will it tell them about our culture? Write your ideas using complete sentences. Be sure to edit for capitalization, punctuation and spelling.

title: Texas: Big State, Big Heritage
text:
In size, Texas is the second-largest state in the United States. Texas is also ranked No. 2 in population in the country. Population is the number of people living in an area. Only California has more people than Texas. Those two facts make Texas an interesting place to live. But there is another special thing that makes Texas unique — the people.

Texas is home to people from around the world. Many families who live in Texas once lived in another country. Texans have immigrated, or moved, to our state from many places like Mexico, Germany, Vietnam, China, Korea, the Philippines and India. In fact, almost every country in the world has given our state at least one new citizen.

These new Texas citizens are like the people who immigrated to Texas in earlier centuries. They want to find freedom and a better way of life. These people want to live and work in our state. They want their children to go to good schools.

When immigrants come to our state, they bring the customs and culture of their homelands with them. In Texas, we can learn about each other's cultures. We can eat foods from many cultures. We can listen and dance to the music of another culture. We can even participate in many cultural traditions at festivals.

We share and respect the many cultures that make up the heritage of our state. An important way we do that is through cultural celebrations. Many groups hold special festivals to share their culture and heritage with other people. When we participate in other cultural celebrations, we learn about new places, people and languages.

In this issue, we will be learning about different cultural celebrations in Texas. We will compare different groups and their heritages. We will find out exactly what it is that makes Texas a true multicultural state.

title: States Crack Down on Hate Crimes
text:
The United States is a good place to live. But there are some things that make people upset. Crime is one of these things. Crimes hurt people and can hurt our communities. Our states try very hard to keep criminals from hurting citizens who follow the laws. States are working hard to stop a very serious type of crime against people. These crimes are known as hate crimes.

Hate crimes are crimes against someone just because they belong to a certain group. The groups may be people of a certain race, color or religion. Sometimes people become victims because of their cultural heritage.

Some criminals try to send the message that these people are not wanted in the community. The criminals try to make the victims feel unsafe.

The Hate Crime Prevention Act was passed by the U.S. Congress in 2009. It gives harsher punishment to people who commit hate crimes. Most states and many countries around the world have special laws against hate crimes too.

Citizens hope these new laws will help make sure everyone living in the United States feels safe and welcome.

title: Texas Cultural Celebrations
text:
Mexican Texan Celebrations

Because Texas once belonged to Mexico, the culture of Mexico is seen throughout the state. Without Mexico, Texas would not be the state we know and love today. The Tex-Mex celebrations in our state include special events also celebrated in Mexico. Cinco de Mayo and Dia de los Muertos are both exciting Mexican cultural celebrations in Texas.

Cinco de Mayo

May 5, Cinco de Mayo, is celebrated as a very special day in Mexico. The day celebrates the Battle of Puebla in Mexico in 1862. On this day, a group of Mexican soldiers won a battle against a large group of French soldiers.

In Texas and other parts of the United States, the day is a day to celebrate Mexican heritage and pride. Celebrations are held in many cities. Colorful parades, bullfights, fireworks and dancing are all part of the celebration. Children look forward to breaking a piñata at a fiesta, or party. A piñata is a colorfully decorated container filled with candy and small toys. Blindfolded children take turns trying to break the piñata open with a stick. Everyone gets to run for the candy when it falls to the ground. Many people look forward to eating traditional Mexican food. Menudo is a spicy stew made with hominy, beef and red chilies. There are often contests to find the best recipe.

Dia de los Muertos

Nov. 1-2 has been celebrated as Dia de los Muertos (Day of the Dead) for hundreds of years in the Mexican culture. The celebration honors family members who have died. It is not a spooky celebration, but a time to share memories about special people.

In Texas and parts of the southwestern United States, the celebration includes picnics at a cemetery. Families eat the favorite foods of their loved ones and tell stories about them. They also clean the grave sites and leave behind fresh flowers called marigolds. Children enjoy eating special Day of the Dead sweets. Sugar skulls and chocolate coffins are a special treat. Pan de muerto is also popular. This sweet bread is baked in the shape of bones and decorated with sugar. In larger cities, the day is celebrated with parades and music festivals.

German Texan Celebrations

Friedrich Ernst, a German, came to Texas in the early 1830s. He wrote letters back home to his family and friends in Germany about his wonderful new home in Texas. Many other Germans heard lots of good things about Texas. By the late 1840s, there were many German communities in Texas. Most of the Germans settled in south-central Texas. Today there are many communities in Texas with a strong German heritage. People of all cultures often enjoy the special German celebrations.

Oktoberfest

People who live in the community of Fredericksburg, Texas, look forward to October each year. This is when the city celebrates its German heritage with Oktoberfest. The original Oktoberfest began in Germany to celebrate the marriage of King Ludwig I. Back then, the celebration lasted 16 days. Now the people of Fredericksburg celebrate for three days each year.

During the festival, there is plenty of German music, like oompah, polka and waltzes. There is even a waltz dancing competition. There is lots of German food to sample too. Everyone enjoys sampling the German sausages and strudels, a sweet pastry usually filled with fruit.

Irish Texan Celebrations

Immigrants from Ireland were some of the first people to settle Texas. Most of them came to Texas so they could own their own land. They were a hardworking group of people who were used to hard times. They were some of the first to sign up to defend Texas against Mexico during the Texas Revolution. There's even a town in the Texas panhandle called Shamrock. Today many communities in our state celebrate St. Patrick's Day with parades, music, dancing and food.

A Green Celebration of Irish Culture

The North Texas Irish Festival has been held every year since 1983. Thousands of people enjoy three days of Irish heritage. The festival was organized to help people learn more about Irish culture. Plus, the fair is a lot of fun! There are Irish dancers and music and lots of crafts that are traditionally made in Ireland. There are also special games and fun for children. Many people enjoy eating Irish stew and soda bread, a special Irish bread made with buttermilk and raisins. Many people are sure to wear the color green, the traditional color of Ireland.

title: Juneteenth: A Special Name for a Special Day
text:
African Americans in Texas have a very special celebration each year on June 19. This day marks the day in 1865 that enslaved people in Texas heard the news of the end of the Civil War.

President Abraham Lincoln signed the Emancipation Proclamation in 1863. This document freed all the enslaved people in the Confederacy. During the Civil War, Texas was part of the Confederacy and was fighting for slavery. Texas, like many of the Southern states, didn’t obey the proclamation during the war.

So the proclamation gave enslaved people their freedom, but it took a war and nearly two years before they were freed.

The Civil War actually ended more than two months before enslaved people in Texas heard. In those days there were no televisions or internet to spread news. The people in Galveston, Texas, did not hear anything until June 19, 1865. This was when General Granger, from the Union army, rode into town and gave the news. The formerly enslaved people in Texas were excited. Finally they were free! There was plenty of singing and cheering that day.

Even today, African Americans still have special celebrations on that same day each year. In 1980, Juneteenth (short for June 19th) became a state holiday. Many Texas cities celebrate each year with parades, picnics and barbecues. Larger Texas cities celebrate with concerts, art shows and other celebrations of African American culture. People from all different cultures come together on this day to celebrate the freedoms of living in America.

title: What is the meaning of “E Pluribus Unum?”
text: "E Pluribus Unum" is the official motto of the United States of America. This motto is in Latin and is found on the Great Seal of the United States. The words mean "out of many, one." Our nation's founders wanted a saying that represents how all the states work together under the national government. Today many people think the saying also shows how many people from many different cultures make up our one strong nation.

title: Foods From Around the World
text:
Many of the foods we enjoy eating today come from many different cultures in different parts of the world.

Popcorn was first harvested by the Aztec tribes in Mexico. They didn't put butter on it. Popcorn was mostly used in religious ceremonies to please their gods.

Hamburgers were probably first made in Germany. They were known as Hamburg steaks. True hamburgers are made with beef. There has never been ham in hamburgers.

Ice cream has actually been around for 5,000 years. Believe it or not, the Chinese invented the treat while trying to keep sweet syrup cold by using snow and salt.

Ketchup is another food we can thank the Chinese people for. It actually began as a fish sauce known as ketsiap in the 1600s. America's favorite sauce didn't even arrive here until the late 1800s.
