title: Wages, Salaries, and Commissions
text:
People receive income in many different ways. The most common way that people earn income is through wages, or an amount of money paid for every hour of work completed. For example, a person working at a coffee shop might earn $12 for every hour that they work. If this person worked an eight-hour shift in a day, their wages for that day would be $96. When earning income through wages, the more hours you work, the more income you earn.

Another way that people may earn income is by working for a salary. A salary is a set amount of money paid to an individual for their work. An example of someone who is paid a salary is a teacher. Many teachers are paid a set amount of money each month or year to do their job. Usually, a person who earns a salary does not complete their work on a set schedule. A teacher may have to work longer hours, before or after school, to complete their job.

Some people earn income through commission. A commission is a payment that an employee makes when they sell something. Some employees earn commission in addition to wages or a salary, while other employees work only on commission. When an employee earns a commission, they make a portion of the sale in income.

A real estate agent is a good example of someone who earns income through commission. If an agent sells a house, they earn a commission based on the sale price of that house. For example, if a real estate agent earns a five percent commission on every house they sell and they sell a house for $100,000, they would earn $5,000 in commission. This might sound like the best way to earn income, but earning income from commission can be very difficult. Each form of income has its positives and negatives.

Hourly employees earn more income the more hours that are worked. However, there might be an opportunity to earn extra pay, or overtime, for hours worked beyond their work schedule. Hourly wages, however, might not be as secure as other forms of income. A business might limit the number of hours a person works based on the number of customers who come into their store or other factors.

Individuals earning a salary receive a set amount of income every month, and that can be very appealing to some. An individual earning a salary, however, might have to work many hours beyond their regular work day to complete the job. For a person working on commission, it would depend on the amount of commission that could be earned, and they might earn more income than most. This income is not guaranteed like a salary, though. In many cases, if an individual working on commission does not sell their product or service, they do not receive income.

Regardless of the way that people earn an income, each person is performing an important role in their community.

title: Interest
text:
Did you know that you can earn income by lending someone some of your money? Interest is another form of income that people might earn. Sometimes, people need to borrow money in order to buy things they need or want. They may borrow money from a bank, a company, or another person, who is often called a lender. The loan, or money borrowed, must be paid back to the lender within a certain amount of time.

The person borrowing money has to pay interest on the loan. Interest is the amount of money a lender or financial institution receives for lending out money. For example, if a person borrows $100 from a bank, the bank will charge interest on that loan. When that person pays back the loan, they will have to pay $100 plus the interest charged. You might be wondering where banks get the money that they loan to people and business. That money can come from you. If you have a bank account that earns interest, the bank is paying you to allow them to use your money.

title: Renting Property
text:
Another way that people can earn income is through rent. Rent is a fee paid by someone to use another person’s property. The most common thing that people pay rent for is housing. If someone is not able or does not want to buy housing, they might pay someone rent to live in their house or apartment. Renting is not just for housing, though. People rent many other types of property. Automobiles and tools are other examples of property that someone might rent.

Some people purchase property for the purpose of renting it to others. For example, a person might already have a home but purchase another one to rent to others. The rent they receive for the rental house is a form of income. That income might help pay for the property or enable the person to purchase more property. Individuals who do this are called entrepreneurs.

title: Entrepreneurs
text:
Wally “Famous” Amos. James Robert Cade. Christina Saralegui. What do each of these individuals have in common? They are all Floridians who started successful businesses. Someone who starts a business is called an entrepreneur. Entrepreneurs do not know if their new business will be successful, but they take the risk in order to make a profit, which is another form of income. Each person who starts a business sees a need in their community and offers their services or products to meet that need. Let’s look at a few of Florida’s famous entrepreneurs.

Wally “Famous” Amos

Wally “Famous” Amos was born in Tallahassee in 1936 and loved his Aunt Della’s cookie recipe. After moving to Los Angeles and working for a modeling agency, Amos turned back to his aunt’s cookie recipe. He perfected the recipe, opened a cookie shop, and started the Famous Amos Cookie Company.

Dr. James Robert Cade

Dr. James Robert Cade was a professor of medicine at the University of Florida in Gainesville. He had a distinguished career and conducted many research projects. The project that made him famous was a drink for treating dehydration. It became known as "Gatorade™" and is famous worldwide.

Cristina Saralegui

Cristina Saralegui is a Cuban-American media personality and entrepreneur who moved from Cuba to Florida when she was 12 years old. After working in the media industry for many years, Saralegui founded her own magazine and started her own talk show. Her talk show is one of the most popular Spanish-language television shows in Florida. Saralegui’s family risked their lives to come to Florida, and she made the most of her opportunities.

Do you have an idea for a product that people might want to buy or use? You, too, can be an entrepreneur!

title: Needs and Wants
text:
What are some of your basic needs? Food, shelter, clothing, sleep, love, education, safety, medical care, and others may come to mind. A need is something that you have to have every day to survive. We need certain things to stay safe and be healthy. The things that we need every day don't change with time. We need air to breathe. We need food and water to survive. We need a safe place to live. Clothing is a need that helps keep us safe by keeping us warm or cool. Needs are things you must have in order to survive.

In addition to your basic needs, you might also have other needs. Some of your needs may be different from those of your classmates. If both of your parents work, you may need a place to go after school until they return home. If you have a special medical condition, you may need to take medicine each day. You may also need special tools, such as a wheelchair, crutches, or an inhaler to help you be successful each day.

A want is something that you would like to have but can live without. It is something that you can wait for. Not everyone wants the same things at the same time. You may want a new bike or a new video game. Someone else may want a new book. Wants are things that are optional. You don’t need them to survive.

Sometimes, it's difficult to decide whether you want or need something. Each of us makes these choices throughout the day. We go through the process of determining the positive and negative consequences of purchasing our wants. We evaluate if it is still a need or a want. Then, we choose what would be best for us.

Each day, everyone must make decisions about needs and wants. The most important thing is that we take care of all of our basic needs first. Afterward, we can start taking care of our wants. When you make a decision, you usually can’t have it both ways. For example, you can’t eat only junk food and still be healthy. Likewise, you can’t spend money on new furniture for the house and still have enough left over to buy groceries. By choosing one thing, you decide not to choose the other, at least for the time being.

When people earn an income, they look at how much they must spend on their needs. They often create a budget, or a plan for keeping track of their money. A budget lists all of their expenses, or things that must be paid for for the month. A budget also lists resources, or money a person has available for spending that month.

Additionally, there are items that aren’t part of the regular monthly budget. When making responsible decisions, people should first pay for everything they need. Then, they can use what's left over to buy things they want. To make good choices, we must learn to see the difference between needs and wants. We must plan wisely so all of our needs are taken care of before we start fulfilling our wants.

title: Spending Choices
text:
You need to buy a new pair of shoes. How do you pick which ones to buy? The least expensive ones? The ones with the coolest advertisement? The ones that your favorite athlete or celebrity is wearing? All of these factors and more can influence how we spend our money. Every time you spend money on something, you are making a choice.

Some of the factors that influence your spending choices are advertisements and commercials that companies or individuals use to call attention to their product or service. Others include price, or the cost, and peer pressure, or influence from your friends or other individuals. The decision to spend your money on a product or service is an important one and should be based on good information. If you make a decision that is not based on good information, you might end up wasting your money on a product or service that is not right for you.

title: Spending
text:
It is necessary for people to spend some of their income on items or services that they need and items or services that they want. Needing something and wanting something are two different things. For example, if the wheel on your bicycle breaks, and you rely on your bicycle for transportation, you need to repair or replace it. You may want to replace it with the most expensive wheel that is made of the coolest materials, but doing so may not be the best way to spend your money. Spending all of your money on all of the items you want might mean that you will not have money left to pay for other items or services that you need. Decisions about how you spend your money are very important ones to make.

When people decide to buy an item or service, there are many ways to do so. If they have the cash, a person can exchange that cash for the item or service. People can also use credit or a loan to buy goods or services. Credit or a loan is when someone borrows money to make a purchase and then pays it back over time. When you borrow money through a loan or credit, you must pay back that money with interest (the fee you pay for borrowing the money). Sometimes, it is necessary to buy goods or services this way. For example, not everybody has enough cash to buy a house or a car.

Borrowing money from a bank is the most common way for people to buy property or housing. By doing this, you can receive something of value now and pay for it over time. In the example of buying a house, it might take a person 15 to 30 years to pay back that loan. Even though that might seem like a really long time to pay back a loan, buying a house or property is an investment. An investment is something that a person buys now with the aim of gaining more money from their purchase in the future.

An important part of making wise decisions about spending is to create a spending plan. By creating a spending plan, you can make sure that you have money for the items or services you need and save money for the items you want. A spending plan is an important tool to help you plan for the future.

title: Saving
text:
All income a person earns is either spent or saved. As you’ve read in this week’s articles, it is important to make good financial choices. Creating a budget, or spending plan, and making sure that you save some of your income is important for your future. There are some goods and services that people must spend money on, like food, clothing, housing, and taxes. However, choosing how much money to spend on some of these items (like the kind of food or clothing that you buy) will impact how much of your income is left for you to save for the future.

One way to make sure that you save money for the future is to create a savings goal. For example, if there is a new skateboard or piece of sports equipment that you want but don’t have the money now to pay for it, a savings goal can help you identify how much money you need to save over time to be able to afford it.

Some people save their money in a bank or credit union, and they earn interest. In that case, you are lending money to the bank, and the bank is paying you. Banks and credit unions are safe places to save money because they guarantee that the amount of money deposited will be protected until you need it.

title: Investing
text:
If there was a way to buy something now and sell it later for more money in the future, would you do it? That is the whole idea behind investing. Some people take money that they have saved and invest it in something like property or a business. The idea of investing your money is the expectation that the value of what you’ve invested in will grow in the future.

A house or property is a good example of an investment that many people make. When someone buys a house, they often take out a loan from a bank for the price of the house. When that person sells their house in the future, they take the money that they earned on the sale and pay off their loan. If they sold the house for more than the cost of the loan, the money left after paying off the loan is income for them. Another way that people invest their money is by buying stock, or a small part of a company. If the company makes a profit because the goods or services they provide are popular, then the stockholders share in the profits.

Investing money does come with risks. There is no guarantee that what you invest in will increase in value. While there are great rewards for investing, it is possible that your investment will lose value. When making decisions about investments, people consider the risks and rewards of what they’re investing in. If the risks of making the investment are greater than the rewards, then it might not be a wise investment. Just like with any decision you make, you need to rely on good sources of information to make a wise decision.

title: Donating
text:
Whether spending, saving, or investing your money, your decisions should be based on good information and advice. This article is about another way that a person can “spend” their money: donating to a charity. A charity is an organization that is set up to help people in need. Donating is giving money, goods, or services to a charity to help others and expecting nothing in return.

For example, a person might donate money to an organization that provides food or shelter for people in need, and that money will help to buy food or items that people need to survive. They might also donate goods and items that they no longer need or use so that others in need might be able to use them.

Another thing that people might donate is their time. For example, a person might volunteer to participate in a park cleanup or help at a local food bank. While they will not receive income for their work, they are helping the organization do their part to make their community a better place. People must make good decisions about where to donate their money, time, or goods. Just like a person should research the best products to buy or the best way to save their money, you have to make sure that the charity you are donating to has a good reputation for helping the community.

Donating money to help others is an important act of community service and could be a part of a person’s spending or savings plan. Just like you can invest in property or a business with the expectation that your investment will grow in value in the future, when you donate your money, time, or goods to a charity, you are investing in something that will help other people get what they need to have a better future.

title: Setting Financial Goals
text:
The articles in this week’s publication have focused on helping you understand the importance of making good financial decisions about your income. One of the most important things a person can do to achieve what they want is to set a goal. Just as a person who wants to get healthier has to set goals about their diet and exercise, you have to set goals about spending and saving to make sure your budget is healthy. Once you set a goal, you have to create a plan to reach that goal. Using the diet and exercise example, you can’t expect to get healthier and be able to run 10 miles overnight. You have to start small, like running half a mile a day to build up your strength and endurance.

Making a plan to reach your financial goal is the same thing. If you want to save your money for a new bicycle that costs $250, you have to create a plan that is SMART. SMART is an acronym that stands for Specific, Measurable, Attainable, Realistic, and Timely.

Setting a SMART financial goal to save money for a new bicycle might look something like this:

Specific: You need to save $250 for a new bicycle.

Measurable: You need to know how much money you have and how much money you still need to save.

Attainable: You have a good plan to earn the amount of money you need to save each week.

Realistic: The amount you save will be an amount that you can afford to save after all of your spending.

Timely: You will save money each week over a specific period of time until you have enough to meet your goal.

Putting that all together, your SMART goal to save $250 for a new bicycle might be:

“I will save $10 per week for the next six months in order to save $250 for my new bicycle.”

While the thought of saving $250 for something you want might seem very difficult, making a SMART financial goal can help you make it happen.

Now it’s your turn. Create a SMART financial goal for yourself.

title: Risks and Rewards
text:
Picture yourself standing at the top of a skateboard ramp. You have been practicing your riding skills for weeks. You are wearing a helmet and all the protective gear you need to be safe. Still, as you look over the edge of the ramp, you think to yourself, “What could go wrong? Could I get hurt?” Then, you think about how good it will feel to accomplish something you’ve been working toward for a long time. You lean forward, and down the ramp you go!

The scene above is an example of someone assessing, or considering, the risks, or possible harm or loss, and rewards of taking an action. We assess risks and rewards every day. Sometimes, the risks and the rewards are small, and other times, they are very large. In the example above, the reward of successfully riding the skateboard ramp was greater than the risk, so you took the chance. Falling down was a risk you were willing to take.

The idea of risk and reward also applies to the choices we make with our money. When someone invests money in something like a house or other property, there’s a risk that the investment will not be successful. However, the reward of a successful investment can be great, and this is why people take risks. The other articles this week will discuss the steps that people can take to minimize, or lessen, the consequences of taking a risk. Just like a skateboarder wears gear to protect themselves in case of an accident, people can do things to protect themselves against harm, both physical and financial, in the event that something bad happens to them.

title: Taking Precautions
text:
In the last article, you read about standing on top of a skateboard ramp and considering whether or not you should try out your new skills. You had to weigh the potential outcomes of skating down the ramp: the risks of trying something new versus the reward of being successful. What you may not have noticed in that scenario is that you took some precautions to protect yourself in some ways from the risk of being hurt. You could avoid the risk of harm altogether and not try riding the skateboard ramp. In the scenario, you took precautions to reduce the risk of being hurt by wearing a helmet and protective gear. By practicing your skateboarding skills before attempting the ramp, you also reduced the potential risk that you would get hurt.

The same can be true for making decisions with investing money. Precautions, such as researching the potential investment and discussing your financial plan with a trusted person (such as a financial advisor or bank advisor), can help reduce the risk that might be a part of the investment. Talking with other investors is another way that someone could learn more about the investment and decide if the financial risk is worth it.

Just like trying out new skateboarding skills on a ramp, making a financial investment can be risky. Even when you wear a helmet and protective gear, it won’t eliminate all of the risk that is involved with skateboarding. The same is true for financial investments. The more you prepare ahead of time, the greater your knowledge and the more you will reduce any risks you may encounter.

title: Insurance
text:
One precaution that people take when there is a risk that something bad may happen to themselves, their loved ones, or their property is buying an insurance policy. Insurance is a financial agreement that provides protection against a possible loss. There are many types of insurance. The most common types of insurance are health, life, home, and automobile insurance. Each provides some sort of protection or support in the event of an emergency. For example, many health insurance policies allow a person to visit a doctor or hospital when they are sick or in need of medical attention, and the visit or medical attention they need does not cost the patient as much as it would cost without insurance. Home and auto insurance work in a similar way. If something happens to your home or you get into a car accident and you have insurance, the insurance company will pay to replace or repair the damage. Life insurance is a little different. Many life insurance policies pay the family of a person after they die. These policies can be very helpful for a person’s loved ones if something unfortunate happens to them.

You might be asking yourself, “How do insurance companies make income if their job is to pay for fixing people’s houses and cars?” To have an insurance policy, you pay a company an amount of money each month to keep it active. Since accidents do not happen all the time, insurance companies usually take in more money than they have to pay out. Even insurance companies, however, take a risk by offering insurance policies. If a natural disaster (like Hurricane Michael, which you’ll read about in the next article) takes place and a whole community needs insurance companies to help rebuild, it can be very expensive. However, this is a risk that companies are willing to take.

It is very important to have insurance in place to protect your loved ones and your possessions. Even though you might pay for insurance your whole life and may think you will never need to use it, it will be there if you do need it.

title: Preparing for the Unexpected
text:
Sometimes, events happen that we don’t have any control over. That doesn’t mean that we can’t be prepared to face unexpected events. In 2018, a very powerful and destructive storm named Hurricane Michael made landfall from the Atlantic Ocean in the Florida panhandle region. This hurricane was classified as “Category 5” status, which is the strongest level a storm can reach. It had winds that blew up to 160 miles per hour. Hurricanes can cause major damage to homes, businesses, and even loss of life for humans and animals.

The people of Florida are not unaware of the risks of living in a state near the Atlantic Ocean, where hurricanes happen. Since the year 2000, almost 100 major hurricanes, tropical storms, or other serious storms have made landfall in Florida. Hurricane Michael was, by far, the strongest hurricane to hit Florida and the United States since Hurricane Andrew in 1992.

For many Floridians, the risk of a hurricane is often balanced with the reward of living in a beautiful state that has an abundance of natural beauty and commerce. Many people prepare ahead of time to reduce the risk of damages from a hurricane by having a family emergency plan. This can include having extra clothes and food placed in backpacks with other emergency gear, purchasing extra supplies, such as flashlights and batteries, having insurance on valuables, and listening to evacuation orders if or when they are given.

While not all of the risks that come from a hurricane can be prepared for, it is still a good idea to be as prepared as possible. Running out of emergency supplies, food, or water or not being able to get to an evacuation shelter may have serious consequences for people, their loved ones, and their pets. Not having insurance on homes, cars, or other important personal property can have negative consequences. If a person still owes money on a home or car that is damaged or lost in a hurricane, they still have to pay any outstanding debts they owe if they aren’t insured. Fortunately, people can prepare ahead of time for the risks that come from hurricanes to the best of their ability.

title: Saving for Emergencies
text:
While humans can’t control how, when, or where a hurricane will strike, there are other ways that we can be prepared for the financial costs that come from hurricanes. In addition to having insurance on important items, such as houses and cars, another way to prepare for an emergency is to have an emergency savings account. This is a special savings account that has money set aside only to be used in case of an emergency, such as a hurricane. This emergency savings account can be created as part of your financial plan.

How you decide to save money in this account may depend on your current financial situation. For example, a small amount of money can be added to the savings account from each pay period or in a larger amount several times a year. Having an emergency savings account in a bank is important, even if someone has insurance. Sometimes, it may take a while for insurance companies to assess the damages from a large disaster, such as a hurricane, and be able to pay on the insurance policies. Having an emergency savings account can provide short-term financial assistance during a natural disaster, since money will be more easily accessed from a bank.

Emergency savings accounts can help pay for unexpected costs that may come up if there was an emergency, such as a hurricane. The saved funds can go toward unexpected expenses. These expenses could include paying for a new place to live, renting a car, purchasing food, clothing, other basic necessities, and more.

Having an emergency savings account may also be important if your place of work is damaged in a hurricane and can no longer provide a source of income. The emergency savings account can help with paying for living expenses while the business is being rebuilt or if another job must be found. Preparing for unexpected emergencies through an emergency savings account is another way that Floridians can help reduce the risk of the impact that hurricanes and other natural disasters may have on their lives.

title: Emergency Preparedness
text:

Review the articles from this week. As you review, write ideas and notes that you think would be important for the public to know in your poster. You can use this chart to write your ideas:

title: Week 22 Inquiry Question
text: How does the inquiry process help with learning?

title: Sectionalism
text:
By the early 1800s, the United States was becoming very large. It covered half a continent. The people who lived in the various parts of the United States developed very different opinions on slavery.

People in the Northern states often lived in cities, worked in factories, and had some education. People in the Southern states often lived in rural areas, worked on farms and plantations, and had limited opportunities for education. The North depended on underpaid workers in their factories. The South depended on enslaved workers in their plantations.

The differences between the Northern and Southern states led to sectionalism. Sectionalism is when a person puts the needs or values of their smaller group over the needs or values of their larger community.

The Southern states were sectional because they upheld slavery, which hurt America’s enslaved people. The Northern states were sectional because they wanted to abolish slavery, which would have hurt the South’s economy.

Both the Northern and Southern states wanted their opinions on slavery to be applied to any new states. The Northern states wanted new states to be “free,” where slavery was not legal. The Southern states wanted new states to legalize slavery. Sectionalism in the United States became extreme. It would soon lead to the Civil War.

title: Marjory Stoneman Douglas
text: Before the year 1947, many people thought of the Florida Everglades as useless land. A Florida woman named Marjory Stoneman Douglas changed how people thought about the Everglades. She wrote a book called The Everglades: River of Grass. In her book, she talked about how important the Everglades are. She helped people see that the Everglades were an important water source for people and animals. She helped people see that the Everglades needed to be protected. The same year the book came out, the Everglades area was made into a National Park. In 1969, Douglas started a group called “The Friends of the Everglades.” This group still works to make sure the Everglades are clean and protected today.

title: Essential Question
text: Who are some people who represent Florida?

title: Andrew Jackson
text: Florida experienced big changes during the 1800s. In 1821, Spain gave up control of Florida to the United States. The U.S. government made Florida a new territory. They did this by combining East and West Florida. Andrew Jackson was a military hero of the War of 1812 and defender of West Florida. He was made the military governor of this new territory. This was not an easy job for Jackson. This was because the people living in Florida had different ideas about how things should go. They often did not agree with Jackson. Jackson organized a new government in the Florida territory. He organized Spanish and British land claims. He helped with the peaceful transfer of power from Spain to the United States. Later, Jackson became president of the United States in 1828.

title: Gloria Estefan
text: Many Cuban immigrants and people of Cuban descent have played a huge role in the economy, government, and culture of Florida. Musician Gloria Estefan moved from Cuba to Miami when she was a young girl. When she was 18, she joined a band called the Miami Sound Machine. During her time in this band, she helped make Latin American music popular in the United States. She also spread awareness of the contributions of Cuban Americans in the United States. In 2015, Estefan and her husband received the Presidential Medal of Freedom. This honor was given to them for their contributions to music and Latin American culture.

title: Bob Ross
text: Have you ever heard of the painter and TV sensation Bob Ross? He was a very popular artist back in the 1980s and ‘90s. He didn't start painting until later in his life. As a young adult, he served in the military. He discovered his love of painting after attending a painting class. At first, he painted for fun and as a way to make extra money. Later, he started making more money from painting than from the army. He decided to leave the army and devote all of his time to painting. Ross eventually started a TV show in 1983 called “The Joy of Painting.” The show played for 11 years. It reached millions of viewers all over the world. Viewers loved Ross’s cheerful and friendly attitude. Ross died in 1995. But the influence of his joyful approach to painting is still alive today.

title: Zora Neale Hurston
text: Zora Neale Hurston grew up in Eatonville, Florida. During college, she studied folklore and earned a degree in anthropology. Anthropology is the study of cultures, communities, and how they develop. She studied African and Caribbean cultures and their folklore. She traveled throughout the American South and the Caribbean. She recorded the stories of the people she met. She began her writing career by publishing short stories. In 1935, she wrote her first book, called Mules and Men. Mules and Men centered on the stories, folklore, sermons, and songs she heard as a child in Eatonville. Her first book was a success. Her second book became her most famous work. This book was called Their Eyes Were Watching God. It was based on her life and experiences. After publishing several books, Hurston traveled around Florida. She interviewed formerly enslaved people. She recorded their stories and wrote about her experiences. Hurston's writings give readers a glimpse into the lives of Floridians during this time.

title: John Young
text: John Young was born in 1930. As a boy, Young loved to learn. He loved reading and building model airplanes. When he grew up, he became a famous astronaut. He worked for NASA for 42 years. He was one of the pioneers of space travel. He was known for his bravery and commitment. He was the first person to fly into space six times. He landed on the moon and drove a lunar rover. He spent three nights on the moon before coming back to Earth. After he stopped flying to space, Young continued to work for NASA. Young helped with many space missions.

text: Research someone from your community who represents Florida. What do they do? How are they a good representative of Florida?

title: Resources
text:
A resource is material people can use. Things like food, air, and water are resources. Resources help us meet our needs and wants. People use three main types of resources in their daily lives. These are natural, human, and capital resources.

People depend on resources to survive. They need resources to produce goods. If a resource is limited, the production of a good could also become limited. For example, if the weather destroyed a citrus crop used to make orange juice, the cost of orange juice may go up. Also, the product supply for orange juice could be much smaller than usual. It’s important for people and communities to use resources wisely. This way, we make sure there will be enough for us to use in the future.

title: Americans with Disabilities Act
text:
One law that protects the unalienable, civil, political, and economic rights of people living in the United States is the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Congress passed the Americans with Disabilities Act in 1990. Its purpose is to “prohibit discrimination against people with disabilities in several areas, including employment, transportation, public accommodations, communications and access to state and local government programs and services.”

The Americans with Disabilities Act is divided into five titles, or sections. Each title has a specific purpose.

Title I: Protects against discrimination in the workplace and ensures that people with disabilities receive appropriate accommodations in their workplace

Title II: Ensures access to services, facilities, and transportation provided by local and state governments

Title III: Prohibits discrimination in public places and requires that people with disabilities receive appropriate access to facilities

Title IV: Requires telecommunications companies to provide equal services to people with disabilities

Title V: Defines various types of disabilities and prevents retaliation by employers, organizations, other people, etc. against individuals who enforce their rights under the act

By protecting unalienable, civil, political, and economic rights, governments can ensure that all citizens have the right to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness. These rights also ensure that governments cannot interfere with the right to life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.

title: Connecting the World
text:
New Jersey lies between two major cities: Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, and New York City, New York. New York City has the largest population of any city in the United States. Many important businesses are headquartered there, including businesses in the financial, retail, and manufacturing industries. Philadelphia is also one of the most populated cities in the country. Important industries there include food processing, oil refining, and education. Not everyone who works or attends school in these cities live nearby. Thousands of people rely on New Jersey’s transportation systems to get them to their jobs, schools, and homes every day. New Jersey’s trains and buses also carry passengers to other nearby cities.

New Jersey’s Port Newark-Elizabeth Marine Terminal also plays an important role in transportation. The Port Newark-Elizabeth Marine Terminal is the busiest container port on the East Coast. Every day, container ships sail into the port, carrying goods like food, clothing, computers, and cars. The containers are unloaded and then sent to destinations across North America. They travel along New Jersey’s railroads, rivers, and roads. Containers with goods from the United States are loaded onto the waiting ships. Then, the container ships sail out of Newark Bay and travel across the ocean to deliver the shipments to other countries.

Just a few miles away from the port, the Newark Liberty International Airport is also busy transporting goods by cargo plane. Of course, those aren’t the only planes flying in and out of the airport. More than 15 million passengers passed through the airport in 2020. Some passengers are traveling to other cities or even other continents. Some are coming home to New Jersey from locations around the world. Other passengers are arriving for vacation in the Garden State.

Every year, millions of people visit New Jersey. Many things draw people to the state. Visitors can explore the natural characteristics that make New Jersey unique, like its beaches, forests, and lakes. They can enjoy resort areas, such as Atlantic City. They can even connect with the history of the United States at New Jersey’s historical sites.

New Jersey may be one of the smallest states in the U.S., but it connects the world together.

title: Themes of Geography: Location
text: Remember, the term “location” refers to a particular place. It answers the question “Where is something located?” Relative location tells us where something is in relation to something else. The absolute location of a place is its exact location. We use a coordinate grid to describe something’s absolute location.

title: Themes of Geography: Place
text: The theme of place refers to how we describe a location. This theme includes the physical and human characteristics of a place. Physical characteristics are part of the natural environment, like forests, oceans, and rivers. Human characteristics come from human ideas and interactions that people have with their environment. Human characteristics include political boundaries, buildings, bridges, homes, and other human-made features.

title: Equal Rights for Everyone
text:
The Changing Face of Our State and Our Country

Thanks to the civil rights activists we've studied the last two weeks, African Americans became a force in education, business and politics. Between the mid-1960s and the early 1970s, schools, offices and government began to change from mostly white to multicultural.

Edward Brooke of Massachusetts became the first African American to be elected to the U.S. Senate in more than 85 years. Thurgood Marshall was sworn in as the first African American Supreme Court Justice. Here in Alabama, Arthur Shores was elected to serve on Birmingham's City Council, and Johnnie Ford of Tuskegee became the first African American mayor.

Many African Americans were also hired as police officers, firefighters, and teachers during the 1960s. Leroy Stover became Birmingham's first African American police officer, and other major cities stopped hiring only white officers as well. Leon Kennedy was named Assistant Superintendent of Jefferson County Schools.

Today, there are many African Americans who serve their communities as elected officials and public servants. They have finally been granted full rights as American citizens: the right to live and work where they choose, the right to a good education, and the right to vote for candidates they believe will best represent them.

The Civil Rights Act of 1964

Because of the sacrifice, courage and dedication of the civil rights workers of all races, Alabama is a better place to live. Their protests forced Congress to pass the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which made segregation of all public places illegal. It guaranteed that an African American woman would never again be told to give up her seat on the bus. It allowed all children to attend the same schools and play in the same parks. It meant that African Americans could enter a restaurant through the front door and did not have to drink water from different fountains. It assured that never again would a child feel the way that Martin Luther King Jr. felt when a curtain was pulled to separate his family from white passengers in a dining car. The law also made it illegal for employers to refuse to hire someone just because of their race.

The Voting Rights Act of 1965

The Selma to Montgomery March drew attention to the need for voting rights for all citizens. Not long after the march, Congress passed the Voting Rights Act of 1965. This law made it illegal for states to make people take tests or pay poll taxes in order to vote. Before the law was passed, some states had rules that said a person had to be able to read, pass a test, or pay a tax if they wanted to register to vote. After the Voting Rights Act, states were still allowed to make up their own rules for voter registration, but those new rules could not take away the constitutional rights now guaranteed by the Voting Rights Act. That meant that citizens no longer had to pass a test, pay a tax, or prove they could read in order to vote. As a result of this law, the percentage of African Americans who were registered to vote grew from around 10 percent to nearly 65 percent in less than 10 years. Many also decided to run for political offices, and Alabama quickly became one of the states with the highest percentage of African American elected officials.

The Civil Rights Act of 1968

The first Civil Rights Act changed many things, but African Americans still faced discrimination when they looked for a place to live. In 1968, Congress passed a new Civil Rights Act, which was also called the Open Housing Law. This law made it illegal for anyone, no matter their race, to be denied the right to buy or rent homes. As a result, African Americans could choose to live wherever they wanted to live. Slowly, neighborhoods across Alabama and throughout America began to be more integrated. For a long time, some cities did not always follow the law. It took many years and lots of lawsuits for things to improve.

title: Understanding Climate
text:
New Jersey has a continental, or temperate, climate. This means it has warm summers and cold winters. Climate is the average weather conditions of a place over an extended period of time. The Office of the New Jersey State Climatologist (ONJSC) at Rutgers University keeps track of New Jersey’s climate data. The following chart shows New Jersey’s average temperature each month, based on data collected between 1991 and 2020.

Scientists use many factors to classify the climate of a region. The most important criteria are precipitation, vegetation, seasons, and temperature. In this graph there are two countries with the same climate classification as New Jersey. There are two other countries on the graph with climates that are different from New Jersey. What similarities and differences do you see between these countries and New Jersey?

title: The Impact of Human Activity
text:
Human activities shape the world in many ways. As communities grow, buildings take over natural habitats. Roads are essential for transportation, but those roads also impact natural habitats. Over the past half century, roads have widened to make room for more cars. Factories generate goods that people need, but they also generate pollution. Innovations in transportation, manufacturing, energy, technology, and other industries all change the environment of a place, including the physical and human characteristics.

These photographs show how the environment of New Jersey has changed over time. The New Jersey Turnpike was built in the 1950s. Over the years, the turnpike was widened, repaired, and improved. As a result, the physical environment changed. Construction caused animals to lose their habitats. Greenhouse gas emissions from cars have contributed to climate change. Changes to the turnpike also affected the human environment. The turnpike improved transportation, and new businesses, like gas stations and restaurants, grew to accommodate travelers.

What kind of environmental consequences do you think the New Jersey turnpike caused in neighboring states, like Pennsylvania, Delaware, and New York?

title: The Civil Rights Movement in Alabama
text:
16th Street Church Bombing

On September 15, 1963, a bomb exploded at the 16th Street Baptist Church in Birmingham. The church was a center for the African American community in town. The blast killed four girls: Addie Mae Collins, Denise McNair, Carole Robertson and Cynthia Wesley. Twenty-two others were injured.

The murder of African American children shocked people around the world. Alabama's governor at the time was George Wallace, a strong supporter of segregation. Martin Luther King Jr. told him that his attitudes created an atmosphere of violence. "The blood of four little children ... is on your hands," he said to the governor.

This tragedy brought a great deal of attention to the Civil Rights Movement. People who did not know much about the movement earlier saw the need for equal rights to be protected. Many realized that African Americans could not be equal if they faced such terrible violence. The support that came to the Civil Rights Movement helped the passage of the Civil Rights Act of 1964.

University of Alabama

In 1954, the Supreme Court ruled on Brown v. Board of Education. It was decided that schools must desegregate. It would take years for this to become a reality as racism still pervaded in Alabama and the country.

In 1963, the governor of Alabama, George Wallace, gave a speech, declaring, "I say segregation now, segregation tomorrow, segregation forever." Later that year, he stood in the doorway of a building at the University of Alabama. Governor Wallace hoped to stop two African Americans from enrolling. President Kennedy took control of the Alabama National Guard, who then asked Wallace to step aside.

Activism in Montgomery

Montgomery is located along the Alabama River in south central Alabama, and it serves as the state capital. The city was also the original capital of the Confederacy during the Civil War.

During the 1950s and 1960s, Montgomery became an important part of the Civil Rights Movement. Like most cities in the South during this time, Montgomery was a segregated city, meaning that African Americans and whites were separated in public places. African Americans and whites sat apart on public buses, ate in separate restaurants, and used separate restrooms and drinking fountains.

Rosa Parks’s refusal to give up her seat on the bus to a white man led to the famous Montgomery bus boycott. This lasted from early December 19 55 to late December 1956 (381 days). During this time, African Americans refused to ride the city buses. The city lost thousands of dollars from lost bus fares. The boycott finally ended when the courts ruled that segregation of buses was unconstitutional.

In 1965, Martin Luther King Jr. led the famous march from Selma to Montgomery in support of voting rights for all African Americans. The march ended at the state capitol building in Montgomery, where King gave a speech to more than 25,000 people, pleading that the rights of all Americans be protected. The Voting Rights Act of 1965 was passed later that year.

If you visit Montgomery, be sure to visit the Rosa Parks Library and Museum, the Dexter Avenue King Memorial Baptist Church, and the Selma to Montgomery National Historic Trail.

title: Mary McLeod Bethune
text:
Mary McLeod Bethune was born in 1875. Her family was not wealthy. Bethune worked hard to help support her family. When she was nine years old, Bethune was given the opportunity to go to school. She grew up in a time when most African Americans were not allowed to attend school. She was a dedicated student. Eventually, she was able to go to a college in North Carolina.

Bethune knew that the education she and other African Americans got was not the same as the education that white people got. She wanted to change that. She decided to start a small school in Daytona, Florida. It was called the Daytona Normal and Industrial Institute. It was especially for African American girls. People in the community helped her build the school. Her school is still there today, and it is now called Bethune-Cookman University.

Bethune eventually met and became friends with powerful leaders in Washington, D.C. One of her friends was Eleanor Roosevelt, whose husband Franklin was the president of the United States. Bethune and Eleanor both fought against discrimination. In 1936, President Roosevelt asked Bethune to work with him. She became the director of a group that advised the president on African American matters. The work of this group made it possible for African Americans to work where previously only white workers had been allowed to work. All her life, Bethune continued to work to get equal rights for all people.

title: Essential Question
text: Who are some people who represent Florida?

title: Janet Reno
text: Janet Reno was born and raised in Miami. As a young girl, she used to go to work with her father, who was a newspaper reporter for criminal trials. This experience made a great impact on Reno. She went to Harvard Law School and got a degree in law. She worked as an attorney in Florida for several years. Attorney is another word for lawyer. Later, she ran for a position in Dade County and was elected. She served as Dade County’s district attorney for 15 years. In 1993, Janet Reno made history when she became the first woman U.S. attorney general. This meant she had the highest government position available as an attorney. She stayed in this position for a long time. She was the longest serving attorney general in the century.

title: Josiah Walls
text:
Josiah Walls was born in 1842. He was born enslaved. As a young man, he was freed. He went to school and served in the army. Walls served in the Union Army during the Civil War. After he served in the army, he worked as a teacher in Gainesville, Florida. By 1868, he had enough money from working to buy a farm.

He was later drawn to participate in government. He wanted to make a positive difference for others. He began his political career by representing Alachua County in the 1868 Florida Constitutional Convention. The same year, he also ran for and won the political position of state assemblyman. He was elected to the Florida State Senate a year later. He was one of five men serving in the Florida Senate who had formerly been enslaved. Walls was a strong supporter of education and economic opportunities in Florida for all races.

In 1872, Walls became Florida’s first African American member of the House of Representatives. In the political circles of Washington, D.C., African American representatives were met with opposition. Few established members of Congress worked with them or treated them as colleagues or members equal in their work. Being a leader of the African American population took great courage. Walls overcame deep political divisions. He was the only African American representative from Florida until the early 1990s. Throughout his political career, Walls worked for the good of Florida. He worked for improvements to be built, such as telegraph lines, courthouses, and post offices. He worked to improve Florida’s harbors and rivers.

title: Jacqueline Cochran
text: Jacqueline Cochran was one Floridian who made a difference in her community and the world. Cochran was born in 1906 in Florida. After working for some time as a beautician, Cochran trained to become a pilot. She earned her pilot’s license in 1932. During World War II, many American men left their homes and went to war. This left many jobs open that needed to be filled. The United States military decided to train women to fill these jobs. They wanted women to fly military planes. These women were known as the Women Air Service Pilots, or WASPs. Cochran was chosen to lead the WASPs. They flew new military aircraft to places where they were needed. They also delivered supplies to many places. It was a dangerous job, but the WASPs were willing to help their community and country. Cochran contributed greatly to civic life in the United States. She continued to train pilots. She also worked with NASA to test female pilots who wanted to become astronauts. She set and broke many records in flying. She was also awarded the Distinguished Service Medal for her service.

title: William Pope Duval
text: William Duval was born in Virginia in 1784. He left home at the age of 14. He eventually settled in Kentucky to study law. In 1821, President Monroe made Duval a federal judge in the Eastern District of the Florida Territory. Later, President Monroe made Duval a governor of the Florida territory. Duval was the first civil governor of the Florida territory. Andrew Jackson had served as a military governor before Duval. Duval served as the civil governor for 12 years. While governor, Duval made many contributions to the Florida territory. He helped establish peaceful relations with Florida’s Native American people. He revised the code of laws that were used. He created a board of education to help grow schools. He established Tallahassee as the capital of the territory. He helped determine land boundaries. He served as a senator in the Florida legislature from 1839 to 1842. He did many great things for Florida. Duval County is named after him.

title: William Dunn Moseley
text: Florida has had many governors. It has also had several first governors. Andrew Jackson was the first military governor. William Duval was the first civil territory governor. William Moseley was the first governor after Florida became a state. This means he was the first state governor. Moseley was born in North Carolina in 1795. As a young man, he studied law and became a lawyer. He moved to Florida in 1835. Ten years later, Florida became the 27th state of the United States in 1845. The very first Florida State election happened that year. Moseley ran for the position of state governor and won. As governor, Moseley made many contributions to Florida. He encouraged the development of agriculture in Florida. This meant growing citrus, avocados, and cotton. He wanted state-funded public schools to be established. The state capital was completed during his first year as governor. After his service as governor, he moved to Palatka. There, he became a citrus farmer.

title: John Young
text: John Young was born in 1930. As a boy, Young loved to learn. He loved reading and building model airplanes. When he grew up, he became a famous astronaut. He worked for NASA for 42 years. He was one of the pioneers of space travel. He was known for his bravery and commitment. He was the first person to fly into space six times. He landed on the moon and drove a lunar rover. He spent three nights on the moon before coming back to Earth. After he stopped flying to space, Young continued to work for NASA. Young helped with many space missions.

title: Research a Local Person Who Represents Florida
text: Research someone from your community who represents Florida. What do they do? How are they a good representative of Florida?

title: United States Government
text:
The United States has a representative democratic government. This means people elect those who represent them in the government. We call these people elected officials. People elect officials at local, state, and national levels. At every level, people’s consent is what gives the government power to act. The Constitution defines how elected officials work together. It defines the principles and structure of our government.

Countries face many problems. Some solutions may be good for most people but limit the freedom of others. A representative democracy must balance individual rights with the common good. Effective leaders work to meet the needs of citizens and protect their rights.

In the United States, we have a federal government that leads our country. The federal government shares its power with state governments. The federal government has the power to:

print money

declare war

build the military

make treaties (agreements with foreign countries)

make rules for doing business between the states and foreign nations

create post offices and issue postage

make laws to enforce the constitution

State governments control laws within each state. They also have elected officials. The leader of the state is the governor. The governor appoints officials and signs or vetoes bills passed by the state legislature. The governor is also the commander-in-chief of the state’s military. Each state has its own constitution. Like the United States Constitution, state constitutions must enforce laws in ways that protect the rights of citizens.

We also have local governments. They lead our towns, cities, and counties. Cities and towns elect leaders called mayors. People also elect city managers, town councils, and county commissioners. These officials address community concerns, help out in the community, and act as a voice to the community. Local governments are in charge of police and fire departments, public bus systems, road maintenance, community parks, trash removal, and building codes.

title: Three Branches of Government
text:
To keep any one person or group from having too much power, the Constitution divides the government into three branches. We call this a system of checks and balances. Each branch was designed to address specific issues and concerns. Each branch has its own structure, processes, and leaders. These leaders use different processes as checks to protect individual liberties. Individual liberties are rights that the government cannot take away. For example, the president may veto legislation passed by Congress. A veto can stop a bill from becoming a law, but Congress can override the veto with a two-thirds majority vote. Congress also has checks on the president. For example, the Senate must confirm executive appointments. The courts can check Congress by declaring laws unconstitutional. This basic structure of the national government is also used to guide the development of state and local governments.

The three branches of government are the executive, legislative, and judicial branches. The executive branch of government enforces our country’s laws. It is also in charge of the military. The head of the executive branch is the President of the United States. The president is chosen by voters. The president and vice president are elected together for four years. They may serve two terms, for a total of eight years. The president chooses members of the cabinet to advise him or her. Cabinet members are often experts in their fields. They help run the executive branch by leading departments. For example, the Department of Defense is in charge of the military. At the state level, the executive branch includes the governor, departments, and agencies that enforce state laws.

The legislative branch makes the laws and sets taxes. Congress is the legislative branch of our government. It is divided into two parts: the Senate and the House of Representatives. Two senators are elected from each state. A state’s number of representatives depends on how many people live there. Larger states send more representatives. Smaller states send fewer. Today, there are 100 senators in the Senate and 435 representatives in the House. All of them were elected by the people of their states.

The judicial branch interprets the laws, or decides what they mean. It also determines whether the laws follow the Constitution. The judicial branch is headed by the Supreme Court. The Supreme Court is made up of judges called justices. They are chosen by the president and voted on by senators. State supreme courts are similar to the U.S. Supreme Court. They decide whether laws go against their state’s constitution. The judicial branch also includes other federal courts and local courts. Local courts decide whether someone is guilty of a crime. The judicial system’s role is to make sure the law is followed and all citizens’ rights are protected.

title: Democratic Principles
text:
Americans have different customs, traditions, and ethnic origins. Americans are united by the principles of a republican form of government. The Constitution says that we need to respect individual rights and freedoms. These democratic principles are the foundation of the American government. They include justice, fairness, equality, and the common good. These principles have influenced new laws and policies over time at the local and national levels of government.

By creating and enforcing laws, citizens can ensure their rights are protected. Respecting the rights of others means that everyone is treated equally. An example of equal treatment is access to buildings for all citizens. This is done by adding ramps, elevators, and parking spaces for people with disabilities.

Fairness, equality, and justice are principles that have influenced government and laws. Fairness is a fundamental American value. Fairness is about making sure that everyone has what they need to be successful. Our government supports fairness by making laws to keep things fair for everyone. All people should be treated equally. Equality means that all people are treated the same, regardless of who they are. Our government provides services and protection to all citizens. Justice means that people behave in a way that is fair, equal, and balanced for everyone. Fairness, equality, and justice are democratic values. These values guide our government. They protect the rights of citizens.

title: Rule of Law and Common Good
text:
Rule of law is based on fairness, equality, and justice. It means that the government is accountable to the law. The government can only use its power as defined by laws. There are four important ideas with the rule of law:

Laws have to be adopted and approved through government processes.

Laws have to be clear, and everyone needs to know about them.

Laws are applied equally for all citizens.

When there are disputes about the law, individuals will have representatives who are neutral to deliver the best outcome.

Rule of law means that both citizens and government leaders must obey the same laws. Every citizen, including police officers and politicians, should follow the same rules and have similar consequences if they break the law. Rule of law means that all government officials and all private citizens must follow the laws of the nation, state, and community. Everyone must be treated equally under these laws.

The common good is when people think about what is best for everyone. It refers to decisions that benefit most members of a community. In a democratic community, citizens act to support the common good. Our government supports the common good through laws. If citizens work together toward the common good, freedom and self-government can be successful. Everyone in the community benefits.

title: Conflict Resolution and Problem-Solving
text:
We can overcome conflict by engaging in civil discourse. Civil discourse helps people live peacefully together and define a problem in a kind way. You practice civil discourse when you talk in appropriate ways with other people to build understanding. Although there are people with different opinions in a debate, civil discourse reminds us to treat others with respect. As American citizens, we have the right to free speech. This means we can express ourselves freely. However, we also have a responsibility to be polite and listen to others when they are speaking. Civil discourse allows for both of these things to happen.

People can overcome conflict by taking steps to solve a problem:

Engage in civil discourse by stating the problem.

Identify the cause of the problem.

Suggest solutions for the problem.

Attempt to solve the problem.

Reach out to experts to brainstorm possible solutions. Some experts may include teachers, parents, and community helpers.

title: Purpose of Government
text:
The purpose of the United States government is to protect citizens' rights and promote the common good. The government works because it receives power to act from its citizens. The Constitution defines how elected officials work together in our government. A representative democracy must balance individual rights with the common good. Then it can advocate for the needs of all citizens.

One way the government can be sure to protect and meet citizens' needs is through taxes. Taxes are fees that citizens pay for services. Taxes are also added to the cost of goods and services. The government uses tax money to pay for community services that make our lives better. Government services ensure safety, well-being, and opportunities for citizens to participate in the community. Examples of government services include police and fire departments who protect us and keep us safe. Health clinics are provided as a government service. Parks provide recreation and protect wildlife. Schools and libraries are also a government service. Services are paid for by citizens' taxes.

title: The New Deal
text:
In 1933, the United States was in the middle of a great economic depression. In that same year, Democrat Franklin Delano Roosevelt was sworn in as the new president of the United States. As president, Roosevelt faced many challenges. One of the greatest challenges was finding a way to bring the country out of the Great Depression.

The New Deal was the title Roosevelt gave to the expansive new plan he and his advisors introduced. This plan was meant to bolster the economy of the country. The New Deal created government agencies to assist the poor, elderly, farmers, and millions of unemployed Americans.

The Civilian Conservation Corps (CCC) was a New Deal program. It provided jobs for millions of single young men between the ages of 18 and 25. The Agricultural Adjustment Act (AAA) helped cotton and tobacco growers find relief. The AAA paid farmers for not planting as many crops. If farmers produced less, the value of the products would increase.

The Social Security Act (SSA) was another part of Roosevelt’s New Deal legislation. The SSA provided direct help to working citizens in need. Under the plan, the SSA made monthly payments to all Americans who had temporarily lost their jobs and could not find work. The government taxed workers’ salaries. This meant that when a person reached a certain age, usually 65, they could receive a monthly payment or pension from the government.

The Banking Act was created to regulate banking procedures and ensure the safety of customers’ deposits. The act gave the president the power to reopen stable banks and provide assistance to failing banks. The act also created the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC). This organization ensured that if a bank failed in the future, customers’ deposits at the time would be refunded up to $2,500.

title: Alabama Unionists
text:
Not everyone in Alabama agreed that the state should secede from the Union. One committed supporter of the Union was Charles Christopher Sheats.

Sheats was a 22-year-old schoolteacher who lived in Winston County, located in northern Alabama. In 1860, the people of Winston County voted for Sheats to represent them at Alabama’s secession convention. At the convention, he refused to sign the ordinance of secession. He campaigned against secession. State authorities arrested him, charged him with treason, and put him in jail.

About a year after the convention, some Unionists gathered at Looney’s Tavern in Winston County. They passed a resolution saying that if Alabama seceded from the Union, then Winston County should secede from Alabama. They passed another resolution saying that Winston County wanted to remain neutral in the war. Not everyone in Winston County agreed with these resolutions. They asked Alabama’s governor to require the Unionists to take a Confederate loyalty oath. The governor ordered that Unionists in Winston County be arrested.

Neither the Confederate nor the Alabama governments let the Unionists in Winston County remain neutral. They tried to force Unionists in Winston County to join the Confederate Army. Many Unionists ran away and joined the Union Army. They formed the First Alabama Cavalry. Winston County became a place where Southerners who wanted to join the Union Army could secretly gather.

Winston County was sometimes trapped between the armies of the Union and the Confederacy. Both armies raided the county, vandalizing their property, and even killing some of its citizens.

After the Civil War, Winston County was heavily Republican. The rest of Alabama supported Democrats. A statue stands in front of the Winston County Courthouse in Double Springs. It shows a man dressed in half a Union uniform and half a Confederate uniform. It symbolizes the county’s divided loyalties.

title: The Ordinance of Secession
text:
Title

An Ordinance to dissolve the union between the State of Alabama and the other States united under the compact styled "The Constitution of the United States of America"

Paragraph 1

Whereas, the election of Abraham Lincoln and Hannibal Hamlin to the offices of president and vice-president of the United States of America, by a sectional party, avowedly hostile to the domestic institutions and to the peace and security of the people of the State of Alabama, preceded by many and dangerous infractions of the constitution of the United States by many of the States and people of the Northern section, is a political wrong of so insulting and menacing a character as to justify the people of the State of Alabama in the adoption of prompt and decided measures for their future peace and security, therefore:

Paragraph 2

Be it declared and ordained by the people of the State of Alabama, in Convention assembled, That the State of Alabama now withdraws, and is hereby withdrawn from the Union known as "the United States of America," and henceforth ceases to be one of said United States, and is, and of right ought to be a Sovereign and Independent State.

Paragraph 3

Sec 2. Be it further declared and ordained by the people of the State of Alabama in Convention assembled, That all powers over the Territory of said State, and over the people thereof, heretofore delegated to the Government of the United States of America, be and they are hereby withdrawn from said Government, and are hereby resumed and vested in the people of the State of Alabama.

Paragraph 4

And as it is the desire and purpose of the people of Alabama to meet the slaveholding States of the South, who may approve such purpose, in order to frame a provisional as well as permanent Government upon the principles of the Constitution of the United States,

Paragraph 5

Be it resolved by the people of Alabama in Convention assembled, That the people of the States of Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Louisiana, Texas, Arkansas, Tennessee, Kentucky and Missouri, be and are hereby invited to meet the people of the State of Alabama, by their Delegates, in Convention, on the 4th day of February, A.D., 1861, at the city of Montgomery, in the State of Alabama, for the purpose of consulting with each other as to the most effectual mode of securing concerted and harmonious action in whatever measures may be deemed most desirable for our common peace and security.

Paragraph 6

And be it further resolved, That the President of this Convention, be and is hereby instructed to transmit forthwith a copy of the foregoing Preamble, Ordinance, and Resolutions to the Governors of the several States named in said resolutions.

Closing

Done by the people of the State of Alabama, in Convention assembled, at Montgomery, on this, the eleventh day of January, A.D. 1861.

title: Take a Closer Look
text:
The Ordinance of Secession was created in January of 1861. It was the official document telling the United States that Alabama was no longer a part of that union. Even though the document is not very long, it is packed with important ideas. Taking a closer look at the text can help some of those ideas become clear.

The title of the document is, "An Ordinance to dissolve the union between the State of Alabama and the other States united under the compact styled 'The Constitution of the United States of America.'" What does the word "dissolve" mean to you? What do you think it means in this context?

The constitutional convention adopted The Articles of Confederation in 1777. According to the title, what was the author’s purpose in writing the Ordinance of Secession in 1861?

Take a closer look at Paragraph 1. How do the authors of the Ordinance feel about Abraham Lincoln and Hannibal Hamlin?

How would you summarize paragraph 2 in your own words? Why is “withdraw” an important word in this paragraph?

Paragraph 3 talks about power. According to this Ordinance, is power going to the national government or to the state governments?

In paragraphs 4 and 5, the state of Alabama is setting a date to meet with some other states. Based on evidence from the article, what do you think Alabama wants to meet about?

The Civil War started on April 12, 1861. How far apart were the Ordinance of Confederacy and the beginning of the Civil War?

title: Was Secession a State Right?
text:
One reason many Southern states gave to justify their secession was states’ rights.

Just before the Revolutionary War, the 13 original states banded together under the Articles of Confederation. The Articles said that “Each state retains its sovereignty, freedom, and independence.” It also said that the states had agreed to join together in a “league of friendship” that “shall be perpetual” (last forever).

Under the Articles of Confederation, the national government was weak. The states mostly governed themselves. But it soon became apparent that the national government was too weak. Some groups staged revolutions that the national government didn’t have the resources to stop. The new country was threatening to break apart. The Constitution was written to create a stronger national government.

When Abraham Lincoln was elected as president, the Southern states said that the national government wanted to take away their ability to run their economy by outlawing slavery. They felt that the only way they could retain their sovereignty and keep their economy running was to secede from the Union.

The national government disagreed. The Articles of Confederation said that the Union would be “perpetual.” The Constitution did not address secession, but it was written to “form a more perfect Union.” As Abraham Lincoln said in his Gettysburg Address, the United States was “dedicated to the proposition that all men are created equal.” In his view, state sovereignty did not allow states to take away human rights. He felt that the national government was justified in stepping in to ensure human rights.

title: Unionism in the Gettysburg Address
text:
Southern states wanted to secede from the Union when Abraham Lincoln was elected as president. Lincoln wanted to make the country more unified. That meant change. The United States is a very large country. It has a wide range of people, economies, technologies, and geography. Meeting all the needs of the country is challenging.

Slavery was the issue that people were the most divided about. There were other problems too, such as trade and tariffs (taxes on imports and exports). Abraham Lincoln was aware of these economic problems. When he was a lawyer, one of the cases he defended involved a boat that hit a bridge crossing the Mississippi River. Should the river stay open and safe for old-fashioned boats? Or should the river have bridges for trains?

In his Gettysburg Address, Lincoln said that the Civil War was a test to see if a country that was based in freedom could survive. Freedom meant making room for change and growth. Lincoln thought states would have to change to serve the good of the nation as a whole. That kind of change was much easier for states based in industry. It was harder for states that were based in agriculture.

The democracy that Lincoln promoted was a “government of the people, by the people, for the people.” This meant that all people should have a voice and that all people should be paid for their work. It also meant that new technology should serve the people.

With the Gettysburg Address, Lincoln said that all states needed to be united as one country in freedoms, economy, technology, change, and growth.

title: What's in This Nest?
text:
Nest making is an important skill for many birds to have. People might believe that birds live and sleep in their nests all year long. Actually, birds only use nests for laying eggs and raising their young.

Birds make nests in all kinds of places. Many people know about the birds' nests found in trees. Some birds make nests on the sides of cliffs, underground, or even on water. Some birds barely make nests at all. They lay their eggs on sand or gravel and a few twigs and sticks. Some birds build nests to last a long time. They return to them year after year. Bald eagles make strong nests that last. Other birds build nests they will only use once. Hummingbirds create very small nests for one season.
