Looking at multiple perspectives can give us a deeper understanding of what happened in the past. When we read about people, places, and events in history, it's important to try to identify if what we read is fact or opinion. A fact is something that can be proven true through evidence. An opinion is a statement that expresses someone’s feelings or beliefs.

In the study of ancient civilizations, however, sometimes there is not enough evidence to prove whether something is fact or opinion. This is the case with China’s Xia dynasty. People are divided about this period in Chinese history. The culture and the actual existence of this dynasty have been debated by scholars for many years. The following are three different viewpoints about the question “Was there a Xia dynasty?”

Yes

Archaeological evidence shows that villages began to form in the Yellow River Valley sometime around 5000 B.C.E. Researchers have found tombs, bronze works, and pottery made on potters' wheels. These objects prove that an organized society existed long before the rise of the Shang dynasty. These small villages developed centralized governments. The first government was the Xia dynasty. It began around 2070 B.C.E. Oral history says that the first Xia king, Yu the Great, repaired the damage caused by a great flood. He built walls and canals to control the floodwaters and organized irrigation systems. Because of this, he was given the right to rule. Archaeologists have found evidence of a great flood from the Xia time period.

No

The Xia dynasty is a story that has been told, retold, and changed over generations. Yu the Great is simply a character from myth. The Xia dynasty is said to have continued for hundreds of years, but there are no written records from that time period. Recently, some scholars have started to classify artifacts as coming from the Xia time period. But none of the excavation sites can be proven to belong to the Xia dynasty. The objects and buildings could easily be classified as early Shang dynasty. It’s even possible that the Zhou dynasty invented the legends about the Xia to justify their right to rule. King Wen of Zhou needed the people to believe he had been granted power from Heaven to take over the kingdom. King Wen could have created the idea of a Xia dynasty so he could say that the Shang rulers were evil and wrong to overthrow the Xia.

Maybe

There is no direct historical evidence that proves the existence of the Xia dynasty. However, there is also no reason why such a dynasty could not have existed in China’s prehistory. The beginnings of Chinese civilization clearly go much further back than the Shang dynasty. For centuries before, villages were advancing and developing new technology. There is early evidence of kingdoms and courts. This leaves room for us to believe that there was an early ruler in Northern China. The Shang dynasty may have been the first one with written records, but that does not mean it was the first dynasty.

title: Mountains
text:
A mountain is an area of land that is at least 1,968 feet taller than the land around it. Mountains have peaks at the top with sloping sides. They can have sharp or rounded shapes. Mountains are found on every continent and even under the ocean. It takes millions of years for mountains to form. They are formed from movement of the Earth's crust. Mountains are shaped over time by weather. Rich minerals are found in the core of mountains. Mountain peaks are often covered in snow. The snow melts and sends water down the sides in streams, creeks, and brooks.

There are many mountain ranges in the United States. The Rocky Mountain range is the biggest mountain range in North America. It begins in Canada and extends through central New Mexico. Many of the peaks are more than 12,000 feet high. Mount Elbert in Colorado is the tallest peak in the range at 14,433 feet. Thousands of tourists flock to the Rocky Mountains each year to explore their natural wonders.

The Appalachian Mountains are located in the eastern part of the United States. The highest peak is Mount Mitchell at 6,684 feet. The Appalachian Trail runs the length of the mountain range, which is about 2,000 miles long. Outdoor adventurers and hiking enthusiasts hike the Appalachian Trail throughout the year.

title: Physical Environments of South America
text:
South America is a continent of geographical extremes. Soaring mountains, massive rainforests, one of the longest rivers, and the driest desert in the world all call this continent home. South America’s geography includes many different kinds of physical features, such as the Amazon River, the Andes Mountain range, and the Brazilian Highlands. The continent is surrounded by the Pacific Ocean, the Atlantic Ocean, and the Caribbean Sea.

The Amazon River is located in the northern region of the country of Brazil. The Amazon Rainforest surrounds the river and all of the tributaries that flow to it. The rainforest is a diverse biome with more species of plants than anywhere else on Earth. Its location on the Equator guarantees a warm, wet climate year-round, which supports the massive amount of plant life there. Because of this, there is no part of North America like the Amazon Rainforest.

The Andes Mountain range runs down the entire western length of South America. As the second-tallest mountain range in the world, the Andes are the location of the highest point in the Western Hemisphere: Cerro Aconcagua. No mountain in North America is as tall as Aconcagua, which is over 22,000 feet high. South America features other mountainous regions in areas of Brazil and Colombia as well.

In the far northern reaches of Argentina are the Iguazu Falls, one of the great wonders of the world. The waterfalls are a part of the Iguazu River. The river begins in an area of South America known as the Brazilian Highlands. The Iguazu River flows south from this elevated, rocky terrain through Brazil, and into Argentina. The river meets the rugged land along the border of the two countries and creates these magnificent falls. The diverse terrain of South America creates the perfect conditions for many rivers to crisscross the continent.

title: Mountains and Landforms in South America
text:
South America is home to several mountain ranges. The longest and tallest mountain range is the Andes Mountains. At over 4,000 miles long, it is the longest mountain range in the world. The Andes are so long that more than half of the countries in South America are home to the range. They stretch from Venezuela in the north; through Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Bolivia; and to Chile and Argentina in the south.

The Andes dominate the entire western coast of South America. Their height, as the second-highest mountain range in the world, affects the climate of the entire continent by influencing weather patterns and rainfall. They are so tall that there are glaciers at the upper elevations that stay frozen, and some areas are covered with snow year-round. The Andes are also a part of the Ring of Fire that runs along the edge of the Pacific Ocean, featuring volcanic activity.

Following the mountain range into Ecuador, the Andes go along the Pacific Ocean coastline where another group of mountain ranges, or cordilleras, run into the Amazon basin. Going from Ecuador into Peru, the Andes break into three more cordilleras and have a glaciated summit called Mount Huascaran. This is Peru’s highest mountain peak.

Continuing into Bolivia, the cordilleras create a landform called the Altiplano. The Altiplano has formed a variety of depressions, hills, and vast plains in central South America. This has created different marshes and lakes within Bolivia. As the Andes reach their southern point in Chile, they go below the sea and form a multitude of islands with steep slopes.

The largest country of Brazil does not contain any portion of the Andes Mountains. Instead, Brazil has several smaller mountain ranges. The Serra Do Mar mountain range runs along the country’s Atlantic coast. In some parts of the range, the mountains run so near to the ocean that they make up the coastline. The Serra Do Mar mountains are not one continuous mountain range, but rather several smaller ranges. These ranges transition to the Brazilian Plateau as they move inland. The Brazilian Plateau is a larger area of rugged highlands where much of the country’s minerals are located.

Outside of the Andes Mountains and the ranges of Brazil, Colombia is home to the Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta range. These tall mountains are right along the Colombian coast. Like the Andes, the tallest peaks do not lose their snow in the summer months. The mountains have been declared a biosphere reserve by The United Nations Educational, Scientific, and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) to protect its natural resources and beauty.

title: River Basins in South America
text:
The Amazon River basin is the largest in the world. It takes up a large portion of Brazil, as well as parts of Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Guyana, Peru, Suriname, and Venezuela. Overall, the Amazon River basin takes up close to half of the land on the continent. On the west, the Amazon basin borders the tall mountains of the Andes. Water runoff from these mountains feeds the Amazon River as it winds its way through the basin. Other highlands and mountain ranges to the north and south divert more water into rivers that eventually meet up with the Amazon. The massive size of the Amazon basin captures so much water that more water flows from the river into the ocean than the next six largest rivers in the world combined.

The Orinoco River basin lies to the north of the Amazon River basin. The Guiana Highlands separate the two basins. Rainfall in the northern highlands flows into the Orinoco basin, while the rain that falls in the southern highlands flows into the Amazon basin. The Orinoco basin covers most of Venezuela and some of Colombia as well. Like the Amazon, it has a massive output, with the third-highest amount of water worldwide flowing out through the Orinoco River.

The La Plata River basin is located to the south of the Amazon basin and is separated from it by highlands. Like the Amazon, much of the water in the La Plata basin flows from the heights of the Andes Mountains in the west. The La Plata basin is made up of smaller river basins that form rivers like the Paraguay, Uruguay, and Paraná Rivers. The La Plata basin occupies all of Paraguay, most of Uruguay, southern Brazil, portions of Bolivia, and much of northern Argentina.

title: Coastal Plains in South America
text:
The coastal plains of South America are generally dry, especially the low flat ground between the Andes Mountains and the Pacific Ocean. Running along the coast from Peru down through Chile, the western coastal plains are situated in the rain shadow of the Andes. This area includes the Atacama Desert in Chile, widely accepted to be the driest desert in the world outside of the polar regions. Although it is extremely dry, its coastal location keeps it cooler than many other deserts around the world. In the northern coastal plains of Peru, the temperatures can be much higher.

Brazil has a long Atlantic coastline that includes some coastal plains. The northern and eastern coastlines are low-lying areas that receive relatively little rainfall. The Brazilian Highlands are just inland from these coastal plains and divert moisture away from the flat land along the coast. The Brazilian coastal plains are sandy, given their location in the low-lying areas along the ocean. Some sections of the coastal plains support forests, while others feature less vegetation.

title: Climate of South America
text:
The climate of South America is determined primarily by latitude and elevation. Latitude measures distance from the Equator. Locations closer to the Equator are warmer and wetter throughout the year. Farther from the Equator, it becomes drier and colder. South America spans from just north of the Equator to just a few hundred miles away from Antarctica. Elevation measures how far above sea level a location is. Temperatures usually drop the farther above sea level you go. South America’s coastline is at sea level, and the tallest mountains are over 22,000 feet tall. These geographical extremes give South America a diverse climate.

The Equator runs through the northern part of South America through countries like Brazil, Colombia, and Ecuador, which takes its name from the Equator. The area around the Equator is known as the tropics. For this reason, the climate in this area is known as a tropical climate. Tropical climates are warm year round and can be wet or dry depending on how much rain they receive. Wet tropical climates, like the Amazon Rainforest in Brazil, can get hundreds of inches of rain per year. Dry tropical climates, like those found in Venezuela and the parts of Brazil farther from the Equator, are warm year-round but are usually drier.

Toward the southern parts of South America, the climate changes. Moving away from the Equator, the climate gets cooler and drier. The far southern reaches of the continent go from semi-arid to arid, or mostly dry to very dry. Far from the wet atmosphere of the tropics, these areas get very little rainfall throughout the year. The southern part of the continent is smaller, so most of South America is in the northern, tropical climate zones.

One exception to this is the elevation of the Andes Mountains that run the western length of the continent from north to south. Although the Equator runs through the Andes, the mountains are so tall that those areas remain cold year-round. Glaciers of ice never melt at that elevation, even in the tropics. Mountains also create rain shadows, or places where rain cannot reach because the mountains block the rain clouds. The Atacama Desert in Chile is the driest desert in the world and sits just to the west of the Andes Mountains.

The major differences in latitude and elevation throughout South America create a diverse continental climate. These differences impact the amount of warmth and water in any given location. The amount of heat and precipitation affect the plant growth in these areas, from mostly barren deserts to lush tropical forests.

title: Biomes of South America
text:
Biomes are ways to categorize areas based on what type of wildlife there is and what vegetation grows there. Grasslands, forests, and deserts are all examples of biomes. The type of vegetation that grows in a place depends primarily on the climate and also on the type of soil and other growing conditions. For a continent like South America, which has a variety of climates, there are also a diverse set of biomes. Biomes are part of the physical characteristics of a place. They describe what kind of plants can live there, which also determines the kinds of animals that can survive there as well.

In general, plants need water and warmth. Places that get plenty of heat and rain year-round have the most vegetation. Where it is colder or drier, the plants must adapt to these conditions. Fewer plants are able to do this, so those areas have fewer species of plants.

Areas along the Equator in South America receive the most heat and rain throughout the year. This region is home to the Amazon Rainforest. The rainforest features many species of plants, and the coverage is so complete that in some places, the sun does not reach the forest floor. Other areas near the Equator, in places like Ecuador, Colombia, and Brazil, receive the same year-round temperatures but less heat. In these areas, the biome is a tropical grassland, also known as a savannah. It is still quite warm, but it lacks the precipitation to support large forests like a rainforest.

Deserts feature plants that have adapted to dry conditions and do not need much water to survive. Deserts can be cold or hot and can also change between the two during seasonal changes. The deserts of South America are located in the far southern areas of the continent and the western strip of land between the Andes Mountains and the Pacific Ocean. The distance from the Equator makes the southern tip of the continent too dry to support many plant species. The rain shadow of the Andes Mountains keeps moisture from reaching the western deserts like the Atacama.

In between the extremes of heat and cold are biomes located in temperate climates, which are not too hot and not too dry. Temperate biomes can be forests or grasslands, depending on how much rainfall they get. The elevation of the Andes Mountains creates conditions where temperate forests can grow, especially in the middle elevations. At higher elevations, the cold temperatures limit the types of plants that can survive. The Patagonian temperate forests located in Chile and Argentina are examples of this kind of biome.

title: Essential Question
text: What are the types of ways we can describe a physical environment in South America?

title: Title of Activity
text:
Producing Iron

Rich deposits of iron ore are found in Pennsylvania. Iron ore is a mineral. It is similar to a rock. Iron ore can be mined and processed to create goods. Iron ore needs to be processed. To do that, small chunks of iron ore are placed in a special oven called a furnace. Furnaces use fuel called "coke". Coke is made from coal. It burns at a high temperature. The iron ore melts in the furnace. It makes a molten liquid. Molten means the ore has been liquified by heat. The molten iron can be poured into molds. This type of iron is known as “pig iron.” Pig iron can be melted, or fired, again. When it's melted again, it can be placed into larger molds for fencing, pipes, or rods.

Pig iron was used by blacksmiths. A blacksmith is a person who makes and repairs objects out of iron. The pig iron would be heated in a fire until red hot. Then, the hot iron would be shaped. Blacksmiths use hammers to shape it. They pound the hot iron on anvils. Blacksmiths shaped iron for wagon wheels, hinges for doors, horse shoes, tools for farmers, and more.

Iron furnaces were built across Pennsylvania. Places with an iron furnace often included the word “forge” or “furnace” in their name. Some of these places include Valley Forge, Greenwood Furnace, Hopewell Furnace, Helen Furnace, and Old Furnace.

Pig iron was brittle. That means it could crack and break. It couldn’t be made into large iron pieces. Through innovation, a new process was created to strengthen the finished iron. Small amounts of limestone were added to the coke and ore mixture. The limestone helped to burn impurities, or non-ore material, from the iron. This created stronger iron. The stronger iron could be used for larger objects.

Creating Steel

In 1856, Henry Bessemer discovered that piping oxygen into the furnace increased the temperature. The high temperature burned more impurities out of the ore. This process created a strong iron called steel. The Bessemer process made steel that was stronger and unbreakable. The steel could be formed into large beams or long, squared pieces. Steel was used to create the frame or structure of buildings. These buildings could be taller and larger than buildings framed with wood. Steel beams could be used to make bridges over wide rivers. Construction in America increased with the use of steel.

As construction increased, more steel was needed. Steel production had to increase too. Larger furnaces were built. When many furnaces were built in one location, it became known as a steel mill. Many workers were needed to run the mills. Immigrants from Europe came to fill the positions.

Open hearth furnaces were used to make large quantities of steel. Open hearth furnaces had openings for the fire at floor level. They were open in order to add fuel. It would take six hours to melt the iron and remove the impurities. In 1900, there were 16 open hearth furnaces at the Homestead Steel Mill in Pittsburgh. The furnaces heated the iron ore to nearly 3000 degrees Fahrenheit. Each furnace would create 40 tons of molten steel every six hours.

Change in America

Pittsburgh, Sharon, Johnstown, and Bethlehem all had steel mills. Because of the steel industry, other businesses grew too. There were many jobs available in many businesses. This caused even more immigration from Europe. The increase in immigration created more demand for housing, food, and supplies.

During World War II, the steel industry created supplies and materials for the military. Tanks, vehicles, ships, and equipment were made from Pennsylvania steel. This supply helped achieve victory for the Allies.

Steel was key to changing America’s way of living, doing business, and using natural resources. All of it was centered in Pennsylvania.

title: Human-Environment Interaction
text:
One of the ways we study our environment is through human-environment interaction. This is how we adapt to or modify where we are. Humans have basic needs. We need food, clothing, and a place to live. The physical environment, including landforms, climate, and weather, influences where people settle, their jobs, and their lifestyles.

If you live on the beach, your environment includes the ocean, the fish, the trees, and the wind. We rely on resources in our environment to meet our needs. People who live near the ocean often eat fish. They use the wind to power sailboats. They use wood from trees to build homes to protect themselves from stormy weather. People usually choose to live close to resources that help them meet their basic needs.

title: Week 23 Framing Question
text: How does land use influence change in communities?

title: Land Use: Urban
text: People form communities based on how they use the land. When many people want to live in one location, the land is known as an urban area. Urban areas can also be called cities. In cities, buildings for business and homes are developed to be close together. Tall buildings with many floors, or stories, are built so many people can live on smaller pieces of land. Transportation in urban areas is organized to move as many people and goods as possible in and out of the city. There is less land available to grow food in urban areas. Food for many people has to be brought into the city.

title: Land Use: Suburban
text: A suburban community is formed when there are fewer businesses and people living in one location. There are fewer developed areas and fewer buildings. Living space on the land includes areas with no buildings. These spaces are yards, parks, and open lots or fields. Transportation systems in suburban communities are smaller. Highways connect goods and people to areas of business and houses. There is some land available for families to have small farms and grow food. Food is brought in to help feed the population in suburban communities.

title: Land Use: Rural
text: Rural communities have large spaces of undeveloped land. This land is used for large farms to grow food for the urban and suburban communities. Houses are far apart in rural communities. Businesses are built together in towns. There are not usually many public transportation options. Roads connect goods and people with towns.

title: Agriculture, Industry, and Services
text:
Agriculture means growing crops and raising animals to produce food and other products. The crops and animals used for agriculture depend on temperature, rainfall, and soil. For example, climates that have sunshine and enough rain are ideal for growing wheat and corn.

Industry is economic activity with the production of goods in factories. Like agriculture, industry is also affected by the environment. Factories require power and electricity, which is often fueled by water, oil, and coal. In order to transport goods produced through industry, factories must have access to oceans, rivers, or roads.

Services are another type of economic activity and include physical and virtual work environments. Services include marketing, design, software, and computing. Services also include entertainment, transportation, and public safety. Even in communities where the work activity is mostly agricultural or manufacturing, services are necessary to keep the economy growing.

title: The Vote for Women
text:
At the turn of the century, many people believed that women should only be homemakers. Many believed women were only supposed to take care of their families. They believed women were not supposed to be involved in politics or give public speeches. Women weren't allowed to own property, attend college, or work at high-paying professional jobs. Perhaps most importantly, women did not have the right to vote. Other people did not think women were being treated fairly.

By the 20th century, women were fighting for the right to vote. Women began forming political groups. One of these groups was the National Women's Party. It was led by a young woman named Alice Paul. Members of this group often marched in front of the White House, demanding to vote. The suffragists, as these women were known, faced much opposition in their fight for women's rights.

title: Week 27 Framing Question
text: What were the motives of the women's suffrage movement?

title: Seneca Falls Convention
text:
In 1848, around 300 people gathered at the Seneca Falls Convention in New York. This important meeting was the beginning of the women’s rights movement in the United States. The goal of the convention was to “discuss the social, civil, and religious rights of Woman.” A group of five women planned the convention in 10 days. Elizabeth Cady Stanton, Lucretia Mott, Martha Wright, and Mary Ann M'Clintock joined Jane Hunt in her home to begin planning. The committee created a "Declaration of Sentiments." This document details the purpose for the convention. It was created to match the Declaration of Independence. The declaration outlined ways women were being treated unfairly.

Elizabeth Cady Stanton was an outspoken supporter of women’s right to vote. This right to vote was known as suffrage.

We hold these truths to be self-evident: that all men and women are created equal ... In entering upon the great work before us, we anticipate no small amount of misconception, misrepresentation, and ridicule; but we shall use every instrumentality within our power to effect our object.

—Elizabeth Cady Stanton, "Declaration of Sentiments," 1848

The Seneca Falls convention became an example for other conventions of women’s rights to follow.

title: A New Age for Women
text:
In 1920, the 19th Amendment to the U.S. Constitution was sent to the states for ratification. If 36 states ratified it, all white women in the United States would be guaranteed the right to vote. Several states initially voted to reject the 19th Amendment. Eventually, however, 35 states had passed it. One more state was needed to make it official. Supporters of the amendment saw Tennessee as their best chance. People from all over went to Tennessee’s capital, Nashville, to both oppose and support it. Anti-suffrage activists wore a red rose and were against the amendment. Suffragists wore a yellow rose and were in favor of the amendment.

Tennessee Governor Roberts called a special session to vote on the amendment. Both houses of the Tennessee General Assembly had to approve the amendment. The Senate voted in favor, 25 to four. It came down to how the Tennessee House of Representatives would vote. As the members entered the House chamber, there were 48 yellow roses and 48 red roses. A tie vote would defeat the amendment.

Harry Burn was the youngest member in the House of Representatives.. He wore a red rose on his suit jacket. However, the morning before he cast his vote, he received a telegram from his mother. It said:

Hurrah and vote for suffrage! Don't keep them in doubt. I notice some of the speeches against. They were bitter. I have been watching to see how you stood but have not noticed anything. Don't forget to be a good boy and help Mrs. Catt [a suffragist leader] put the ‘rat’ in ratification.

When the speaker of the house called his name, Harry Burn said, "Aye," or "Yes," to ratification. Now, all white women in the United States had the right to vote.

title: Susan B. Anthony
text:
Many women have worked to improve the quality of life for women in the United States. One such woman was Susan B. Anthony. Anthony had worked as a schoolteacher. She was a leader in society. She supported the anti-slavery and women's rights movements.

After the Civil War, Anthony wanted formerly enslaved people and women to have the right to vote. They were disappointed when the 14th and 15th Amendments to the Constitution didn’t give women the right to vote. They didn't give up, though. Anthony traveled all over the nation to convince people to support her cause. She was once arrested and fined $100 for voting illegally in a presidential election.

Women did not gain the right to vote during Anthony's lifetime. The right came 14 years after her death. However, she influenced many other Americans to continue with social reform. Thanks to Susan B. Anthony, women today can vote on election day.

title: Timeline of Women’s Suffrage
text:
1848: The Women’s Rights Convention was held in Seneca Falls, New York. The "Declaration of Sentiments" was shared by Elizabeth Cady Stanton.

1850: The first National Women's Rights Convention was held in Worcester, Massachusetts.

1851: Sojourner Truth gives her “Ain’t I a Woman?” speech.

1861-1865: Suffrage efforts were halted during the Civil War. Many suffrage supporters became involved in the efforts to free enslaved people.

1878: A woman’s suffrage amendment was proposed to the U.S. Congress. Suffragists were allowed to testify in front of the Senate. Thirty thousand petitions were reviewed, but the amendments were postponed.

1890: Wyoming became the first state in the U.S. to allow women to vote.

1916: Jeannette Rankin was the first woman elected to the House of Representatives in Montana.

1917: Suffragists hold a parade on Fifth Avenue, displaying the signatures of one million New York women, demanding the right to vote.

1918: The House of Representatives passed the 19th Amendment. It fails the two-thirds vote requirement in the Senate.

1920: On August 26, 1920, the 19th Amendment was ratified.

title: China’s Dynasties
text:
A dynasty is a series of rulers who belong to the same family. Dynasties ruled over China for much of its history. Long before there were dynasties in China, there were villages. These were usually groups of relatives working together to farm and raise animals. Family relationships are strong in Chinese culture, and everyone in the village looked out for each other. In each individual family, when the father died, the oldest son would inherit the family’s property and have authority and responsibility over his family members. In time, villages transformed into kingdoms with kings who ruled over many villages. In the kingdoms, the same pattern was repeated. The head of the most powerful family governed the other families and created the rules. When the king died or was too old to rule, the oldest son inherited the throne.

The king and his officials collected taxes from farmers to pay for courts and luxuries. This increased their wealth and power. In time, surrounding families and kingdoms were brought under the control of one powerful family. This was the beginning of dynasties. Some say the first Chinese dynasty was the Xia dynasty. In legends, Yu the Great gained the power to rule when he became the first person to control the flood waters. However, the Shang is the earliest dynasty to be written down in history.

In the early dynasties, the head of the ruling family was king over all the land. When he died, another member of the family would take power, usually the oldest son. Dynasties continued in China for a very long time. Sometimes a ruling family was taken over and replaced by another family. The last Chinese dynasty ended in 1912 C.E. That means that dynasties ruled China for almost 4,000 years. Chinese dynasties created a powerful system of government. They divided a large kingdom into parts. Each part had a leader, and the leaders all served the king. The kings and emperors created schools to teach government and leadership. This helped them find well-educated officials to assist in running their kingdoms. These traditions have helped China to survive longer than any other civilization in the world.

title: Week 14 Framing Question
text: How did traditional values influence the development of Chinese society and culture?

title: The Mandate of Heaven
text:
Chinese rulers claimed to have the “Mandate of Heaven.” This meant that the guiding force of the universe, known as “Heaven” or “Sky,” had selected them to rule on Earth. An important part of the mandate was the understanding that a ruler was given this power because he was good and worthy. He had a strict duty to use his power for the good of his people. If he did not, terrible things could happen, and his right to rule would be taken away.

King Wen of the Zhou dynasty was the first ruler in Chinese history to claim he had the Mandate of Heaven. Legends tell of a battle when fewer than 50,000 Zhou soldiers were able to defeat well over 700,000 Shang soldiers. King Wen said this happened because the Shang rulers were evil. He claimed that the will of Heaven was for the Zhou family to replace the Shang family as rulers of China.

Kings and emperors claimed the Mandate of Heaven throughout the history of Chinese dynasties. This often helped them win the support of the people. However, it also meant that the rulers could be blamed for problems. When there were wars or natural disasters, some people thought it was a sign that the gods wanted a new ruler to take power.

title: The Shang and Zhou Dynasties
text:
Written records are especially important for learning about ancient civilizations. In China, the first people to leave written records lived during the Shang dynasty. Historians believe that the Shang dynasty came to power around 1600 B.C.E. It lasted about 700 years. There were 30 different Shang kings. The Zhou dynasty eventually conquered the Shang. The Zhou dynasty lasted for almost 800 years. It was the longest ruling dynasty in Chinese history. During these early dynasties, farming and trading grew. Artisans became very good at working with bronze. They made tools, weapons, containers, and musical instruments. They also made beautiful bronze works of art.

The Shangs developed a well-organized political system. It was based on a strict hierarchy. This means there were levels of authority based on a person’s importance, and everyone had a specialized role. There was also an aristocracy. This is a small group of wealthy people who are given power in the government. Local rulers looked after different areas of the kingdom. They made sure that everything was peaceful, that taxes were collected, and that the king knew what was happening. During the Shang dynasty, a feudal system began. This means that the farmers who lived and worked on the land had to give some of what they made to the feudal lords who owned the land.

The size of ancient China made governing difficult. The same geographic features that kept ancient China isolated from the rest of the world also made it hard to govern the growing country as one unified kingdom. The king lived in and ruled from a capital city. The Zhou dynasty is divided into two time periods: Western Zhou when the capital was in Xi’an in the west, and Eastern Zhou when the capital moved to Luoyang in the east.

During the Zhou dynasty, many changes happened. People began to work iron. Farmers created plows that could be pulled by oxen, and cities started large irrigation projects. All of these innovations increased food production. The population continued to grow, and the challenges of running such a large kingdom continued. To solve these problems, rulers built new roads and canal systems that improved transportation and communication. As China grew in wealth, the Chinese also had to defend against attacks from outside the kingdom.

After about 500 years of rule, the Zhou dynasty began to fail. The kingdom had grown so large that it was divided into smaller separate states, and the royal court had very little control over them. These smaller states were constantly at war with each other. Members of the aristocracy, who used to support the ruler, now worked to weaken him. Without clear leadership, the kingdom began to fall apart. People started forgetting peaceful traditions, and many important Chinese values began to fade.

title: Wise Teachings
text:
Confucius

As feudal lords fought over land and leaders became more corrupt, one government minister believed he should try to make things right in the world. His name was Kong Fuzi. He was later known outside of China as Confucius. Confucius was a scholar, teacher, and counselor. He was worried about what was happening in China and wanted to restore peace and stability. He tried to remind the people of their traditional values. He believed that everyone should treat others justly. One of his most famous teachings was, “Do not force on others something that you do not wish for yourself.” Confucian values weren’t just wise sayings; they were principles meant to help people change themselves and change society. His followers wrote down his ideas and continued to teach them after he died. The teachings of Confucius later became known as Confucianism. Though it is not an organized religion, the teachings are rules for thinking and living. They focus on self-discipline, love for others, respect for elders, and worship of ancestors.

Lao Tzu

Another honored thinker from this time of conflict was Lao Tzu. He is believed to be the author of a book called the Tao Te Ching, which means the Book of the Way. It teaches that “the Tao,” or “the Way,” is the natural force of life in the universe. Lao Tzu believed we should follow the Way by being thoughtful and living simple lives. This helps us learn the natural patterns of life and nature. Then we can make good decisions that follow those patterns. There is very little information about the life of Lao Tzu. In fact, there is not much evidence that he existed at all. Some scholars believe that the Tao Te Ching is really a collection of sayings from many different authors. The teachings of the Tao Te Ching are the basis of the religion called Taoism (also spelled Daoism). One of the main beliefs of Taoism is the idea of yin and yang, forces that balance each other.

title: A Duty to Respect
text:
Filial piety was one of the most important teachings from this time period in China. Confucius believed that families, society, and even governments are stronger when people obey their parents. Filial piety is about devotion to your family. It means you have a duty to be good to your parents, to take care of them, and to show them love and respect. In fact, you must respect not only your parents but all of your elders. This means your grandparents, older siblings, aunts and uncles, and elderly people in your community. It includes being good outside the home and bringing honor to your parents and family.

This belief is critical to the Chinese family structure. It is based on a hierarchy. Parents and older family members rank higher than children and younger family members. Those of higher rank have a duty to care for and raise those of lower rank. In return, members of lower rank have the responsibility to respect and obey those of higher rank.

Related to this is the idea of respect for ancestors. Chinese people feel connected to their ancestors who died long ago. Many believe that ancestors who have died still watch over their living family members. Children are expected to make sure their parents are happy in their old age and then to continue to honor and worship them after their deaths.

title: Silk
text:
Silk was first made thousands of years ago from the cocoon of the silkworm. Legend says that Empress Lei-Tzu discovered silk by accident. The story tells how a silkworm cocoon fell into her cup while she was drinking tea under a mulberry tree. The strands unraveled as she took out the cocoon. The Empress kept some and decided to try weaving it. She taught her dressmakers how to use the cocoon strands to create beautiful silk fabric. The earliest actual archaeological evidence of silk goes back more than 8,000 years. Fibers, bone needles, and weaving tools were found in ancient tombs in Jiahu, China.

Silk became an important source of income for farmers. As weaving tools and skills improved, the reputation of Chinese silk spread to other civilizations of the ancient world. Over time, China became famous for its silk fabric. Everyone wanted it, but the Chinese were the only people who knew how to make it. Silk became very expensive. As trade opened up between China and other regions, many Chinese people became rich by trading silk. A series of roads used by merchants wound across China to the Mediterranean Sea and the Indian Ocean. People named it the Silk Road for the enormous amounts of silk fabric exported to people in other countries. The expensive material was easily transported because of its lightweight, but the Silk Road carried more than just silk. People also used the road to trade gold, ivory, spices, animals, plants, medicines, and foods. The Chinese also traded ideas with the Western world. Many historians think these ideas changed the way we live to this day. Printing processes, papermaking, gunpowder, and the compass are just a few important ideas that spread from China. Can you imagine the world without them?

There was one idea that Chinese people could not spread. Chinese leaders made it a crime for people to share how silk was made. That crime was punishable by death. The secret was kept for almost 2,500 years. Stories say that a Chinese princess smuggled silkworms out of China in 440 C.E. She hid them in her hairpiece.

title: Chinese Writing
text:
It is hard to say exactly when writing was first used in China. Most writing was probably done on materials like wood, bamboo, or silk. These materials have broken down over time. The earliest evidence of full sentences is found on bones. During the Shang dynasty, the kings used professional oracles, or fortune tellers, to make predictions about the future. They wrote questions on things like turtle shells and ox bones, such as: “Will the king have a son?” or “If we send 3,000 men into battle, will we succeed?” A hot metal rod was inserted into the bone or shell until it cracked. Then the fortune teller interpreted the cracks to learn the answer to the question.

The markings on these shells and bones are more than 3,000 years old. They are some of the oldest written signs in the world. Before the discovery of the oracle bones, scholars had no solid proof that the Shang dynasty even existed. Over time, these ancient marks developed into modern Chinese writing.

Chinese writing is very different from English. In English, letters stand for sounds. We combine letters to make written words. Instead of letters, Chinese writing uses symbols, called characters. Each character stands for a word. Characters can also be combined to make other words. That makes it hard to learn Chinese writing. Anyone who wants to read Chinese needs to memorize thousands of characters. To learn the characters, students use a special paper that is covered with gridlines. They practice drawing the characters in the correct shape and size on the grid. By the end of fourth grade, you would probably need to know about 3,000 characters.

title: Taoism and Confucianism
text:
Taoism and Confucianism are both traditional, ancient Chinese religions and philosophies for living. Lao Tzu was a Chinese philosopher and poet who founded Taoism, which is also known as Daoism. Confucius was the founder of Confucianism, and he lived during a time known as the Spring and Autumn period in China (770-476 B.C.E.). Both traditions were founded close to the same time, though Lao Tzu is believed to be older than Confucius. There is even a story that tells of when a young Confucius visited Lao Tzu in search of answers to his questions about life. Let’s learn a little more about these two religions.

Taoism

Born sometime in the sixth century B.C.E., the philosopher Lao Tzu is well-known for a text called the Tao Te Ching. Also known as the Book of the Way, it focuses on the path, or the way, to virtue through these things: contemplation, or thoughtfulness; simplicity; acceptance of the present; and a harmonious life with a natural, universal force known as the Tao. Lao Tzu wrote this about the Tao: “When we renounce learning, we have no troubles.... The ancients who showed their skill in practicing the Tao did so not to enlighten people, but to make them simple and ignorant.” Lao Tzu’s reference to ignorance was not an insult to those who followed his teachings and practiced Taoism. Instead, it was a way of thinking about life that did not clutter the world with too much information. It simplified it instead. A few facts about Taoism simplify the study of it, too!

The purpose of Taoism is to live as one with nature.

Followers worship several gods in temples, or shrines, primarily in Asia.

Taoists believe the soul survives death.

Taoist holidays are the Chinese New Year, Tomb Sweeping Day, and the Hungry Ghost Festival.

A virtue on which Taoism is based is contemplation.

Confucianism

Confucius lived through a time of turmoil in China. The Zhou dynasty, which had ruled the region since around 1050 B.C.E., had lost control after 500 years. Without clear leadership, the area collapsed and was divided into smaller states that were constantly at war with each other. Tensions ran high while the states fought for power and control. As often happens in times of war, people acted out of stress and greed. While the Zhou dynasty fell apart, so did traditions and practices that brought culture and morality to the people. Confucius sought to restore this structure, and he stepped in with his philosophy of love, self-discipline, and education. As his fellow citizens fought, Confucius taught and exercised his principle belief that ren, or loving others, could restore the peaceful traditions of their native country. In fact, he had his own version of the Golden Rule: Do not do to others what you do not wish for yourself. Sound familiar? A few helpful facts will shed more light on Confucianism, too.

The purpose of Confucianism is to have a structured society.

Followers worship in temples or in their homes.

Practicing Confucians believe that ancestors are to be worshiped.

Official holidays of Confucianism are the Chinese New Year and Teacher’s Day.

A main principle on which Confucianism is based is respect.

title: Confucius and Dr. King
text:
Martin Luther King Jr. was an American civil rights leader. He inspired millions of followers. King worked so that African Americans in our country could have equal rights. He earned a reputation for his teachings and for how he organized nonviolent protests.

In 1964, the Nobel Committee decided that King deserved the Nobel Peace Prize. They saw he had done important work on race relations, human rights, and world peace. The nominations described King as working for “the dignity and worth of the human person, regardless of race.” He became known for powerful speeches in which he used his passion to capture the energy of his followers. King taught about the power of education in everyday life as well as in classrooms. These were some of the same lessons that Confucius taught.

Confucius lived almost 2,500 years before King. They even lived on different hemispheres. Confucius believed that education was powerful. He also believed in compassion and morals. Confucius shared his experience and wisdom with several generations of Chinese people. He taught and inspired people with his thoughtful questions and observations.

Read the two statements below. One was said by Confucius and the other by Martin Luther King Jr. Can you tell which man said which statement?

Statement #1: "If I am walking with two other men, each of them will serve as my teacher. I will pick out the good points of the one and imitate them and the bad points of the other and correct them in myself."

Statement #2: "We must remember that intelligence is not enough. Intelligence plus character — that is the goal of true education. The complete education gives one not only power of concentration, but worthy objectives upon which to concentrate."

title: Sericulture: Are You Serious?
text:
Tobacco was the most important crop in the Southern Colonies, but it wasn’t the only crop by any means. King James didn’t like tobacco. He ordered that people raise silkworms to make silk, too. He was not happy that China was making all the money for this popular fabric. Georgia, Virginia, and South Carolina gave it a shot, but only Georgia was able to make much silk. Making silk is an expensive process. Silk is made from the cocoons spun by silkworms. It takes thousands and thousands of silkworm cocoons, and they only eat mulberry leaves. It takes many workers and just the right conditions. Raising silkworms is called sericulture.

The knowledge of sericulture got to America in the 1600s. Colonists finally discovered the farm technology to make silk. All you need are moth larvae and mulberry trees. That’s it: two ingredients.

Here’s how sericulture works. You first need to raise silkworms. You must grow the mulberry trees to feed them. Then, let the silkworms spin cocoons. Does that sound easy? It’s not. Silkworms’ heads have two spinnerets that spin sticky cocoons. After thousands of cocoons are spun, the cocoons are heated to kill the larvae inside. If the worms hatch into moths, it would ruin the silk of the cocoon.

Next, the cocoons are soaked in water. The cocoon silk is unwound. Then, the strands are spun together to make a silk thread about a mile long. Later, the thread is woven into soft clothing.

Making silk is a very hard process. Weather changes, tree diseases, and workers’ mistakes can lead to instant crop failure. Most colonists quickly switched back to farming tobacco, rice, or cotton. But silk is truly beautiful. Look at some labels on clothing at your house. Do you have a silk shirt or scarf in the house?

title: Checks and Balances
text:
The writers of the U.S. Constitution wanted to limit the power of government so that the United States would be strong and endure. Articles I, II, and III of the Constitution separate the government into three branches.

This ensures that branches of government share power equally. In order for these branches to work together, the Founders created a system of checks and balances. This means that each branch of the government has to be in agreement with the other two.

Each branch has the power to stop certain actions of another branch. This happens if a branch believes those actions are unconstitutional or not in the best interest of the country. The system of checks and balances helps make sure that no branch of government becomes more powerful than the others.

Congress can pass a law, but the president must approve it. Congress can also override the president's decision to veto, or reject, a law. The Supreme Court has the power to strike down a law that has been approved by both Congress and the president if it believes the law is unconstitutional. The president appoints justices to the Supreme Court, but Congress must approve the choices. Because of this system of checks and balances, U.S. citizens can be sure their rights are always protected.

title: Why Should I Take Action?
text:
Empathy is the ability to understand and be sensitive to the feelings of somebody else. It’s trying to look at a situation through another person’s eyes. Having empathy often motivates us to help other people.

Pretend you have a lot of litter around your school and playground. You might not think it is a problem. How would your principal feel? What about your classmate who tripped over some litter and hurt themselves?

An empathy map helps us understand how another person sees a situation. Let’s use the litter example. How might our school custodian feel about all of that litter?

See: What does your custodian see?

Garbage in the school and playground

Unwanted animals entering the playground

Unsafe corridors or play areas

Hear: What might your custodian hear?

Parents complaining and sad

The principal telling the custodian this is a problem

People asking the custodian to fix this

Think and Feel: What might your custodian think and feel about it?

Angry or sad that the kids don’t care

Tired because it’s a lot of work to clear up

Frustrated because it seems like their job is never done

Say and Do: What might your custodian say and/or do about it?

Yell at kids who drop trash because they’re frustrated

Pick up the trash

Ask kids to pick up the trash

title: Civic Responsibility
text:
A civic responsibility is something that citizens are expected to do in the community. All citizens are expected to make choices for the common good. Members of a community are expected to obey laws. We are all expected to work to improve our communities.

Some civic responsibilities are enforced. This means that there are consequences if we do not follow them. Obeying the law and serving on a jury are enforced responsibilities. A jury is a group of citizens who are selected to decide a court case.

We vote to elect public officials. However, voting is not enforced. It is by choice. Volunteering is also by choice. It helps the community and people in need. Serving in the military or holding a public office are also things citizens can do to help their community.

title: Running for Political Office
text:
Citizens interested in serving in the government participate in a campaign process. People who want to be elected are called candidates. Candidates need to meet official requirements for the government job, or office, they want. Before election day, candidates spend a lot of time campaigning. This means they let voters know who they are and what they believe about different issues. They talk about what they would like to do if they win the election. They might use signs, flyers, billboards, and commercials to campaign. They also give speeches and often have debates with other candidates.

Citizens study each candidate carefully. They vote for the person who best represents their viewpoints. The candidate with the most votes wins. Citizens can vote for leaders of their community, state, or country.

title: Effects of European Exploration
text:
The people of the Americas met their wants and needs using resources from the land around them. They had vibrant societies and extensive trade routes. They had art, history, and protection for their communities. They had government and religion. They fed their families by hunting animals and gathering berries, nuts, and fruits. They cultivated crops of corn, squash, beans, tomatoes, potatoes, and some grains. They created tools from the resources around them. They traveled by walking or using boats on the waterways.

The Europeans used natural resources to create manufactured goods. Like American Indians, they also had vibrant societies and extensive trade routes. They had art, history, and protection for their communities. They had government and religion. They fed their families by farming and going to markets. The Europeans domesticated animals to keep on their farms. This meant they didn’t have to hunt for food. They had horses to help with the work on the farm and at the market. They cultivated grain crops of wheat, oats, and barley. The Europeans developed different modes of transportation. They used wagons and carts on land and ships on the sea. They manufactured goods out of metal and wood. They used many of their resources to help them explore new places across the ocean.

When these two societies met, there were intentional and unintentional consequences. The two groups traded ideas for the design of tools and transportation. The Europeans brought domesticated animals, pigs, chickens, and horses with them on their ships. The people of the Americas gave them plants, food, and precious metals. Sign language and gestures were used to help the two cultures communicate with each other.

Tolerance of differences between the two cultures could have expanded the positive exchanges. However, some Europeans were not tolerant of the differences they encountered. They believed the peoples of the Americas were inferior because their ways were different. Intolerance caused conflict and the captivity and deaths of many indigenous American people.

The introduction of domesticated animals in the Americas caused imbalance in the ecosystem. Pigs were turned loose to forage in the forests. The pigs multiplied until there were so many they depleted the vegetation. Other animals that depended on the same vegetation had nothing to eat.

The horse was a new animal to the Americas. The horse quickly became popular to help the people of the Americas in their everyday lives. They used horses for transportation and work. Horses became a valuable trade resource. The horses quickly multiplied. Descendents of these horses are still found on the east coast and the western lands of the United States.

The most deadly exchange was unintentional. The Europeans brought disease with them. They had developed immunity to many bacteria and viruses over the centuries. The people of the Americas had never been exposed to such deadly germs. Smallpox, tuberculosis, influenza, and other strains of disease were easily transported by unsuspecting people. Historians estimate that disease killed 90 percent of the native population within 150 years.

title: Introduction to the Plains
text:
The people living in the Midwest lived on grasslands called plains. The tribes that lived there included the Sioux, Cheyenne, Dakota, Comanche, and many more. The plains of North America are ideal for farming and hunting animals that graze for food. For centuries, the Native Americans who lived in the Great Plains area lived these two lifestyles: hunter-gatherer and agricultural.

Hunter-gatherer tribes utilized large areas to hunt. They often moved with the animals they hunted. Their main source of food and materials was bison. They used every part of the bison to meet their needs. Bison skin was used in tepees, clothing, containers, and blankets. Dried bison dung was used as fuel for fires.

The Native Americans who lived a hunter-gatherer lifestyle had to move around a lot. Their houses needed to go with them, so they often lived in tepees. Tepees were made of tall, thin logs that were set up vertically and leaned against each other. Animal hides were attached to the logs to make a large, conical (cone-shaped) shelter.

The tribes who lived as agriculturalists (farmers) didn’t move around much. They usually built earth lodges to live in. Many tribes inhabited this region, including the Wichita and the Caddo. These tribes also farmed the land. They traditionally grew corn, pumpkins, beans, and squash. They also hunted deer, antelope, bear, and bison. Some groups lived in more permanent villages. These villages had homes that couldn't be transported like the tepee could.

Earth lodges were built from a few supporting logs attached to beams on top. Then, smaller logs would branch out from them like a sun’s rays. All of it was covered with thick layers of sod (dirt) and grass. A hole would be left in the top to allow smoke from the cooking fire to escape. Earth lodges used the materials on the Great Plains to make a house that could stay warm during the cold, windy winters. Dozens of people would live in an earth lodge. Since earth lodges needed logs, they had to be built close to wooded areas.

title: Week 15 Framing Question
text: How did the horse change the economy and culture of the indigenous people of the Plains?

title: Physical Safety
text:
There are so many important ways you can take care of your body. One way is to care for your physical safety. Physical safety refers to protecting your body. Think before you act. Would it be smart to jump out of a window or try doing a flip without any help if you’ve never done one before? No. There are many things you can do to ensure your physical safety. You can get yearly medical checkups. This is a form of preventative care, which means you are checking for problems before you have any. You can protect your skin from the sun by using sunscreen and protective clothing like hats and sunglasses. This will protect you from getting sunburns, skin cancer, or damaging your eyes. You can also protect your skin from ice by wearing gloves and appropriate clothing during the winter. This will protect you from frostbite.

You can promote your physical safety by being prepared to react to emergencies. If someone has a dental emergency where an adult tooth is knocked out, run cool water in their mouth and put the tooth in a cool glass of water, then go straight to the dentist. If someone bites their tongue or lip, apply pressure with a cloth right away. If the bleeding does not stop, go to the doctor.

If someone stops breathing, CPR can be performed manually (with your hands). You can take a class and get certified to give CPR in case of an emergency. In some emergencies, when someone becomes unconscious or stops breathing, you should call 911. An ambulance may come, and medics can help the injured individual. In situations where an individual’s heart has stopped, medics may use an automated external defibrillator (AED). An AED sends electrical pulses to the person’s heart to get it started again. This should only be used by someone who is trained to operate it.

title: Follow Rules
text:
The most effective way to protect your body is by following rules and laws that are in place to keep you safe. Your state, community, school, and even your family all have rules to keep you safe. If you choose to follow these rules, you can significantly decrease your chances of injury. Having these rules in place is one way your environment can impact your health. Here are some state and federal (country) laws in place to keep you safe:

Anyone in a car must be wearing a seatbelt (babies and small children must be in car seats).

You must have a driver’s license to drive a vehicle.

Individuals must be at least 21 years old to drink alcohol.

Many drugs are illegal to be produced, consumed, or distributed.

Use a crosswalk to cross the street.

Wear a helmet when riding a bike (it is illegal in some states to ride a bike without a helmet).

Here are some rules in place at most schools to keep you safe:

No running in the halls

No bullying or fighting

No drugs, smoking, or alcohol

No cheating or stealing

Can you think of any rules to add to this list?

What rules exist in your home to keep you safe?

Rules help protect you and your body! Choosing to ignore laws and rules is risky behavior and can greatly increase your chances of being injured. Be smart. Follow the rules and encourage your friends to follow them too.

title: Hygiene and Growth
text:
There are things you have been taught since you were young about how to keep your body clean. You were probably taught to wash your hands after using the bathroom, before you eat, or after you play outside. You were probably taught to brush your teeth twice a day. You were probably taught to take baths or showers frequently. These are all great ways to practice personal hygiene, and they are things you should continue to do no matter how old you get. These things help protect you from communicable (transferable from one person to another) diseases and illnesses such as flus and colds.

Noncommunicable diseases are conditions that cannot be passed from person to person, such as asthma or cancer. Because some illnesses can move from person to person, it is important for you to learn to practice good personal hygiene. You can do your best to wear clean clothes, trim your nails, wash your hair, and use deodorant. As you grow and your body develops, it will be critical to learn to keep yourself clean.

How does taking care of your personal hygiene affect your health and well-being in each area of your development?

physical

social

emotional

academic

mental

title: Move Your Body
text:
You can take care of your body by being physically active each day. It is recommended that kids ages 6–17, including you, should get at least one hour of physical activity every day. Exercising helps your body in so many ways. It strengthens your bones and muscles, which makes it harder for you to get hurt. It makes you stronger, so it is easier to do the activities you enjoy. Moving your body also strengthens your lungs and gives you energy. Maintaining healthy habits is also much easier when you are active each day. Exercise not only helps your body; it also benefits you mentally and socially.

Strengthening your body strengthens your mind too. Exercising wakes up your brain. It gives you more brain power and helps boost your mood. If you are ever feeling grumpy or tired, get up and move around! It will help. Has your teacher ever had you do a “brain break,” where you stand up and move your body in some way? Moving your body can help your brain focus better, especially if you have been working for a long time. Lastly, physical activity can help you socially, which means with friends. How do you think exercise can help your relationships and friendships? Think about it: Some of your most social times are surrounded by physical activity. You get to spend time with your friends during recess, when you might play a game, run a race, or just walk and talk. These are all forms of movement, and you get to interact with your peers. Participating in any sport is another great way to make friends and move your body.

As you keep your body active each day, don’t forget to pay attention to how it feels. If you have any unusual aches and pains, don’t be afraid to talk to your school nurse or ask your parent or guardian to take you to the doctor. You can also avoid injury or other health issues by getting an annual (yearly) health exam with your doctor. Every year, your doctor can check every aspect of your health to make sure you are healthy and growing properly. They can also give you tips and advice on how to stay healthy.

title: Fuel for Your Body
text:
Every body is different. Every body needs different amounts of food and has different tastes. But every body can benefit from a variety of nutritious foods. Each food group — carbohydrates, dairy, fruits and vegetables, protein, and fats — provides different nutrients and benefits to your body. For this reason, it is important to incorporate them all into your daily diet. More information is available on national websites discussing dietary guidelines and recommendations.

Carbohydrates: give you energy

Examples: bread, pasta, rice

Protein: gives you long-term energy and strengthens your muscles

Examples: meat, eggs, nuts

Dairy: gives you calcium, which strengthens your bones

Examples: cheese, milk, yogurt

Fruits and vegetables: give you minerals and vitamins to strengthen your immune system, strengthen your hair and nails, and keep your skin clear

Examples: berries, apples, oranges, broccoli, peas, carrots

Write at least three more fruits or vegetables that you enjoy.

Fats: promote brain function

Examples: oil, butter

title: Hazards to Your Body
text: To keep your body healthy, there are things you should avoid consuming at all costs. Drugs, alcohol, and smoking are extremely unhealthy for adults, and when young people consume them, the consequences are even more serious. These substances are extremely addictive and harm your body, brain, emotions, and relationships. In addition, consuming any of those products when you are under the age of 21 is illegal. You can pay fines or even spend time in jail. It is important to be aware of the consequences that come with getting involved with drugs, alcohol, and tobacco. It is critical to think about the consequences of consuming these products. It can be hard to say “no” when it seems like doing drugs, drinking alcohol, and smoking are the norm at your school or in your family. You can ask for time to think; say “no” and walk away; or call a friend, parent, or guardian if you are invited to use drugs or drink alcohol. What do you already know about the consequences of using harmful substances such as drugs and alcohol?

title: You Are in Charge of Your Body
text:
As an individual, only you are allowed to determine what you do or don’t want to do with your body. When you are pushed to do something you don’t want to do, you may have a sudden feeling of uneasiness or nervousness. You may think, “I’m not sure I should be here,” and feel the urge to leave. These feelings exist for a reason and often help protect you from dangerous situations.

Many things can influence a person’s behavior. Peer pressure, social media, and even family impact a person’s decisions and health. Teenagers are particularly vulnerable to inaccurate or unrealistic messages about their health in the media. Young people are also at a greater risk of being targeted by predators. In online settings especially, there are those who want to take advantage of young people. They may communicate under a false image and name and ask for personal information or request to meet in real life by making false claims and promises. Some predators may even ask for photos of young people online.

Though it may not eliminate the risk completely, there are many steps you can take to protect yourself from danger. Don’t share your personal information with strangers. Avoid going places alone or when it’s dark out. Avoid talking to strangers alone, both online and in real life. Don’t agree to meet people you’ve never met in real life. No one should ask you to send compromising pictures of yourself to them. Predators do what they can to make you feel trapped. It’s not always easy to tell who is and isn’t safe to be around, so it’s important to take precautions to keep yourself safe. If you or someone you know is in a situation like this, get help from a trusted adult immediately.

Though we may choose to take certain steps to protect ourselves from dangerous situations, it is important to remember that the survivors of violence or predators are not at fault. Trust is earned by demonstrating respect for boundaries.

title: Help Others Make Healthy Choices
text:
Have you ever seen one of your peers doing something you thought was cool, so you wanted to join in? Your peers can have a big influence on you and what you perceive as the norm. The norm is what is considered socially acceptable. It is usually something you might think everyone is doing. Sometimes unhealthy behaviors can even trend, such as sexting, doing drugs, or smoking. Trends may make a behavior seem like the norm, which makes those behaviors seem more tempting to try. You can help positive, healthy behaviors be the norm. If the norm at your school is to work hard in school, be kind to others, and participate in sports and clubs, those things will be more exciting.

You can make the world a better place by being a positive influence on others. A great way for you to influence others to make healthy choices is by making healthy choices yourself and by celebrating the healthy choices of others. You can be an example to others through your actions, words, texts, posts, and likes. Start with you. What goal would you like to set that will help you be an influencer for healthy choices?

title: Protecting Your Body
text:
You are in charge of your body. You can protect your body by setting healthy boundaries and by talking about your needs. It is important to know that sometimes people do not respect others’ needs and boundaries. Predators are people who look for opportunities to take advantage of others. Predators are people who intend to hurt others. They may pretend to be someone they are not so they can build a relationship with you with the intent to harm you or take advantage of you. They may lie or send you pictures or sensitive content to force you into feeling trapped. They do this to approach you or even kidnap you after getting you alone.

Online predators may ask you for information and content, including videos or pictures. Do not share personal information such as your address or where you go to school with strangers online. Don’t send someone nude pictures or videos of yourself, even if they threaten you. If someone online asks you to send content such as this, notify a trusted adult immediately. You are not at fault when someone asks you for content that is harmful to you, and you do not need to feel pressured to share it.

There are safeguards you can use in real life as well as online. In real life, you can make wise choices such as not going places alone, not going outside alone in the dark, staying alert, and being assertive with the way you communicate with others. When it comes to intimate relationships, you can be assertive verbally with what you are and are not comfortable with. Sexual consent is an agreement between people to engage in sexual activity. Any sexual activity without sexual consent on both sides can be considered rape. Sexual consent involves more than being told verbally that someone wants to have sex. Consent requires constant communication and attentiveness to both yourself and your partner.

Consent is not always as simple as a verbal “yes” or “no.” There are many situations where people, such as those who have experienced some form of sexual violence in the past, may feel unsafe or even pressured to agree to something they do not want. It’s important that you understand the many ways someone may express that they are not giving consent. Do you notice that the person is unusually silent or frozen in place? Maybe they’ve become withdrawn or have begun to shake their head and try to push you away. These are nonverbal cues that indicate that a person is not giving consent. The absence of a verbal “no” is not the same thing as a “yes,” and pressuring someone to engage in sexual acts until they agree is not the same thing as consent.

Each state has laws that govern the age a person needs to be in order to legally give sexual consent. If a person is younger than that age, they are legally not allowed to give sexual consent. There are also other situations in which a person is not able to give consent, such as when they are intoxicated or under the influence of drugs. Sexual harassment and sexual abuse or violence include unwanted sexual advancements, such as touching, talking inappropriately, or any forced removal of clothing or intercourse. If someone touches you in a private area, you can say, “No” or “I am not comfortable with this,” and tell a trusted adult, such as a counselor, parent, or guardian, right away.

Each person has a responsibility to respond to others with respect. When a person discloses that they have experienced sexual violence, you can respond with empathy, patience, and kindness. You can also ask a trusted adult for help. It is helpful to gather support in situations like this.

title: Consequences of Consuming Addictive Substances
text:
Consequences of consuming addictive substances:

Physically

Smoking rots your teeth.

Smoking makes your breath, your clothes, and wherever you smoke smell like smoke.

Smoking damages your lungs and makes it harder to breathe.

Smoking can create secondhand smoke, which can hurt people who are in close proximity to the smoker. These people did not consent to smoke, but if they are next to someone who is smoking, they can breathe in the smoke, and it can hurt their lungs too.

Drugs and alcohol will disqualify you from competing in sports or competitions.

Drugs are very difficult to quit once you have started using them. Becoming sober is a difficult process that can involve withdrawal symptoms. These symptoms can include shakes, sweating, nausea, and headaches, and are the body’s way of dealing with the absence of the substance.

Overconsumption of alcohol can cause a hangover the next day.

Emotionally and Mentally

Drugs and alcohol can make you moody.

Drugs and alcohol can make you confused.

Drugs are extremely addictive.

When you are under the influence of drugs and alcohol, your reality is unclear, and you may do things that put you or someone else in a dangerous situation. It is illegal for someone under the influence of drugs or alcohol to drive. Driving under the influence increases the likelihood of car accidents.

Socially

Drugs can cloud your judgment. They can make you unaware of the dangers in your environment. You may even do or say things that you regret later. People do things while they are under the influence of drugs or alcohol that they would never do sober, which can put them at great risk. Drugs and alcohol are very expensive and can use up all of your money. A dependency on drugs or alcohol can make you do things out of character to feed your addiction, like doing dishonest things to get money. This can ruin your relationships or even get you thrown in jail.

Drugs and alcohol increase the likelihood of rape or sexual violence.

Benefits of saying “no” to drugs, alcohol, and tobacco:

You will have a clear mind.

You won’t smell bad.

You don’t have to feel stress when the police do a surprise drug search at your school.

You can save your money for something important, such as college.

You will have better hygiene.

You can avoid hangovers.

You can avoid all arguments and relationship drama that are caused by addictive substances.

You will have time to do enjoyable things, including playing sports, spending time with family and friends, going to movie theaters, and bowling.

Some drugs are illegal, no matter how old you are. The legal age for smoking tobacco is 18 years old in some states. For the most part, people under the age of 18 cannot legally consume drugs unless those drugs are prescribed. If someone takes too much of a drug (overdosing), it would be appropriate to call 911. If a person has started taking drugs and is having a hard time quitting, they can talk to a doctor or a school counselor. School counselors and doctors are reliable resources who can help people get the help they need. Asking for help may feel hard or embarrassing, but overcoming addiction is very difficult for a person to do on their own. A person wanting to overcome substance use or abuse can talk to a trusted adult (a teacher, a counselor, a parent, or a doctor) in private and say, “I made a mistake. I used drugs, and now I want to stop. Can you help me?” Individuals can also ask for help if they are worried about a friend who is using drugs, alcohol, or tobacco. If you are worried about a friend, you can say something like, “I am worried for my friend. They are using drugs, and I can tell it is harming them. How can we help them?” Someone addicted to a harmful substance may need assistance to make the healthy choice to quit.

You can make a healthy choice right now and commit to saying “no” to drugs, alcohol, and tobacco. Another healthy choice is deciding to influence your friends and family to be healthy. Encourage those around you to make choices that will keep their bodies healthy and strong.

title: Personal Hygiene and Reproductive Health
text:
