title: Educated Thinking
text:
Every person has different thoughts, beliefs, and opinions. Each person can use their knowledge and experience to think critically every day. A person's thoughts shape their experiences, so it is valuable to take time to think critically.

When a person learns something new, they can ask questions to help them understand it better. People can think about what they already know and what else they want to know. Problems can have multiple parts and multiple potential solutions. Asking questions helps a person to think critically because it helps them think about all of the parts of the problem.

Many things influence a person's thinking. Parents, caregivers, teachers, friends, social media, books, education, and culture all impact the way a person thinks and sees the world. Thinking critically is learning to compare and contrast these multiple perspectives and information and make healthy decisions using all of the information. Comparing and contrasting events and interactions helps a person understand them better. It also helps a person to know what questions need to be asked. People can even compare and contrast their own behavior with the behavior of others. If a person has friends who make healthy decisions, they will probably see how happy the friends are. This provides evidence that using critical thinking to make healthy decisions will help them to be happy and healthy. Thinking critically allows people to observe the world around them more completely. It also helps them develop their sense of self.

title: Get to Know Yourself with Critical Thinking
text:
Critical thinking helps you understand your own mind. When you think critically, you start to realize what you already know.

Eli is in math class. He is learning about multiplying and dividing fractions. He is excited to learn about it because he already knows how to multiply and divide whole numbers. What he is learning makes sense to him because he uses his prior knowledge to make sense of the new concepts he is learning.

You can combine your existing knowledge with what you already know too. When you learn something new, combine the new information with what you have read, learned, seen, and heard. Thinking for yourself, forming your own opinions, and solving problems are skills that can help you build a happy and successful life.

title: The Problem
text:
Choose a problem to work with on the Problem Web:

I have one hour before dinner. Should I do my homework or play?

Should I save my allowance for something big or buy the new shoes everyone else is wearing?

Someone is sitting alone at lunch. Should I go sit with them?

Rank your possible solutions in order from favorite to least favorite option. Then, circle your decision.

title: Using Research
text: Thinking critically means doing some research on a topic. Research involves considering sources and asking questions so that you can base your opinions on facts and relevant information. You want to form well-thought-out opinions by gathering information and sticking to the facts. You have so much information at your fingertips, so it is important to be educated about the topics you discuss so you can be confident in the opinions you form. There is great power in what you see or feel. Your experiences are like research. When you read a book, you learn more about a topic, person, or place. If you and a friend watch something online, you gain more knowledge about and experience with that topic. All of this research helps you formulate your own opinions because you gain more knowledge and experience.

title: What's Your Opinion?
text:
Opinions are views or judgments that you form about something. We can form opinions based on our beliefs, how we feel, what we hear, and what others say. We can also form opinions based on facts and knowledge. Asking questions is important in forming opinions. It helps you form opinions that are in line with your moral identity, or what you believe is right and wrong.

Last week at school, Caz learned all about impressionist art. This weekend, Caz got to go to the art museum with his dad. He looked at the small, visible brushstrokes and the unblended colors. He studied the way the artists tried to emphasize the realistic natural light on the canvas. He recalled all of the lessons from class about impressionist art. He forms an opinion about the art style. He really likes how it looks and how it makes him feel inspired to spend more time outdoors.

Opinions can be based on facts or emotions, so it is important to ask questions and gather information through research. You can form opinions that support your moral identity. You can stay true to who you are, what you believe, and what your opinion is. You can also share your opinion with others in a respectful way. Sharing your opinion does not mean proving others’ opinions are wrong. It means sharing what you have learned from your own research. Other people will share what they have learned as well. Learning to value other people’s opinions will help you grow emotionally, appreciate new perspectives, and maintain healthy relationships.

title: Recognize the Influence of Others
text:
You may not realize it, but your peers and the people around you influence your life and decisions. Peer pressure is pressure or influence from peers to do or not do something. Peer pressure can be negative or positive. You can use your knowledge, research, and opinions to analyze the pressure from your friends. Having your own opinions and sticking to what you believe will help you avoid negative peer pressure.

Lia's friends were being unkind to her. They all had a party over the weekend and she wasn't invited. Lia believes it is good to treat others with respect. Even though Lia felt sad, she chose to treat her friends respectfully. When someone said something mean about one of her friends, she didn't join in because she knows that it won't make her feel better about herself; it will just hurt her friend. Lia decided to encourage all of her friends to include one another. She set a good example by inviting all of her friends to meet at the park after school to hang out.

Positive peer pressure encourages you to do things that are in line with your moral identity. Positive peer pressure can improve your well-being.

Negative peer pressure encourages you to do things that are not in line with your moral identity. Negative peer pressure can decrease your feelings of well-being and cause you harm.

title: Reflect on Your Decision
text:
After making a decision, stop and ask yourself how the decision turned out. Spend time evaluating if the decision you made created positive or negative consequences and if you are happy about how you handled the problem. This is called reflection. Reflection is an important tool that can help you to think about your own actions and words in a way that helps you. Reflection can help you make the best possible decisions for yourself. Reflection can help you keep a growth mindset and improve your decisions over time. Reflection can help you be resilient and confident because it helps you to be aware of how your decisions affect you and others. Reflecting regularly will help you to build and keep healthy relationships.

Try reflecting right now. Think about a decision you recently made. Think about the options you had, the impact of each option, and the decision you chose.

Ask yourself:

What outcomes did I see?

How did my choice affect others?

Is there something I can learn from this?

Is there something I will do differently if I face this decision again?

title: How My Brain Communicates with My Body
text:
Your brain helps you move. Your brain tells your body what to do. When you want to take a bite of food, your brain sends signals or messages to your hands to grab the utensil, scoop up the food, and bring it to your mouth. Your brain tells your body to chew and swallow the food. Your brain and body do all this communicating without you having to think about it! Isn’t that amazing?

So, how does it work? You have what’s called a central nervous system, which is made up of your brain and your spinal cord. These connect to the bottom of your brain and runs all the way down your back. Your brain and your spinal cord are full of nerves. These nerves branch out from the spinal cord to every other part of your body. Nerves carry messages up and down your spinal cord from your brain to tell your body what to do.

Some people lose that connection between the body and the brain. This is usually because of damage to either the brain or the spinal cord from accidents, illnesses, or other causes. This type of damage can result in the loss of function in the person’s arms or legs. Everyone has different abilities. You can be respectful to those around you by accepting and celebrating the abilities and talents they have.

title: How My Body Communicates with My Brain
text:
Your brain helps you perceive everything you do. Everything you eat, see, smell, touch, and do with your body sends messages or signals to your brain. When your eyes see a flower, your brain may tell you to smell it. When your eyes see danger, your brain will probably tell you to run. Your body smells odors, and your brain interprets the sensory information and then tells you if they are good or bad and healthy or dangerous. If you touch a stove, your skin will send signals to your brain so you realize it is hot.

Pay attention to what is around you. Notice the signals your body sends to your brain. Notice the signals your brain sends back to your body and how you interpret each sensory experience. Look at things, smell things, and touch things. As you pay attention to your senses, be respectful to others and their belongings.

title: Mindful Movement
text:
What do you think the phrase “mindful movement” means? What do you think it is referring to?

Mindful movement means involving your thoughts and mind in your movement, whatever that movement may be. Mindful movement is a great way to increase the connection between your brain and body. Dancing, swimming, running, biking, and all other kinds of movement can be done mindfully. Performing movements mindfully will help you gain more benefits from your exercise. Here are a few ways you can perform any movement mindfully:

Pay attention to your breathing during the movement.

Check in with your body while you move. Notice how your body is feeling.

Do your movement in silence and without distractions.

Stay focused on the movements you are performing.

title: Taking Care of My Brain Through Exercise
text:
When you take care of your body, you are also taking care of your brain. When your body is healthy, your brain performs at its best. You can take care of your body through consistent physical activity. It is suggested that youth get at least one hour of exercise each day. Exercise includes anything that gets your heart rate up. You might get some of that exercise in a game of tag during recess or at soccer practice. There are certainly many benefits for your body that come from daily exercise, including having more energy, getting stronger, and maintaining healthy habits. At the same time, your brain also benefits from daily movement in multiple ways:

Exercise can act as an antidepressant, meaning that consistent movement makes you happier. When you exercise, your body produces endorphins, which make you feel good. It helps you be in a good mood and relieves anxiety and stress.

Exercise can help you sleep better. When you get more sleep, your body and your brain work better.

Exercise can help improve your memory. It helps keep your brain cells healthy and helps new blood vessels grow.

There is no one best type of exercise for your brain. All forms of exercise can increase your brain capacity and function. You can find a form of exercise that you love, then choose to do that and other types of movement every day!

title: Taking Care of My Brain Through Rest
text:
Have you ever wished you could get things done while you sleep? Well, your wish came true! Your body does a lot during the time that you sleep at night. During the 9–12 hours of sleep that you should be getting each night, your body is busy. While you sleep, your body produces a hormone called melatonin, which makes you sleepy. Levels of cortisol, a stress hormone, lower in your body during sleep so that you can fully relax. During sleep, your immune system releases small proteins called cytokines. These proteins help your body fight off inflammation, infection, and trauma.

While sleep is a great way to take care of your body, it also is a great way to take care of your brain. When you sleep, your brain sorts through all the information you were exposed to during the day. Sleep gives your brain time to store information and helps create long-term memory. Lack of sleep can make it harder to reason, think logically, and problem-solve. You can make the choice to go to bed early enough to get all the sleep you need.

title: Taking Care of My Brain Through Nutrition
text:
Because your brain is always turned on, it is important to give your brain proper fuel. The best fuel for your brain is high-quality food that contains many vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. Consuming the right foods helps your brain to function at its best. The types of food you eat affect the way your brain functions. High-sugar diets can decrease your brain’s ability to function at its best, almost like causing stress to your brain. The food you eat is the source of energy for both your body and brain. Without proper nutrition, you may feel sluggish or slow. When you give your body nutritious foods, like leafy greens, vegetables, and a variety of fruits, your body has more energy for a longer period of time and less oxidative stress. These kinds of food also help your brain to function better.

Foods

Nutrients

Benefits

Leafy green vegetables

Vitamin K, vitamin A, vitamin C, vitamin E, vitamin B, folate, beta-carotene

Slows brain aging; some studies show that consuming leafy greens can even help prevent health conditions like Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, and diabetes.

Berries

Flavonoids, vitamin C, vitamin K, potassium, magnesium

Helps improve memory, slow aging of the tissues, prevent inflammation, improve motor control, and improve cognition

Fish and nuts

Omega-3 fatty acids, Vitamin D, Vitamin B2, calcium, potassium, iron, zinc

Builds and strengthens the brain through the omega-3s, improves memory, and fights inflammation in the brain

Your brain uses lots of energy to work at full capacity. You can choose to fuel your body and brain with plenty of nutritious foods. Not consuming enough nutrients can harm your body and your brain.

title: Defining Growth and Fixed Mindsets
text:
A growth mindset is when someone believes they can learn, grow, and work hard to accomplish anything. When you have a growth mindset, it is easy to set big, challenging goals and know you can achieve them. A growth mindset helps you to not compare your success or talents with other people. Instead, you focus on your own abilities and how to improve them. Can you think of a time when something was difficult but you chose to have a growth mindset?

A fixed mindset is when someone believes they are stationary or stuck where they are. When you have a fixed mindset, you believe your skills, knowledge, talents, and relationships can’t grow. A fixed mindset gives you the tendency to give up when things get hard. It makes you want to avoid challenges or big goals. A fixed mindset makes it difficult to respond well to criticism or feedback. Having a fixed mindset makes you believe you don’t have the power to change. Learning about fixed and growth mindsets can help you build more of a growth mindset. Can you think of a time when something got hard and you chose to have a fixed mindset?

title: Natalia's Goals
text: Steven and Natalia are good friends. Steven is always trying new things and inviting Natalia to try new things too. Steven is planning to compete in the upcoming spelling bee. He invites Natalia to try the spelling bee with him. He promises to help Natalia study and learn new words to be prepared. Natalia knows she is pretty good at spelling, but she also knows that there are lots of other people who are better spellers than her. She is very nervous about being in a competition like this, but Steven convinces her to try. Natalia decides to combat her fears and sets a goal to sign up for the spelling bee with Steven. She thinks about all the possible outcomes, and she knows she might fail or spell a word wrong right at the beginning. With two weeks left before the spelling bee, Natalia decides to prepare with Steven because she has never done a spelling bee before. Natalia decides she will study hard during those two weeks and just see what happens. She will give it her best shot.

title: Natalia's Hard Times
text:
On Tuesday after school, Natalia gets a call. It is Steven. He says, “Hey, Natalia. I’ve got some bad news. My parents just told me that we are going on a trip next week, so I won’t be able to do the spelling bee with you anymore. I’m really sorry. But I still think you should do it. We have been working hard the past few days, and you are a really good speller.”

Natalia is quiet, but inside she just wants to cry. She says, “Okay. Thanks for letting me know. It’s fine. I don’t know if I will still do it. I’ll have to think about it. I am really nervous without you.”

After the phone call, Natalia feels disappointed that Steven is not going to be with her at the spelling bee. She thinks about her goal. She feels like she is only doing it because Steven is doing it with her. This change to the plan makes her very nervous. Natalia starts to question her goal of competing in the spelling bee and wonders if she can even reach that goal. Natalia thinks, “This might be too hard for me. Everyone else already knows more words than me. I don’t think I can learn any more words. I’m not that smart. Other people are much smarter. I should probably just quit so I don’t look dumb.”

Have you ever had thoughts like this when you are nervous about doing something new or hard? These are fixed mindset thoughts.

title: The Power of a Growth Mindset
text:
Natalia changed her mindset and competed in the spelling bee. As she practiced spelling words to prepare for the competition, do you think Natalia spelled every single word right? No. She made plenty of mistakes. But those mistakes were what helped her learn, grow, and be prepared for the spelling bee. In the competition, she got almost every word right. She came in second place!

Natalia recognized that even though she did not win, her effort mattered the most. She had given her best effort, learned, and grown.

Having a growth mindset is a powerful tool. When you have a growth mindset, you can achieve many things. Physically, you can set a goal to improve your skill, strength, or technique for an activity. Academically, you can improve your grades with hard work. Mentally, you can think positively about your life and be grateful for what you have. Socially, you can be a great friend, and you can always meet new people and make more friends. Emotionally, no negative emotion is permanent. You can choose to take action or get help to feel happier.

title: Feelings of Fear
text: Arachnophobia is the fear of spiders. Ophidiophobia is the fear of snakes. Acrophobia is the fear of heights. Everyone has felt fear before. Fear can be a powerful emotion. It is an unpleasant emotion when you feel that someone or something could do you harm. Feeling fear can help protect you from danger. You feel fear when you feel threatened in any way. Then your brain tells your body how to react.

title: Foundations of Fear
text: Spiders, fire, heights, bugs, swimming, public speaking, the dark, and clowns are some of the most common fears that people have. Everyone has different fears. Not all fears feel rational, or make sense. But even irrational fears, fears that evoke emotions that don’t make sense, can feel very real because the emotions are the same. You can overcome many of your fears by thinking about the event or object and making a plan that helps you feel and deal with your emotions. You can make choices to not encounter spiders. You can choose not to go up to high places. You can also train your brain to think of things differently by changing your perspective. Instead of saying, “I am afraid of snakes,” you could say, “I don’t know very much about snakes. I am curious about them.” Or, instead of saying, “I am afraid of public speaking,” you could say, “Public speaking gets me very excited and gives me lots of energy.” You can even try to change your perspective by introducing new experiences. For example, a person might have a fear of dogs because they were bitten by a dog once. They can ask an adult to help them have more positive interactions with safe and trained dogs. That way, their experience isn't limited to something negative.

title: Functions of Fear
text: There is a reason you feel fear. It is your body’s natural way of warning you about danger. Having an appropriate amount of fear is healthy because it helps you avoid hazardous situations and potential injury. It is healthy to be afraid of drugs, strangers, and driving without a seatbelt. Those are all legitimately dangerous situations. When you think about potential consequences, you may feel nervous or afraid. If you are thinking logically (with facts), not emotionally (with emotions), and you feel afraid, you should listen to that fear and leave or change the situation. Put a seatbelt on. Say “no” to drugs. Don’t talk to strangers, in real life or online. When you make wise decisions because of a logical fear, you can avoid most scary situations.

title: Effects of Fear
text:
Negative effects of fear can be unhealthy if not treated. Negative effects usually happen when someone feels irrational fear. This may mean they feel more fear than is appropriate, they are afraid of something that isn’t normally hazardous, or they don’t deal with what they feel.

Alma has a deep fear of clowns. Anytime she sees a picture of one or even hears the word “clown,” she gets nervous. Her heart starts beating faster. Alma has never actually seen a clown in real life. She has only seen a scary clown in a movie once. But now, she has nightmares about them and is terrified of them. Alma’s fear of clowns may be irrational, but her feelings are real. She has no real reason to be afraid of clowns, but this fear may cause her heart to race, her hands to sweat, or her body to shake. This fear could even cause her to change her behaviors. The fear may keep her from going to a circus or make her want to stay away from parties where people are dressed as clowns. This fear may keep her from seeing certain movies with friends. When you feel afraid, you can start dealing with it by getting curious. Alma asks herself:

Why am I afraid of this?

What experiences have I had that cause me to feel afraid?

Could my fear really happen? How likely is it? (Is this rational?)

It is healthy to feel and deal with your fearful emotions. There can be negative effects of not dealing with emotions like fear. When a person lets irrational fears take over, they may experience some negative effects, like:

Anxious feelings

Missing out on experiences or people

Lack of progress

title: Preparing Ahead of Fear
text: People are often afraid of what they cannot predict or control. Some people are afraid of the future because they do not know for certain what will happen. A great way to decrease your fear of the future is to prepare for it. You can establish healthy routines and habits that will help you avoid problems in the future. You can brush your teeth every day to avoid cavities in the future. You can study for a test to avoid failing in the future. You can follow classroom or school rules to avoid injuries. There are many things that your school and community do to help people be prepared for the future. At school, you have fire, earthquake, and other safety drills to be ready if an emergency occurs. Your community may send information or practice other drills to protect against natural disasters. When you are prepared, you do not need to be afraid of the unknown. Remember what is in your control and what you can do to prepare for what is not.

title: Choosing Healthy Responses to Fear
text:
Sometimes being afraid of missing out on what other people are doing can cause a person to change their behavior and even do things they wouldn’t normally do.

Evan was walking down the hall at school. He saw a big group of his friends gathered in a circle, laughing and talking. He walked over to the group to see what was going on. He noticed that they were all looking at a phone and laughing at another one of their classmates in a picture online. Evan knew this wasn’t kind, but all his friends were doing it.

Peer pressure can cause a person to think about an event or experience in a skewed way. Negative peer pressure can make you think you need to do something to fit in, keep up, or be included. If it seems like everyone is joining a gang, doing drugs, or bullying someone, it may make a person feel like that is normal behavior. A person may feel like they should join in because they are afraid to be different or afraid they are missing out on the experience. Doing the right thing means knowing the difference between things that are worth missing out on and things that are worth joining in on.

Evan knows that it is wrong to bully others, online or in real life. Evan needs to make a choice. He can join in with his friends to make fun of their classmate. He can feel afraid of missing out, not belonging, or being left out. He can even be afraid of becoming the next victim. If Evan lets the fear make his decision for him, he may end up doing something he regrets.

Evan didn’t like the idea of making fun of someone, especially when they weren’t there to defend themselves. He decided to remind his friends about the game that night. He asked if they were all going to go to the game and changed the subject. The conversation changed to the game, Angela put the phone away, and everyone stopped talking badly about the student’s picture.

When you feel afraid of missing out on experiences, popularity, or certain friendships, think about what is healthy and what will help you be your best self. Make the choices that will help you be a person who others want to be around and who helps others feel connected and included. Make the choice that helps you and your friends be healthy emotionally, physically, academically, mentally, and socially.

title: Types of Stress
text:
Pressure is where stress begins. Pressure is feeling the need to do something. You might put pressure on yourself to get good grades or take care of your body. Pressure can also come from people around you, like your friends and family. You may feel pressure because you have so many things to get done. Pay attention to the pressure you feel, where it comes from, and if it is prompting you to do things that are good or bad for your health.

Stress is when you feel a lot of pressure at once and begin to feel mentally overwhelmed or strained. It is normal and even good to have some stress in your life. Different kinds of stress create different responses and different outcomes. The right kind of stress is motivating. The wrong kind of stress can be problematic.

Eustress is a positive kind of stress. It is stress that motivates you to work hard and be productive. You may feel eustress to get homework done by a deadline. Or maybe you have a recital coming up, and you may feel good stress that will motivate you to practice your instrument so you perform well. Eustress is gentle stress that pushes you to be your best self.

Distress is intense stress that can cause other negative emotions, like sadness, depression, or anxiety. Distress can make it difficult to be productive or move forward. It can be overwhelming. Distress can even affect your physical health by weakening your immune system. Distress can increase the amount of cortisol, a stress hormone, that your body produces. Cortisol can lower the number of lymphocytes in your blood and interfere with your white blood cell production. The increased cortisol and decreased white blood cell communication can make the body’s immune system less effective in fighting germs. Distress can cause physical symptoms. The next time you have a headache or a stomachache or feel really easily agitated, think about what could be stressing you out, then make some decisions to improve the stressors or your behaviors.

If you have severe feelings of stress or sadness over multiple months, it is important to ask a trusted adult for help.

title: Stress Can Help You Grow
text:
Things that cause eustress can help you grow! Getting out of your comfort zone can be stressful, but doing things you have never done before is how you learn and gain new skills.

When Cameron exercises, his muscles grow. As Cameron works hard, he puts stress on his muscles and they actually break down. The next day, he might feel sore and his muscles may feel tight. If he gets the muscles moving, the soreness fades and the next time he exercises, he notices that the muscles have increased in their capacity. Cameron needs to continue to lift heavier weights to continue getting stronger.

As you encounter more stressful life events, you will get stronger and better at feeling and dealing with stressful emotions. Doing new things can cause the mind and emotions to experience a lot of stress, like breaking down a worked muscle. But as you continually try new things, your brain and your ability to manage emotions grow stronger, and you will be able to do harder and harder things.

title: Causes of Stress
text:
The causes of stress are different for everyone. Highlight any items on the following list that cause you stress. Highlight the ideas that cause you eustress in green. Highlight the ideas that cause you distress in red.

Homework

Sports

Presentations

Arguments

Losing things

Performances

Feeling lonely

Comparing yourself to others

Being late

Talking to friends

Eating lunch

Difficult situations, like losing a loved one, can cause you to feel greater stress, sadness, or anxiety. If you feel overwhelmed with heavy emotions, it is wise to talk to a teacher or school counselor. You can also talk to parents, guardians, and other trusted adults, including a doctor.

title: Understanding Your Stress
text:
When you are feeling stressed, ask yourself, “Is this stress really necessary?” You can reflect on different experiences, activities, or people to determine the ways they may or may not contribute to your stressful feelings.

There is no one right way to feel in situations, but when you feel stressed, you can take a step back to determine how much stress would be appropriate. You can ask these questions to try to understand your stress better:

How much does this thing affect me?

How much control do I have over this thing?

If you have no control, it is best to limit the stress you feel over it.

Stress Color Meter

Test your reflection skills by highlighting the following scenarios in different colors based on the amount of stress each scenario causes you. The warmer the color you use for the scenario, the more stress you think is appropriate. The cooler the color you use for the scenario, the less stress that experience creates for you. If a situation gives you no stress or very little stress, you do not need to highlight the scenario.

Can’t find the pair of shoes you wanted to wear

Lost your dog

Dealing with a bully

Arguments at home

Lost your favorite pencil

Fighting with a friend

Sharing a presentation at school

Handing in homework

Starting homework

title: Coping Strategies
text:
There are many different ways to feel and deal with stressful emotions. Coping strategies are things that can help you feel better. You can use coping strategies any time you are dealing with a challenging emotion, like sadness, frustration, and especially stress!

Cameron deals with stress by setting goals and making a plan.

Alana manages her stressful feelings by dancing to her favorite music.

Aleki talks to his grandma when he is stressed.

Steven and Claire like to laugh about stressful situations to get through them.

Gina takes a break from stressful homework to walk outside, then returns to finish.

The same coping strategies may not work for everyone. Each person needs to figure out what coping strategies help them the most. Also, a certain coping strategy, like breathing exercises, may only help you calm down in certain situations. So, it is best to have a few coping strategies ready to go when you need them.

title: Spending, Saving, and Investing
text:
How do people pay for their needs and wants? People must work in order to earn money. People work in many jobs to earn money. You could work in a restaurant or grocery store. You could farm the land and grow crops. You could even open your own business. You could also become a teacher, veterinarian, doctor, lawyer, or computer programmer. The possibilities are endless.

Money that you receive for working is called income. You can do many things with your income. Most people use their income to meet their needs. This includes paying for rent or a mortgage, electricity, food to eat, and transportation. Medical services, like visiting the doctor or going to the dentist, also cost money.

You can also use your money to buy things you want. Some people choose to save a portion of their income for the future. You can earn money to buy goods and services you need and want. People have many choices about how to save and spend their income. Part of the income people earn is collected by the government in the form of taxes. Taxes pay for community, state, and national services.

title: Debit and Credit
text:
There are many ways that someone can pay for their wants or needs. Besides using cash or a check, people can also use plastic, either in the form of a debit card or a credit card.

A debit card is tied to a banking account. This means that the money someone spends with a debit card is money that they have available in their banking account. This gives people the advantage of not having to carry around a large amount of cash. However, debit card users have to be careful to not spend more than what is in their account. If they do, their bank or credit union will charge them fees called overdraft fees.

Another way people are able to spend money is by using credit cards. Credit cards allow a person to go into debt to purchase their wants and needs. Debt is money that one person owes another. When someone borrows money from a bank, that money must be paid back. An interest fee is charged for borrowing the money. Individuals, businesses, and governments can have debt. Many people go into debt to pay for a house, a car, or college. However, if people aren’t careful with their money, they can also go into debt for everyday items. This includes clothes, entertainment, and food. One way to stay out of debt is to save money for large purchases. Additionally, try not to spend more than you earn. To get rid of debt, a person should begin paying it off a little at a time until the debt is gone.

Both types of cards allow people to learn responsibility for their finances. They teach people to only spend money they have or to build up their financial history by using credit cards.

title: Credit Scores
text:
Learning how to manage credit cards and debt is a great way to keep someone's finances in a positive place and can lead to many helpful benefits.

Checking someone’s credit score is an example of looking at their financial well-being. A credit score is a number that a credit bureau gives based on a person’s spending habits and how quickly they repay any debts they have. A credit score is a record that builds up a person’s credit history, or how responsible a person is in paying back their debts. Often, people must show their credit score when they make a large, expensive purchase, such as buying a car or a house. Credit bureaus keep track of people’s credit scores. There are three major credit bureaus that people use today: Equifax®, Experian® and TransUnion®.

Having a high credit score helps people get approved for mortgages, car payments, other credit cards, and low-interest loans. Having a good credit history of paying items off, paying on time, and not having large balances can also be a deciding factor in applying for apartments or getting a new job.

Payment History

Part of a person’s credit score is based on their payment history. A person’s payment history makes up about 298 points of the 850 points of credit a person can achieve. If late payments occur or if a person skips a payment, their credit score is affected. Payment history can go as far back as 7–10 years.

The Amount You Owe

Another part of a person’s credit score involves looking at how much they have on their credit accounts. This means looking at the amount of credit that has been used and the amount that is still available. Maxing out credit cards can leave a negative impact on a person’s credit. In contrast, if a person uses their credit cards but also pays them off regularly, it can have a positive impact on their credit score.

Length of Credit History

Being able to show the credit use and history of a credit account will also help a person increase their credit score. Credit history shows the oldest account opened with a person’s credit, the newest account, and how regularly the accounts have been used and paid off.

New Credit

Opening up many new credit accounts all at once or applying for multiple loans at one time can have a negative impact on a person’s credit score. However, a person can create a positive credit history when they open up one account at one time and pay it off regularly. This can give a person a positive new credit history.

Types of Credit

There are also many types of credit accounts a person can apply for. These types of credit accounts can have a variety of purposes. Applying for a credit card at a retail store, a credit card from the bank, or a loan for a car payment or house mortgage are all types of credit a person can use to build their credit history.

title: Retirement
text:
The Social Security system pays money to those who have retired, those with deceased spouses, or those who have become disabled (unable to work because of illness or injury). About 65 percent of people receiving payments are retired workers.

However, the money paid out by Social Security is no longer enough for most people to live off of in retirement. On average, Social Security usually covers about 40 percent of a person’s pre-retirement income.

Today, most people have to plan ahead and save for retirement. You may have heard your parents or grandparents talk about putting money into their retirement fund before. Your parents or grandparents may not be planning to retire for another 20–40 years, but planning ahead and saving money for retirement takes a long time. In fact, experts recommend that people start saving for retirement at the age of 20. The reason for this is that the sooner you start saving for retirement, the longer that money has to accrue interest in a savings account.

Some of the important things to consider when planning for retirement include figuring out at what age you would like to retire, any medical expenses you may have to take care of as you get older, where you will live, and how much money you will need each month to live on. The average American spends 20 years in retirement before they die. So, on average, you will want to plan to save 20 years’ worth of income to live on in retirement. Experts recommend putting 10 to 15 percent of each paycheck toward retirement. This means if you had a goal to save 10 percent and made $1,000 from one paycheck, you would put $100 toward your retirement savings.

Some companies offer their employees a retirement benefit called a 401(K). A 401(K) is a program into which you pay a set amount of money with each paycheck. Some employers will match this payment and pay some or all of the same amount toward your 401(K). This is meant to help people prepare for retirement years down the road. The earlier a person starts saving and the more money they contribute toward their 401(K), the more they can save and accrue in interest. Remember that goal of saving 10 percent of each paycheck? Well, if you have a 401(K) and your employer matches 100 percent of your payments, you could save five percent, and your employer would match the other five, which would meet your goal of 10 percent. There are also options for people who don’t have a 401(K) plan offered by their employer. There are Individual Retirement Accounts (IRA) that people can sign up for to put their savings into. These work similar to regular savings accounts, but they are meant to be separate and never have money drawn out until you retire.

Some people also invest some of their money in stocks in order to earn interest and make more money. These investments can pay off in a big way, but they are also unpredictable and can fluctuate, depending on the economy.

However you eventually start planning for retirement, always remember that the sooner you start saving, the better. The future you will thank you.

title: Long-Term Financial Planning
text:
There are many ways that a person can plan to make long-term financial decisions. Long-term financial decisions require taking steps and planning with a goal in mind. This goal could be to save money for a car in three years, or to save enough for a down payment on a house in 10 years. Long-term financial goals can be a step forward in planning for retirement as well.

One way that people make an investment is through real estate. Being able to buy, own, sell, and rent property can be a profitable investment. Real estate owners and investors are able to use the property they own to take out more loans. They can offer their property against the loans. If they can’t pay off the loan, their property is taken to settle the debt. Otherwise, they pay off the loans and interest over time.

Rental properties are a great way to create a regular passive or separate income. However, they can take a lot of time and effort to manage, depending on the tenants who are renting and any damages they cause. Another way people can rent out their properties is by being part of Real Estate Investment Groups (REIGs). These groups are for people who own rental properties but do not want to maintain or manage them. REIG can be hired to come in and manage and operate the properties.

House flipping is another type of real estate investing that allows people to buy houses, fix them up, and then resell them for a higher price. This seems like a quick way to make money, but it can cause issues, depending on the housing market and the prices of interest rates.

Many people invest their money in the stock market. The stock market is a large group of companies that sell shares to investors. Shares are like a small part of the company. So, if you are a stockholder (also called a shareholder) in a toy company, then you own a small part of that toy company. Companies sell stocks to raise money. They might need to build a new factory or hire more people or design a new product. They could borrow the money, but they would have to pay interest, and they'd have to pay back the money by a certain date. Instead, they allow people to buy a small part of their company.

Stockholders make money when the company makes money, but they can also lose money if the company does not do well. Being a shareholder means you share both the profits and the risks. People buy stocks hoping that a company will be successful and their stocks will be worth more over time. If you buy stock in lots of different companies and leave your money in the stock market for a long time, you can often earn more than you would in a savings account in a bank — sometimes a lot more. That's the profit part. However, sometimes the stock market goes down, and investors lose money if the company loses profits or goes out of business. That's the risk part.

In the stock market, prices go up and down a lot, but they usually change a little bit at a time. When stock prices continue to go up over a long period of time, people call that a bull market. A bear market happens when stock prices go down over a long period of time.

Using a money market account is another great step in long-term financial planning. A money market account is an account that a person puts money into to earn interest. A money market account has a high interest rate. This means that it will earn more money over time than a savings account. A money market account also gives a person the ability to write checks or have a debit card. Imagine you start putting $100 into a money market account every month when you turn 18. You do not touch the money in that account until you are 28. If you did these things, it could help you set up a fund to give you a start on retiring or buying a home.

title: Models of the World
text:
There are different ways we can study the world's geography. A globe is a round model of the Earth. Globes show us where water, land, and countries are located. Globes are useful when you need to see the Earth in a more accurate, spherical shape.

Maps are drawings of places around the world. They show where places are located and how to get there. Maps help us find the direction we need to travel. They can show large areas like continents or small areas like cities. Maps can show elevation, which means height above sea level. They can show the population, or how many people live there. They can also show the climate, or the weather over a long period of time. The person who creates a map is called a cartographer. A cartographer has a point of view and decides what to include on a map.

There are map tools that we use to help us when using maps and globes. Map tools include the title, legend, compass rose, cardinal directions, and scale. The map’s title helps us know the map's purpose and the kind of information we will examine on the map. The map’s legend or key explains what the symbols and colors on the map represent. Maps have a compass rose. The compass rose is a symbol that shows the cardinal directions north, south, east, and west. The compass rose can also show the intermediate directions of northwest, northeast, southwest, and southeast. Distance is how far it is from one place to another. You can tell the distance on a map by looking at the scale.

title: We All Need Coping Strategies
text:
Coping strategies are behaviors or thought patterns that help you deal with strong emotions or hard situations. Coping strategies don’t take your problems or emotions away. Rather, they are ways you can choose to deal with hard things. Everyone has challenges, and everyone uses coping strategies. Different strategies work for different people. Some people may prefer exercising and movement, while others may prefer art and music. Coping strategies can be healthy or unhealthy. Almost anything can be a healthy coping strategy if it helps you feel better and is good for your health.

Families and cultures influence what works as healthy coping strategies. Consider the things you love about your family. Consider what you love about your culture. Think about what brings you happiness or what makes you excited. These are positive, motivating forces in your life.

A big test is happening in Mr. Crawley’s science class on Friday next week.

Natali is doing really well in science class. She’s working hard and doing her homework each day. She hands things in on time and does her best work. Natali is nervous for the test next Friday, so she plans to study her notes to help her be prepared. Natali uses a healthy coping strategy because studying helps her academic and emotional health.

Jim is not doing so well in science class. He doesn’t usually do his homework, and when he does do it, he forgets to hand it in. Jim is nervous for the test next Friday but decides to put off studying. Jim took notes, but he deals with his nervous feelings by avoiding thinking about the test. Jim does not choose a healthy coping strategy because avoiding thinking about the test will not prepare him to do well.

Kaya likes science and tries her best in all of her classes. Her family loves to rhyme and rap. She is worried about the test next week as well. She talks to her mom about her feelings. Kaya and her mom make up rhymes using her science class notes. They use a healthy coping strategy and rap to memorize for the test.

title: Avoiding Unhealthy Coping Strategies
text:
Some coping strategies are harmful to a person’s health. People use them because they seem to ease the pain in the short term, but the truth is that they usually harm a person’s health in the long term. It’s important to develop healthy coping strategies so you don’t use unhealthy ways to deal with a problem or big emotions.

Some examples of unhealthy coping strategies include drugs, alcohol, self-harm, violence, pornography, eating disorders, and even technology overuse. We know all of these behaviors are damaging to our physical, mental, social, emotional, and academic well-being. While some of these coping mechanisms seem to help at first, they actually cause additional problems for the person using them. Unhealthy coping strategies do not solve problems or help a person deal with their emotions. They are often addictive, meaning they’re hard to stop when you want to. They end up creating more problems or adding to the already-existing problems. Be smart when you’re going through challenges. Choose healthy coping strategies instead of unhealthy habits that will only make your life harder.

Thomas was on the football team. He was competing with Mac to be the quarterback and team captain. Thomas felt motivated about the competition for this spot on the team. He wanted to win and show all of his teammates that he was a good player. Over the summer, Thomas decided to eat healthy foods, get enough rest, and practice his plays from the team notebook. Thomas even called some teammates to practice with him and work on their timing. When his friends wanted to stay out late, Thomas talked to them about his goals and why he wanted to get enough rest. Thomas avoided unhealthy coping strategies. He communicated clearly with his friends, paid attention to the goals he had to take care of his body, gave his body the rest he needed, and had proper nutrition.

Mac was also very determined to earn the spot of quarterback and team captain. Mac’s friend knew how much Mac wanted to beat out Thomas for the spot. He offered Mac performance-enhancing drugs to get an edge on the competition. Mac wasn’t sure what to do. He knew that the drugs could help him improve his strength, but he also remembered reading about all of the negative side effects and harmful consequences of using drugs like that.

Mac decided not to use the performance-enhancing drugs. He decided to just do his best. He worked hard to get stronger by exercising and lifting weights. Mac avoided unhealthy coping strategies by saying “no” to harmful substances that could cause health problems for him.

title: Movement as a Coping Strategy
text:
All areas of your well-being are connected. Taking care of your physical well-being can often help improve your emotional or mental well-being. You can use exercise and physical movement to help reduce your mental or emotional challenges. When you move and get your heart rate up, your body releases endorphins. Endorphins are hormones that can make you feel happier and less stressed or anxious. There are so many ways to get moving.

Stella likes to run. When she gets stressed, a short run helps her to think more clearly about the problem.

Andrew likes to tumble. When he gets upset about something, he likes to perform his favorite gymnastics routine because it gives him a sense of accomplishment.

Cambree loves to create things. When she gets stressed, she likes to go outside and create something in nature.

Matt likes to swim. When he gets stressed, he likes to find a pool, the ocean, or somewhere else to swim with a buddy.

Ellis loves to spend time outside. When he feels overwhelmed, he likes to walk up the stairs to the garden on top of his apartment building.

title: Thoughts as Coping Strategies
text:
Your thoughts are so powerful that they affect your behavior. Big emotions can cause a strong response, but you can use positive thoughts to help you feel and deal with them.

Breathing: Breathe in as you count to four, hold your breath for four seconds, breathe out for four seconds, then relax and don't breathe for four seconds. Breathing deeply helps you slow down your thoughts.

Positive visualization: Imagine yourself overcoming your challenge. Imagine what things will be like when your challenge is over. Visualizing helps you keep your thoughts focused on what you want to happen.

Positive affirmations: Say things that remind you that you are okay despite your challenge: “I can do this. I am safe. I can take deep breaths. I am smart. I am loved.” Positive affirmations help you train your thoughts to be positive.

Be present: Notice things around you to help you be present. Find red things in your room. Hold a textured item and pay attention to how it feels. Being present helps you practice managing your thoughts and overcome stress or anxiety.

title: Anxiety
text:
All dimensions of your health are connected. Your emotions can affect your behavior and each area of your wellness. Anxiety is a feeling of nervousness or worry. It usually happens when you are afraid of something that could happen in the future. Anxious feelings can feel overwhelming and can affect your other emotions and even your behavior. If a person has anxious feelings that keep them from taking care of their health in some way or stop them from spending time with friends or family, it can become a problem.

Josh is very afraid of the dentist. The office is noisy and uncomfortable, and he is worried about his tooth that hurts. He has heard about cavities, but he doesn’t know what will happen if a cavity is making his tooth hurt. After school, Josh’s mom tells him she has scheduled a dentist appointment for him. Josh starts to breathe faster and even feels like he is going to cry. The appointment isn’t for a few weeks, but Josh already feels anxious about it.

Some people respond negatively to strong emotions and make choices that could cause them or someone else harm or injury. When a person understands a feeling better, they can make a plan to be prepared for that feeling. A plan can help them respond in a way that does not result in injury or harm to them or anyone else.

Josh knows that he feels anxious when he has a dentist appointment. Instead of getting frustrated and throwing his backpack or hitting his brother, he can think about the following questions:

Why am I afraid of going to the dentist?

What am I afraid could happen if I go?

Why do I go to the dentist?

What usually happens when I go to the dentist?

Would it make me feel better if I visited the dentist office without having an appointment so I can become familiar with the office and see what will happen during my appointment?

When you feel anxious, you can ask yourself questions like these to better understand your emotion and try to calm it down.

title: Identifying Anxiety
text:
Recognizing symptoms of feeling anxious can help a person process, or understand, the emotion.

Josh’s hands get sweaty and his heart pumps fast. He even feels a little sick to his stomach. Josh remembers reading about anxiety at school. He thinks about how his body is reacting to his emotions. He dries his hands, takes a deep breath, and checks his heart rate by putting two fingers on the inside of his wrist. Josh is still worried. When Josh and his brother drive to get a haircut, right next door to the dentist, Josh feels even more nervous and almost doesn’t go in to get his haircut. When they get home, Josh has trouble sleeping that night because he doesn’t know what will happen at the dentist. The next morning, Josh tells his mom how worried he is and that he couldn’t sleep during the night. Josh’s mom talks to him about how these are all signs of his anxious feelings.

Signs and symptoms of emotions or injuries help you realize what is going on inside your body.

Physiological signs can help you pay attention to your body’s needs. Social or emotional signs of anxiety can be harder to detect, but paying attention to how your feelings affect your choices and behaviors can help you recognize the signs. Identifying anxious feelings is the first step in working through them in a healthy way.

title: Causes of Anxiety
text:
The causes of anxious feelings can be different for everyone. Sometimes big emotions happen because of internal thoughts. Sometimes big emotions happen because of external influences like a negative experience such as loss, peer pressure, or injury.

Some common sources of anxiety can include things like:

Anxiety about the past: This might include overthinking or feeling regret about something that has already happened.

The last time Josh had a dentist appointment, he was so anxious that he cried at school before he got checked out to go. The experience Josh had crying at school created more anxious feelings for him the next time he had an appointment and made him want to avoid going to school. Josh finds himself worrying about the dentist appointment and thinks constantly about it.

Anxiety about the future: This might include feeling anxious about things that have not happened yet. This cause of anxiety is very common.

Josh worries about crying at school again. He doesn’t know what will happen and feels all the physiological symptoms of anxiety. He worries about the appointment, his body’s response to his emotions, and what his friends will think about him.

Separation anxiety: This is anxiety or stress caused when someone is separated from someone they are close to, usually their parents or caregiver.

Josh’s anxious feelings cause him to feel more stressed when his mom isn’t with him. He worries that if she isn’t there, he won’t be able to tell anyone what he needs.

Social anxiety: This is anxiety caused by being around other people. You may feel social anxiety in social situations such as parties, school, or other group gatherings.

Josh’s anxious feelings make him want to avoid being with his friends because he felt embarrassed when he cried.

Some things can worsen feelings of anxiety, and some responses to big emotions are not good for your health and wellness. When a person has overwhelming feelings, sometimes they decide to hurt themselves or others in an attempt to manage the emotions. If someone tells you they are planning to harm themselves or others, a trusted adult should be told immediately. When making a plan to manage anxious emotions, it is important to be aware that some responses can make anxious feelings feel worse. If a person feels anxious, they should try to avoid things like technology, caffeine, and sugar. Another huge contributor to anxiousness is drugs and alcohol. Drugs and alcohol are bad for your health in so many ways, including causing and worsening anxiety; it is best that you avoid them.

title: Effects of Anxiety
text:
Anxiety can be a powerful emotion. If you do nothing to manage them or calm them down, anxious feelings can become really big, really fast. Anxiety can affect your schoolwork or your ability to concentrate. It is hard to focus on a math problem or read a book when you are wrestling with fear. Anxiety can also negatively affect your relationships with your friends or family. The most extreme effects of anxiety could lead to depression or self-harm. If you have those types of thoughts, ask for help from a trusted adult immediately.

If you practice managing your anxiety through breathing, talking with others, and positive thinking, you can usually steer clear of these negative effects of anxiety.

Josh’s anxious feelings about the dentist made him make changes in his behavior. He avoided getting a haircut. He even started to feel like not going to school on days leading up to a dentist appointment. The effect of Josh’s anxiety was interfering with his life activities.

title: Anxiety Is Normal
text:
Everyone feels anxiety sometimes. Anxiety is a natural reaction when someone feels threatened or afraid. When you feel in danger, your body automatically produces stress hormones and goes into fight-or-flight mode. These stress hormones get your body ready to react to whatever danger you face. In your brain, the amygdala is the part that handles emotions. It is your amygdala that tells your body to release the stress hormones. There are three main stress hormones:

Adrenaline: gives you a burst of energy so that you can react quickly to your situation

Norepinephrine: gets your body ready for its quick response; it increases your heart rate, your focus and reaction time, and even your pain tolerance.

Cortisol: a slower-acting hormone that prompts cells to release sugar into your blood so you can continue handling your situation

Although anxiety is not enjoyable, it can be good because it can help us avoid harmful or dangerous situations. Paying attention to and heeding (listening to) your anxiety can help you prevent or avoid injuries and other health problems.

Gupta is Josh’s friend. When Gupta saw that Josh was feeling anxious, he asked if everything was okay. Josh told Gupta he was worried about the dentist appointment. Gupta told Josh about how he remembers that when he was younger, he had a really bad bicycle accident. He fell off his bike and scraped his knee up pretty badly. Luckily, he was wearing a helmet at the time, but his knee was really sore for a long time. Every time he saw someone riding a bicycle, Gupta felt like his knee was hurting all over again. Gupta told Josh that he was so worried about it that his grandma took him to see their family physician. The doctor talked to Gupta and his grandma about anxiety and the symptoms. Gupta learned that he was feeling anxious around bikes because he had fallen off his bike the year before. Gupta worked with his grandma to reframe his thinking about riding a bike and was able to learn to ride again without feeling anxious.

Hearing Gupta’s story helped Josh feel brave. Josh decided to ask his dad about his fear of the dentist. Josh and his dad talked about the anxious feelings and they made a plan to go to the dentist’s office one day when Josh didn’t have an appointment, just so Josh could look around. On the day of the visit, Josh still felt nervous, but he and his dad were brave and went anyway.

title: Get Ready for a Career Today!
text:
Careers are types of jobs that people choose to do for the rest of their working lives. Most people hold many different jobs throughout their lives, but many end up choosing those different jobs in a single career and sticking with it. These careers can be in any field, from law enforcement, firefighting, social work, and medicine, to music, computer programming, teaching, and many others. In addition to choosing your career, you will also need to choose whether you will work for someone or start your own business. Working for someone can be very rewarding because you will have someone who can look over your shoulder and help you become better. However, it can also be quite competitive if someone comes along looking to take your career from you.

Careers and jobs are always competitive. Working for yourself can be very hard but also extremely rewarding. You can open your own bakery, start a secondhand store, begin your own construction company, or become an artist. There would be no boss to answer to but also no one to make sure you are at work on time and doing the job correctly.

Something that is very important about a career is school. It is becoming harder to get a career or even a job if you don’t have a good education. Education is something that is important no matter what job you do or what career you go into. To learn more about careers, keep reading: it might help you make a decision you will be happy with in the future. Whatever path you choose to take, make sure it is really what you want to do.

title: Want an Unusual Job?
text:
When you think of what you want to be when you grow up, what jobs come to mind? A police officer? A teacher? A doctor? Maybe you have something a little more unusual in mind, like a jelly donut filler, a Christmas tree decorator, or a fingerprint analyzer. If the job you have in mind isn’t something the average person would think of, you probably need to start planning now if you want your dream job to become a reality.

To get the job you really want, it might be a good idea to talk to someone who is already doing that job for a living. Ask them how they found out about the job, what they did to prepare for it, and if they are happy in their work. Find out how much money the job pays, what the hours are like, and if there is anything about the job that they don’t enjoy. If you are still interested in that job, begin taking classes or reading books that will help you prepare for it.

If you want to train elephants, begin reading books about them and look into volunteering at a nearby zoo, if possible. If you want to retrieve balls from golf course ponds, take scuba diving classes and learn to dive. Now is a great time to start learning any skills that will help you succeed at your future job. You may also want to talk to a school counselor to see if there are jobs available in your area of interest. Your counselor can also help you learn what type of education you might need to prepare for your dream job. It is great to have dreams for your future. It is even better when you take the time to prepare for your dreams so that they can become a reality.

text: How do economic decisions impact career choices?

title: Choose Your Career
text:
People must complete tasks and solve problems in their jobs. Some jobs do not require a lot of special training or education. Others demand it. Let’s look at a few examples of jobs. We’ll explore what they are, the skills required to do them, and what it takes to get hired.

Farmers and Ranchers

Farmers and ranchers work the land. Farmers are responsible for growing and harvesting crops. They must care for the soil between crop harvests and keep an eye on the weather during the growing season. Ranchers care for animals, called livestock. They work on a kind of farm called a ranch. They clean and maintain the areas where the animals live. Ranchers make sure animals are fed. They also check for any signs of illness in the livestock.

Part of a farmer’s or rancher’s job is to keep track of crops and livestock. They have to take inventory, or a count, of everything on the farm. This tells the farm owners how much they have ready to sell to the market. Farmers and ranchers spend most of their working days outside. That might appeal to some people, but some days, they may need to work long days in the rain and snow of winter or the blistering heat of summer. Farmers and ranchers operate special equipment, too. They need to be careful and have the training to operate machinery safely.

Since there are several jobs to do on a farm, many people are needed to get all of the work done. People need to be able to work well with others for this. To work in farming and ranching, many employers also require that you have at least a high school diploma or GED. It is common for new workers to receive some on-the-job training.

Registered Nurses

Nurses are critical to good health care. Nurses work in doctors’ offices and hospitals. They can also work for residential care facilities. Some nurses travel directly to their patients’ homes. Nurses are often the first people you meet when you visit the doctor. Nurses organize patient care. They record patients’ medical histories and provide important information for doctors to review.

Nurses are educators, too. An important part of the job is to educate people about how to care for themselves. Some nurses even show family members how to perform certain tasks to take care of a patient at home.

Patients typically spend more time with a nurse than with a doctor when they receive treatment in a hospital. Nurses must be organized and able to keep track of several patients at a time. They are also responsible for giving patients their medications. They have to be very careful when they do this. Nurses also help patients move around and exercise after they have surgery. This means that nurses should also be in good physical shape.

To become a nurse, you need to be licensed in the state where you work. There are two main requirements. First, you need to graduate from an approved nursing program. You must also pass the National Council Licensure Examination (NCLEX-RN). Each state may require additional qualifications for licensed nurses before they can go to work.

Urban and Regional Planners

Urban and regional planners develop programs and plans for managing cities. They might work on developing the economy. Others might focus on how transportation systems are designed in a city.

To develop good plans, urban planners collect and analyze a lot of data. Their core purpose is to help cities grow and adapt to new conditions. Governments make policies and pass laws. Urban planners give advice to the public officials making these policies and laws. Urban planners suggest how policies could affect people and the physical environment.

Additionally, planners also engage with people in the local community. They discuss possible plans with residents for how to improve their neighborhoods. Just as important, planners listen to residents to find out what is most needed in their communities. Strong communication skills are a must for people who want a career in this field. Planners need to be able to respond to criticism or objections from the public.

Urban planners need to know how to read data and problem-solve. Familiarity with computer programs and geography are also important skills. Urban planners require a college education. Not many colleges offer bachelor’s degrees in urban planning because the profession is fairly new. Most entry-level jobs in urban planning require a master’s degree. Master’s programs in urban planning accept students from a variety of backgrounds. Often, students who have studied social sciences like geography, history, and political science fit right in.

Electricians

Electricians install, maintain, and repair electrical equipment. They work with the wires that provide electricity to buildings and public spaces. Electricians can work for large electrical businesses or build small businesses for themselves. Electricians must be able to read special documents called blueprints. Blueprints show how a building is laid out. Electricians read blueprints to understand how to connect buildings to the electrical grid.

Another part of this job is to make sure electrical systems follow government standards for safety. Electricians need to be educated in the National Electric Code to do this. Electricians must also be problem solvers. When trying to figure out why an outlet is broken, they must rely on critical thinking to find and solve the problem.

People working in this field should also be in good physical shape. They will sometimes need to climb up to high ceilings or fit through low crawl spaces. In addition, they should be able to answer customer questions in a helpful way.

To become an electrician, you have to complete an apprenticeship. This is a program in which a person trains with an experienced electrician for a certain period of time. As they learn job skills, they also gain experience. People doing apprenticeships are also paid as they train.

title: Managing Your Anxiety
text:
There are things you can do to manage your anxiety if it gets too intense or too frequent.

Healthy diet: Sugar can spike, or increase, feelings of anxiety.

Exercise: Regular exercise can help the body produce feel-good hormones.

Sleep: Inadequate sleep can result in exhaustion.

Reality check: Remind yourself of what is real and what is not.

Feeling anxious from time to time is completely normal. But you should know when to ask for help. You should ask a trusted adult for help if you are feeling afraid, nervous, or anxious most days for a long period of time, especially if it is affecting your productivity and life. You can talk to your doctor. A doctor can evaluate symptoms, using a series of questions, to determine if a person has anxiety that should be treated with medication, behavioral intervention, or other methods. Anxiety disorders can be treated with medication when necessary.

Josh continued to talk to his dad and they even asked the dentist some questions about Josh's fears. The dentist gave Josh some great information about how to avoid cavities, how to brush well, and how to do his best to take care of his teeth. Knowing how to care for his teeth helped Josh feel more confident. It helped him know that more about his dentist visit was in his control than he thought previously. Josh decided that he would brush his teeth twice a day, avoid sugary foods and drinks, and floss every night. He knew that these behaviors would help him avoid the pain of cavities. Josh also visited the dentist’s office a couple more times with his dad on days he didn’t have an appointment scheduled. This helped him reframe his thinking about the dentist’s office in general.

No matter what the causes or effects of anxious feelings are for a person, they can always get help to manage the feelings in a healthy way. Sometimes the solution involves talking, and sometimes it can involve other options like medicine or changes to systems and routines.

title: Internships
text:
An internship is similar to an apprenticeship. The purpose of internships is to provide a person with job experience. An intern observes people who work in the job the intern wants to learn about. Interns are given simple tasks to gain some job skills, but for the most part, interns are not given a lot of responsibility. Businesses benefit from internships by gaining some extra help. Interns can help support employed workers while they are observing and learning from them.

Internships can vary in length, but they rarely last longer than a year. Internships can last for several weeks, a couple of months, or half a year. It depends on the company providing the internship. Internships can be part-time or full-time. Usually, companies offer part-time internships during the fall, winter, and spring seasons. Full-time internships are common in the summer. Many companies offer internships to students in high school or college. There are both paid and unpaid internships.

A part-time internship makes sense for students to do during the fall and winter months. Although students are usually in classes during the day, they can coordinate when to fit in their internship hours before, between, or after classes. Over the summer break, many students try to gain lots of work experience. Without classes, students can be full-time interns.

An internship can help someone decide if a job they are interested in is a good fit for them. Internships introduce students to working professionals, too. These professionals provide students with guidance during the internship. They can also help students afterward. Interns may secure their first jobs with a good reference from someone they worked with directly as an intern. Internships can also result in job offers from the company where they interned. This is beneficial to the company because much of the job training was completed during the internship.

title: Careers
text:
You have been reading about careers and how people prepare for them. You have even been able to look at some examples, such as how to become an electrician or licensed nurse. Now, it’s time to look at potential careers for yourself based on your skills and interests. Think about two or three careers that interest you. Think about what you enjoy and what makes you curious. Think about your skills and values. Select one career, then do some research online to find details about that career. Find information that answers the following questions.

Careers Activity

What is the minimum level of education required to qualify for that career?

______________________________________________________________________________________________

How many years of experience does a person need to qualify for that career?

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Does this job require a college degree, a graduate degree, a professional degree (i.e., law or medical degree), or a completed apprenticeship?

______________________________________________________________________________________________

How much money can you make working in this career? (Hint: Look for information related to “median salary.”)

______________________________________________________________________________________________

Does this career have an average lifespan? (How many years could you do this job?)

______________________________________________________________________________________________

What are the different specializations within the career? (Hint: If this question is confusing, start by finding the definition of “specialization.”)

_____________________________________________________________________________________________

Take notes about what you learn for each of these questions.

title: Researching and Organizing Information
text:
It is common to hear someone say, “I want to be a doctor when I grow up,” or, “I want to be a movie star!” Have you ever heard someone say, “I want to be a gumologist”? Probably not! What is a gumologist, anyway? A gumologist is a real job, and it pays a person to chew and test new gum products. Sounds like an easy job, right? Not quite. You see, a gumologist must be able to identify over 70 ingredients from a single pack of gum. There are all kinds of strange and unusual jobs in the world.

Directions:

Create a chart that includes two columns. Then, find two strange job titles that you never knew existed. Write down the job titles on the chart, one in each column. Then, find out the details related to that job, just as you did earlier while researching the careers you might like to have.

Remember, learning about a job includes finding out certain things:

What education and experience are required?

What skills must the person have?

What does the job typically pay?

Is previous professional experience required?

What kind of person would best fit in this type of job?

Fill in your chart with the details of each job. You will get the chance to share what you’ve learned with your classmates. Find out if any of them might be interested in the jobs you found.

Muhammad was born in about 570 CE in Mecca. Muhammad’s father was a tribal leader. He died before Muhammad was born. When he was six, his mother died. Muhammad grew up with first his grandfather and then his uncle.
